1726.name: 滑輪繩索躺地三頭伸展
instructions: 繩索接在低位滑輪機上。
仰臥躺在地面，頭部朝向滑輪機。
雙手抓住繩索兩端，掌心相對，手臂垂直伸向天花板。
上手臂垂直固定，彎曲手肘將繩索放低至額頭兩側。
停頓片刻，伸展手臂推回。
重複所需次數。

1727.name: 滑輪站姿反握單臂過頭三頭伸展
instructions: 背對滑輪機站立，雙腳與肩同寬。
單手持滑輪把手，手臂伸展高舉過頭，手肘靠近耳朵。
上手臂固定不動，手肘彎曲將把手降至頭後。
底部停頓片刻，三頭肌發力將手臂推直。
重複所需次數後換手。

1728.name: 滑輪雙臂三頭後踢
instructions: 雙腳分開與肩同寬站立，膝蓋微屈。
雙手抓住滑輪手把，掌心朝內，手臂呈 90 度屈曲。
上手臂貼緊身側固定，前臂向後推伸直，直到手臂完全伸展（滑輪三頭後屈伸）。
停頓片刻，慢慢放回 90 度。
重複所需次數。

1729.name: 啞鈴仰臥交替伸展
instructions: 平躺在平凳上，雙手各握一啞鈴，掌心相對，手臂垂直於胸前。
手肘微彎，先將單側啞鈴向下屈臂降向頭部，另一臂維持伸展。
底部停頓片刻，推回起始位置。
換另一側手臂重複，雙手交替進行至指定次數。

1730.name: 啞鈴坐姿俯身交替後踢
instructions: 坐在重訓椅上，雙手各握一啞鈴，掌心朝內。
屈髖向前俯身，背部打直與地面平行。
單臂向後推直伸展，手肘貼緊身側，直到手臂完全伸直（啞鈴三頭後屈伸）。
頂點停頓片刻，慢慢收回。
換手重複，雙手交替進行至指定次數。

1731.name: 啞鈴窄握推舉
instructions: 坐在平凳上，雙手各握一啞鈴置於大腿。
用大腿輔助將啞鈴頂至肩寬高度。
轉動手腕使掌心朝前，躺上椅面。
吸氣慢慢將啞鈴降至胸旁，直到與胸口齊平。
吐氣運用胸肌與三頭肌發力將啞鈴推回正上方。
頂峰停頓收緊肌肉，重複所需次數。

1732.name: 啞鈴前弓步三頭伸展
instructions: 雙腳與肩同寬站立，雙手各握一啞鈴。
右腳向前跨步成弓箭步。
背部維持挺直，挺胸。
雙臂伸直高舉過頭頂，手肘貼近耳朵。
手肘彎曲，將啞鈴降向後腦勺。
停頓片刻，手臂向上伸展推回起始位置。
重複所需次數後換腿。

1733.name: 啞鈴上斜雙臂伸展
instructions: 坐在上斜重訓椅上，雙手各握一啞鈴置於大腿。
慢慢躺下，啞鈴貼近胸口。
將手臂向上推直，手肘微屈。
頂部停頓片刻，慢慢降回胸側。
重複所需次數。

1734.name: 啞鈴後踢(健身球)
instructions: 坐在抗力球上，雙腳踩實，背部挺直。
雙手各握一啞鈴，掌心朝內，手肘彎曲呈 90 度。
將手臂向後伸直，在動作頂峰擠壓三頭肌。
稍作停頓，慢慢放回 90 度。
重複所需次數。

1735.name: 啞鈴仰臥單臂伸展
instructions: 平躺在平凳上，單手持啞鈴垂直伸直於胸前。
上手臂固定不動，控制著將啞鈴降向前額上方。
在動作底部稍作停頓，然後伸展手臂推回。
重複所需次數後換手。

1736.name: 啞鈴單臂法式推舉(健身球)
instructions: 坐在抗力球上，雙腳踩實，背部挺直。
單手持啞鈴，掌心朝前，手肘呈 90 度。
將手臂垂直推向天花板，手肘打直。
慢慢降回肩部起始位置。
重複所需次數後換手。

1737.name: 啞鈴坐姿俯身三頭伸展
instructions: 坐在重訓椅上，雙腳踩實，雙手各持一啞鈴。
屈髖向前俯身，背部挺直，抬頭平視。
手肘貼緊頭側向後伸展手臂。
停頓片刻，慢慢放回。
重複所需次數。

1738.name: 啞鈴坐姿反握單臂過頭三頭伸展
instructions: 坐在重訓椅上，背部打直，雙腳踩實。
反握抓住啞鈴，手臂垂直向上伸過頭頂。
手肘彎曲將啞鈴降向頭後，上手臂維持固定。
停頓片刻，手臂推直回到頭頂。
重複所需次數後換手。

1739.name: 啞鈴站姿交替三頭後踢
instructions: 雙腳與肩同寬站立，雙手各握一啞鈴。
膝蓋微屈，屈髖前傾，背部打直。
雙臂向後伸展推直，手肘緊貼身側。
頂峰停頓片刻，慢慢收回。
交替進行或雙臂同步進行至指定次數。

1740.name: 啞鈴站姿俯身單臂三頭伸展
instructions: 雙腳與肩同寬站立，單手持啞鈴。
屈髖前傾，背部平直與地面平行。
將單側手臂向後推直伸展，手肘貼身。
慢慢收回啞鈴。
重複所需次數後換手。

1741.name: 啞鈴站姿俯身雙臂三頭伸展
instructions: 雙腳與肩同寬站立，雙手各持一啞鈴。
屈髖俯身，背部挺直，膝蓋微彎。
雙臂向後伸展打直，手肘貼身。
慢慢收回啞鈴。
重複所需次數。

1742.name: 啞鈴三頭後踢(鸛式站姿)
instructions: 雙腳與肩同寬站立，右手持啞鈴。
膝微屈，屈髖前傾，背部平直。
右上臂抬起貼近身側，手肘呈 90 度。
右臂向後推直伸展，擠壓三頭肌。
頂端停頓片刻，慢慢放回 90 度。
重複所需次數後換邊。

1743.name: 啞鈴扭轉臥推
instructions: 平躺在重訓椅上，雙腳踩實，背貼椅面。
雙手各握一啞鈴，正握，掌心背向自己。
推起啞鈴至胸口正上方，手肘微屈。
降向胸部時手肘貼身，旋轉手腕使掌心在底部朝向自己。
底部停頓片刻，推起啞鈴同時轉回手腕，使掌心再度背向自己。
重複所需次數。

1744.name: 健身球撐體
instructions: 坐在抗力球上，雙腳踩實，膝蓋呈 90 度。
雙手置於臀部旁的球面上，手指朝前。
三頭肌與手臂發力推直，將臀部抬離球體。
屈肘下沉身體貼近球前緣。
重複所需次數。

1745.name: 健身球坐姿三頭伸展
instructions: 坐在抗力球上，雙腳踩平，背部挺直。
單手拿啞鈴，手臂向上垂直伸直。
手肘彎曲將啞鈴降向後頸，上手臂靠近耳側。
保持伸展數秒，然後推回正上方。
換另一手重複。

1746.name: 健身球仰臥三頭伸展
instructions: 坐在抗力球上，雙腳踩平，膝蓋呈 90 度。
雙手合握一個啞鈴，垂直向上伸向天花板。
慢慢將啞鈴放低至後腦勺，手肘維持靠近耳旁。
停頓片刻，伸展三頭肌將啞鈴推回正上方。
重複所需次數。

1747.name: EZ槓法式推舉(健身球)
instructions: 坐在抗力球上，正握抓住 EZ 槓。
雙臂向上完全伸展，手肘貼近頭部。
彎曲手肘，慢慢將槓鈴降至後腦勺下方。
停頓片刻，將手臂向上推展回原位。
重複所需次數。

1748.name: EZ槓仰臥窄握頭後三頭伸展
instructions: 平躺在重訓椅上，頭枕在椅端，雙腳踩實。
雙手反握或正握抓住 EZ 槓，將雙臂推直於胸口上方。
上手臂垂直固定，手肘彎曲將槓鈴降向頭頂後方。
停頓片刻，手臂伸展推回。
重複所需次數。

1749.name: EZ槓站姿法式推舉
instructions: 雙腳與肩同寬站立，正握抓槓鈴。
將槓鈴高舉過頭頂，雙臂伸展。
上手臂貼近頭部固定，彎曲手肘將槓鈴降向後腦勺。
停頓片刻，伸直雙臂推回頭頂。
重複所需次數。

1750.name: 藥球仰臥胸前拋
instructions: 平躺在平凳上，雙膝彎曲雙腳踩實。
雙手抱藥球於胸前。
手肘微收，雙手爆發力向上將藥球盡可能推拋向高空。
接住落下的藥球，立即銜接下一次重複。

1751.name: 槓鈴卡榫推舉
instructions: 在深蹲架上將槓鈴調至胸部高度。
面對槓鈴站好，雙腳與肩同寬。
正握抓槓，握距略寬於肩寬。
起槓推直於胸部上方。
將槓鈴慢慢降向胸部，手肘適度內收。
觸胸時稍作停頓。
發力推回起始位置，雙臂完全伸展。
重複所需次數。

1752.name: 史密斯機上斜三頭伸展
instructions: 調整史密斯椅位，使槓鈴位於肩部高度。
坐在重訓椅上，背靠椅背，雙腳踩實。
正握抓槓，握距略寬於肩。
起槓推直於胸部正上方。
上手臂固定，手肘彎曲將槓鈴降向前額上方。
底部停頓片刻，三頭肌發力推回。
重複所需次數。

1753.name: 三凳撐體
instructions: 坐在重訓椅邊緣，雙手握住椅緣，手指朝前。
臀部移開椅面，雙手支撐全身重量。
屈肘下沉身體，直到上手臂平行地面。
手臂推直，將身體撐回原位（椅子雙臂撐體）。
重複所需次數。

1754.name: 負重三凳撐體
instructions: 坐在平凳邊緣，雙手握緊凳緣。
雙腳向前走，臀部懸空移出凳緣，手臂支撐體重。
屈肘下沉身體，背部貼近長凳。
底部停頓片刻，撐起身體回原位。
重複所需次數。

1755.name: 負重三頭撐體
instructions: 坐在重訓椅邊緣，雙手抓在臀部兩側。
雙腿向前伸展，臀部滑出椅面。
背部貼近長凳，手肘微屈。
手肘彎曲下沉身體至上手臂平行地面。
雙手推直將自己撐回頂端。
重複所需次數。

1756.name: 槓鈴單腿硬舉
instructions: 雙腳與臀部同寬站立，正握槓鈴置於大腿前。
重心轉移到左腳，右腳向後微抬懸空。
背部打直、屈髖前傾，右腿順勢向後延伸平衡（單腿羅馬尼亞硬舉）。
將槓鈴沿著左腿下放，左膝保持微彎。
在底部感受拉伸停頓片刻，臀大肌發力將身體拉回站姿。
重複所需次數後換腳。

1757.name: 啞鈴單腿硬舉
instructions: 雙腳與臀部同寬站立，右手持啞鈴。
重心移至左腿，右腳向後微離地。
背部打直，屈髖前傾將啞鈴降向地面。
同時右腿向後伸展打直，與軀幹呈一直線平行地面。
在拉伸極限處停頓片刻，臀肌發力站回原位。
重複所需次數後換手換腳。

1758.name: 輔助仰臥起坐
instructions: 坐在下斜板或平凳上，固定雙腳。
平躺，膝蓋微屈。
雙手放於後腦勺，手肘朝外。
腹肌發力收緊，將上半身捲離椅面，抬至約 45 度（斜板仰臥起坐/捲腹）。
頂端停頓片刻，慢慢降回。
重複所需次數。

1759.name: 單腿深蹲(手槍式)男
instructions: 雙腳與肩同寬站立，雙臂向前平舉。
右腿向前伸直懸空。
彎曲左膝髖部後推，單腿下蹲（手槍深蹲）。
下蹲時挺胸背打直。
蹲至左大腿平行地面或舒適深度。
底部停頓片刻，踩穩左腳跟蹬起回站姿。
重複所需次數後換腿。

1760.name: 啞鈴高腳杯深蹲
instructions: 雙腳與肩同寬站立，雙手在胸前垂直托住一個啞鈴（高腳杯深蹲 Goblet Squat）。
挺胸收腹，屈髖屈膝向後下蹲。
蹲至大腿平行地面或略低。
底部停頓片刻，腳跟發力推回站姿。
重複所需次數。

1761.name: 懸垂斜向屈膝抬腿
instructions: 懸掛在單槓上，手臂完全伸展，掌心朝外。
收緊核心，屈膝將雙膝抬向胸部，同時將下半身向一側轉動。
頂端停留片刻，慢慢放回中央。
換向另一側重複抬腿轉體。
交替進行至所需次數。

1763.name: 肩寬握引體向上
instructions: 抓握單槓，握距與肩同寬，掌心朝外（正握引體向上）。
雙臂完全伸直懸掛。
啟動背肌將身體向上拉起，直到下巴超過單槓。
頂峰停頓片刻，慢慢降回懸掛姿勢。
重複所需次數。

1764.name: 懸垂抬腿抬髖
instructions: 懸掛在單槓上，手臂伸直，掌心朝外。
收緊核心，屈髖屈膝抬起雙腿，直到大腿與地面平行。
頂峰停頓片刻，緩慢放回。
重複所需次數。

1765.name: 啞鈴直立划船(背面視角)
instructions: 雙腳與肩同寬站立，雙手各持一啞鈴，正握。
啞鈴垂在大腿前，雙臂伸展。
背部打直核心收緊，吐氣以手肘引導將啞鈴垂直向上提拉至下巴高度（啞鈴直立划船）。
手肘始終高於手腕，在頂峰停頓片刻。
吸氣慢慢降回啞鈴。
重複所需次數。

1766.name: 自我輔助反向腿彎舉
instructions: 趴在機械腿彎舉機上，腳踝扣在滾輪墊下方。
雙手抓緊把手維持上半身固定。
上半身放平貼墊，吐氣收縮腿後肌群，將滾輪拉向臀部。
頂峰強力收縮腿後腱片刻。
吸氣慢慢放回至膝蓋微屈。
重複所需次數。

1767.name: 高雙槓負重三頭撐體
instructions: 雙手撐在雙槓上，雙臂伸直支撐全身重量。
彎曲手肘下沉身體，直到上手臂平行地面。
稍作停頓，雙手推直將自己推回頂端（雙槓撐體）。
重複所需次數。

1769.name: 徒手側臥二頭彎舉
instructions: 側躺在地面上，單臂屈枕在頭下。
上臂貼緊身側，手肘彎曲，前臂向上彎舉。
頂峰停頓片刻，慢慢放回。
重複所需次數後換邊。

1770.name: 腿部二頭集中彎舉
instructions: 坐在重訓椅上，雙腿張開，雙腳平踩。
單手拿啞鈴，手肘抵在大腿內側近膝蓋處。
掌心朝上，將啞鈴向上彎舉向肩膀，上手臂維持不動（集中彎舉）。
頂端擠壓二頭肌，慢慢降回。
重複所需次數後換手。

1771.name: 徒手跪姿三頭伸展
instructions: 膝蓋跪地與臀同寬。
雙手在身前撐地與肩同寬，手指朝前。
雙腿向後伸展成高棒式，身體成一直線。
手肘微收彎曲，將上半身降向地面。
底部停頓片刻，掌心推地推回起始位置。
重複所需次數。

1772.name: 抬肘反向伏地挺身
instructions: 俯臥趴在地上，雙腿伸展，雙手撐在肩部正下方。
收緊核心手掌推地，將上半身挺離地面，手肘貼近身側。
頂峰停留片刻，收縮上背肌群。
慢慢將身體放回地面。
重複所需次數。

1773.name: 單臂毛巾划船
instructions: 雙腳分開與肩同寬站立，雙膝微屈，單手抓握毛巾。
屈髖前傾，背部維持平直，核心收緊。
手臂完全向前伸展垂下。
將毛巾拉向胸部，夾緊肩胛骨。
頂峰停頓片刻，慢慢放回。
重複所需次數後換手。

1774.name: 側橋式髖外展
instructions: 側躺，雙腿伸直疊放。
前臂撐地，手肘正對肩膀下方。
啟動核心將髖部抬離地面成側棒式，身體呈一直線。
維持側棒式穩定，將上側腿向上抬起，骨盆不翻轉。
頂峰停頓片刻，慢慢放回。
重複所需次數後換邊。

1775.name: 側棒式髖內收
instructions: 側躺在地上，雙腿伸直疊放。
手肘置於肩下撐起身體成側棒式。
核心收緊，骨盆抬離地面呈一直線。
維持側棒式姿勢，將上側腿朝天花板向上抬高打直。
慢慢降回。
重複所需次數後換邊。

1777.name: 過頭胸部伸展
instructions: Stand tall and interlace your fingers, then raise your arms overhead.
Press your arms slightly back and lift your chest without arching your lower back.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1778.name: 輔助站姿胸部伸展
instructions: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides and your hands at shoulder height or slightly lower.
Have your partner hold your wrists and slowly pull your arms back until you feel a stretch across your chest.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1779.name: 輔助坐姿胸部伸展
instructions: Sit upright on a bench or chair with your hands behind your head or arms out wide.
Have your partner stand behind you and gently draw your elbows or wrists back.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1780.name: 屈臂胸部伸展
instructions: Stand beside a wall or doorframe and place your forearm on it with your elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Step forward and turn your body away until you feel the stretch across your chest.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1781.name: 牆角胸部伸展
instructions: Stand facing a wall corner and place a forearm on each wall at about shoulder height.
Step one foot forward and lean your chest into the corner until you feel a stretch.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1782.name: 反向胸部伸展
instructions: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back with straight arms.
Lift your hands up and away from your body while opening your chest.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1783.name: 站姿胸部伸展(訓練肋木)
instructions: Stand beside wall bars and grip a bar at about shoulder height with one hand.
Slowly turn your body away from the bars until you feel a stretch across your chest.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1784.name: 輔助後拉胸部伸展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with your arms extended behind you at hip to shoulder height.
Have your partner hold your wrists and gently pull your arms back and slightly up.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1785.name: 跪姿胸部伸展
instructions: Kneel in front of a bench or chair and rest your forearms or hands on it.
Sit your hips back and let your chest drop toward the floor until you feel the stretch.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1786.name: 輔助軀幹屈曲胸部伸展
instructions: Sit or stand with your hands clasped behind your head and your elbows wide.
Have your partner pull your elbows back as you gently tilt your trunk forward.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1787.name: 直臂向後胸部伸展
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and reach both straight arms behind you.
Lift your arms slightly and open your chest without leaning back.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1788.name: 過頭直臂伸展
instructions: Stand tall and raise both straight arms overhead with your palms facing forward.
Reach up and slightly back, keeping your ribs down and your core lightly braced.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1789.name: 輔助直臂仰臥伸展(胸部)
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms stretched out straight to the sides or overhead.
Have your partner gently press your wrists or arms down toward the floor.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1790.name: 輔助俯臥拉臂胸部伸展
instructions: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides and your forehead resting on the floor.
Have your partner hold your wrists and slowly lift your arms up and back.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1791.name: 斜方肌與頸部伸展
instructions: Sit or stand tall and hold the edge of the seat or a hand behind your back to anchor one shoulder down.
Tilt your head toward the opposite shoulder until you feel a stretch along your neck.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1792.name: 環繞肩部伸展
instructions: Stand tall and bring one arm across your chest at shoulder height.
Hook it with your other forearm and pull it gently closer to your chest.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1793.name: 交叉肩部伸展
instructions: Stand tall and bring one straight arm across your chest.
Use your other hand to hold it just above the elbow and draw it closer to you.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1794.name: 向前伸展上背伸展
instructions: Stand or sit and clasp your hands or hold a support in front of you at chest height.
Round your upper back and push your hands forward while dropping your head between your arms.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1795.name: 伸展上背伸展
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and reach both arms forward at chest height.
Round your upper back and spread your shoulder blades apart as you reach farther.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1796.name: 站姿上舉背部旋轉伸展
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and reach one arm overhead.
Rotate your upper body gently away from the raised arm and reach up and over.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1797.name: 上舉背部伸展
instructions: Stand tall and reach both arms overhead with your palms facing each other.
Reach up and lean slightly back, keeping your lower back relaxed and your ribs down.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1798.name: 仰臥全身伸展
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms overhead and your legs straight.
Reach your fingertips up and your toes down, as if you want to get taller.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1799.name: 雙手懸垂背部伸展(使用訓練牆梯)
instructions: Grip a wall bar overhead with both hands and walk your feet out slightly.
Let your body hang and sink your hips back, relaxing your upper back and shoulders.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1800.name: 滑輪懸吊背部伸展
instructions: Hold the cable attachment or handles with both hands at about chest height.
Lean back with straight arms and sit your hips back until you feel your back lengthen.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1801.name: 單臂背闊肌伸展
instructions: Stand tall and hold a pole or frame with one hand above head height.
Lean away from the arm and sit your hips slightly back to feel a stretch along your side.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1802.name: 側向背闊肌伸展
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and raise one arm overhead.
Lean to the opposite side from the raised arm, reaching over without twisting.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1803.name: 坐姿下背伸肌伸展
instructions: Sit on the floor or a bench with your knees slightly bent and your feet flat.
Round your back and fold your chest toward your thighs, letting your arms hang down.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1804.name: 坐姿下背伸肌與側屈肌伸展
instructions: Sit tall on a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor.
Fold forward and reach your hands toward one foot, letting your trunk bend slightly to that side.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1805.name: 坐姿彎腰背部伸展
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat and your knees apart.
Bend forward from your hips and let your head and arms hang between your knees.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1806.name: 坐姿側伸展
instructions: Sit tall with your legs crossed or your feet flat and place one hand on the floor beside you.
Reach your other arm up and over your head toward the side, lengthening along your flank.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1807.name: 盤腿坐姿前伸展
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs crossed and your back tall.
Walk your hands forward along the floor and fold from your hips until you feel a stretch.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1808.name: 仰躺下背伸肌伸展
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Draw both knees toward your chest and hold them with your hands.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1809.name: 坐姿雙腳併攏前伸展
instructions: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together and your knees falling out.
Hold your feet and fold forward from your hips, keeping your spine long.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1810.name: 仰臥膝碰胸伸展
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs extended.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands while the other leg stays flat.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1811.name: 站姿膝碰胸伸展
instructions: Stand tall, using a wall for balance if needed.
Lift one knee and pull it gently toward your chest with both hands.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1812.name: 跪姿背部旋轉伸展
instructions: Start on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Place one hand behind your head and rotate your elbow up toward the ceiling.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1813.name: 站姿背部旋轉伸展
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms at chest height.
Rotate your upper body to one side, keeping your hips facing forward.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1814.name: 肘屈肌伸展
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with your palm facing up.
Use your other hand to gently press the fingers down and back until you feel the stretch.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1815.name: 前臂旋前肌伸展
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with your elbow straight and palm down.
Use your other hand to rotate the palm outward until you feel a stretch along your forearm.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1816.name: 垂直伸展雙臂
instructions: Stand tall with your arms raised straight overhead.
Press your arms back slightly and reach long through your fingertips.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1817.name: 支撐物上手臂伸展
instructions: Place your hands or forearms on a bench or other stable support behind you.
Lower your body slightly and lean away until you feel a stretch in the front of your arms.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1818.name: 旋後握槓懸吊伸展
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Let your body hang with your arms straight, relaxing your shoulders downward.
Take as much weight through your legs as you need to stay comfortable.
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1819.name: 滑輪機旋後懸吊伸展
instructions: Hold a pulley handle with an underhand grip and your arm straight.
Lean your body weight back gently until you feel a stretch in the biceps and forearm.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1820.name: EZ槓牧師椅手臂伸展
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench and rest your upper arms on the pad, holding an EZ bar.
Let the bar lower under control until your arms are fully extended, using a light load.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1821.name: 肘伸展與前臂旋後旋前伸展
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with your elbow straight.
Slowly rotate your palm up and down and let your other hand add gentle pressure at each end.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1826.name: 手指屈肌伸展
instructions: Extend one arm forward with your palm facing up or out.
Use your other hand to gently pull your fingers and palm back toward you.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1827.name: 手指伸肌伸展
instructions: Extend one arm forward with your palm facing down and your wrist relaxed.
Use your other hand to gently press your fingers and hand down toward you.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1828.name: 向下伸手三頭肌伸展
instructions: Raise one arm overhead, bend the elbow and drop your hand behind your head.
Use your other hand to press your elbow gently back and down.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1829.name: 靠牆三頭肌伸展
instructions: Stand next to a wall and place your bent elbow on it above head height.
Lean your body forward and down until you feel the stretch along the back of your upper arm.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1830.name: 肘伸肌肘肌伸展
instructions: Extend one arm forward and bend the elbow fully with your palm down.
Use your other hand to press your forearm toward your upper arm, then rotate it gently.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1831.name: 頸部旋轉伸展
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly turn your head to one side, then to the other, as far as is comfortable.
Keep your chin level and avoid pushing into any pain.
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1832.name: 頸部斜向屈曲伸展
instructions: Sit tall and gently turn your head about 45 degrees to one side.
Drop your chin diagonally toward your chest, using your hand for light added pressure.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1833.name: 頸部後伸伸展
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tilt your head back to look up at the ceiling, keeping your jaw relaxed.
肩膀放鬆，呼吸緩慢而均勻。
保持 20-30 秒，不要彈動。
輕輕放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1834.name: 頸部前引伸展
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Keep your eyes level and slide your chin and head straight forward.
Stop when you feel a stretch at the back of the neck.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
Draw your head back to neutral and relax.

1835.name: 坐姿頸部屈曲伸展
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your hands resting in your lap.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Let the weight of your head do the work, without forcing it.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
Lift your head back to neutral slowly.

1836.name: 頸部前屈伸展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with your shoulders down.
Place both hands lightly behind your head.
Let your elbows drop forward and ease your head toward your chest.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
Release your hands and return to neutral.

1837.name: 頸伸肌伸展
instructions: Sit tall with your back straight.
Tuck your chin toward your chest.
Rest one hand on the back of your head and add very light pressure down.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
Remove your hand and lift your head slowly.

1838.name: 頸伸肌與旋轉伸展
instructions: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Turn your head about 45 degrees to one side.
Rest a hand on the back of your head and ease your nose toward your armpit.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1839.name: 頸屈肌伸展
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your chin and slowly tilt your head back.
Keep the movement small and comfortable.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
Return your head to neutral.

1840.name: 頸屈肌與旋轉伸展
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders down.
Turn your head slightly to one side.
Tilt your chin up and back until you feel a stretch along the front of your neck.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1841.name: 仰臥頸伸肌伸展
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Clasp your hands behind your head.
Gently lift your head and ease your chin toward your chest.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
Lower your head back down slowly.

1842.name: 仰臥頸部後伸伸展
instructions: Lie on your back with your head near the edge of a bench or bed, shoulders supported.
Slowly let your head relax backward past the edge.
Support it with your hands if it feels heavy.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
Use your hands to lift your head back up carefully.

1843.name: 輔助頸部旋轉伸展
instructions: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Turn your head to one side as far as is comfortable.
Place one hand on your chin and the other on the back of your head.
Add light pressure to deepen the turn.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1844.name: 頸部後伸與側傾伸展
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders down.
Tilt your head back slightly.
Lower one ear toward the same shoulder.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1848.name: 小腿靜態伸展
instructions: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and your heel on the floor.
Keep your back leg straight and lean toward the wall.
Press your back heel down until you feel a stretch in the calf.
Keep your hips square and your toes pointing forward.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換腿。

1856.name: 槓桿式仰臥抬腿(屈膝)
instructions: Lie back on the machine and grip the handles.
Bend your knees and place your legs under the pads.
Curl your knees up toward your chest.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower slowly until you feel tension, then repeat.

1858.name: 槓桿式下斜仰臥起坐
instructions: Lie back on the decline seat and hook your feet under the pads.
Cross your arms or hold the handles.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
在頂部收緊腹部。
Lower back slowly under control.

1859.name: 滑輪跪姿三頭伸展 v. 2
instructions: Attach a rope or bar to a high pulley and kneel facing away.
Hold it overhead with your elbows bent behind your head.
Keep your upper arms still and straighten your elbows.
Squeeze your triceps at full extension.
慢慢回到起始位置。

1861.name: 滑輪多功能V型把手彎舉
instructions: Attach a multipurpose V bar to a low pulley and grip it with palms up.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
在頂部夾緊二頭肌。
Lower slowly without letting your elbows drift.

1862.name: 槓桿式滑輪肩推
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Sit back with your feet flat and grip the handles.
Press upward until your arms are nearly straight.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower slowly back to the start.

1864.name: 加強下斜仰臥起坐
instructions: Set a decline bench to a steep angle and hook your feet under the pads.
Lie back and cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting.
在頂部收緊腹部。
Lower slowly back down.

1867.name: 槓桿式坐姿髖內收 v. 2

1868.name: 槓鈴低槓深蹲(使用深蹲架)

1869.name: 槓桿式坐姿髖外展 v. 2

1870.name: 槓桿式側向下拉(片裝式)
instructions: Adjust the seat and grip the handles overhead.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull down until the handles reach chest level.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Return slowly to full stretch.

1871.name: 槓桿式三頭撐體(片裝式)
instructions: Sit upright and grip the handles beside you.
Set your elbows tight to your sides.
Press down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps.
慢慢回到起始位置。

1872.name: 槓桿式牧師椅彎舉(片裝式)
instructions: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad.
Grip the handles with your palms up.
Curl up until your biceps are fully contracted.
短暫停頓。
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

1873.name: 槓桿式腿伸展(片裝式)
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and your shins behind the roller.
Hold the handles.
Extend your knees until your legs are straight.
Squeeze your quads at the top.
控制着慢慢放下。

1874.name: 槓桿式交替腿伸展(片裝式)

1875.name: 槓桿式深蹲(片裝式)
instructions: Step under the shoulder pads and set your feet shoulder width.
Release the safeties and stand tall.
Sit down and back until your thighs are parallel.
腳後跟發力站起。
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.

1876.name: 槓桿式側平舉(片裝式)
instructions: Adjust the seat and place your arms against the pads.
Sit upright.
Raise your arms out to the sides until about shoulder height.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly to the start.

1877.name: 站姿髖外推內收肌伸展
instructions: Stand tall with your feet wider than hip width.
Shift your weight onto one leg and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight, foot flat.
Push your hip out until you feel a stretch in the inner thigh.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1878.name: 站姿交叉腿外展肌伸展
instructions: Stand tall, next to a wall if you need balance.
Cross one leg behind the other.
Lean your hips toward the side of your back leg.
Feel the stretch along the outer hip.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1879.name: 站姿腿擱髖部伸展
instructions: Stand facing a bench or step.
Place one heel on it with the knee slightly bent.
Keep your chest tall and hinge forward at the hips.
Feel the stretch in the hip and glute.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1880.name: 傾斜外展肌伸展
instructions: Stand next to a wall and lean on it with one hand.
Cross your outer leg behind the inner one.
Lean your hips toward the wall.
Keep both feet flat.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1881.name: 站姿腿下穿外展肌伸展
instructions: Stand tall near a support.
Pass one leg behind and under the other.
Push your hips gently to the side of the back leg.
上身保持挺直。
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1882.name: 仰臥外展肌伸展
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bring one knee up and across your body.
Use the opposite hand to ease it toward the floor.
Keep your shoulders flat on the ground.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1883.name: 健身球仰臥外展肌伸展
instructions: Lie on your back with your calves resting on a stability ball.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Roll the ball gently to bring your legs toward your chest.
Feel the stretch in the outer hip.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1884.name: 仰臥腿懸掛外展肌伸展
instructions: Lie on your back on a bench.
Cross one leg over your body and let it hang off the side.
Keep your shoulders flat.
Let gravity lower the leg slowly.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1885.name: 站姿腳尖上翹跟腱伸展
instructions: Stand facing a wall with one foot forward.
Place the ball of the forward foot against the wall, heel on the floor.
Lean your hips toward the wall.
Feel the stretch in the calf and Achilles.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1886.name: 單腳墊高落跟跟腱伸展
instructions: Stand on a step with the ball of one foot on the edge.
Hold a rail for balance.
Lower your heel slowly below the step.
Keep the knee straight for the calf, then slightly bent for the soleus.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1887.name: 站姿後腳跟跟腱伸展
instructions: Stand facing a wall and step one foot back.
Keep the back leg straight and the heel down.
Bend your front knee and lean forward.
Feel the stretch in the back calf.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1888.name: 站姿跟腱伸展
instructions: Stand near a wall or support.
Step one foot back with the heel down.
Slightly bend the back knee to target the lower Achilles.
Keep your back foot pointing forward.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1889.name: 坐姿拉腳尖跟腱伸展
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight.
Loop a towel around the ball of your foot or grip your toes.
Pull your toes toward your shin.
Keep your knee straight.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1890.name: 蹲姿後腳跟跟腱伸展
instructions: Crouch down with your hands on the floor for balance.
Extend one leg back with the heel down.
Press the heel toward the floor.
Keep your chest lifted.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1891.name: 腳趾深蹲伸展
instructions: Kneel on a mat with your toes tucked under.
Sit back onto your heels slowly.
Rest your hands on your thighs.
Ease off if the stretch is too sharp.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
Release and shake out your feet.

1892.name: 跪姿腳跟下壓跟腱伸展
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Lean forward, keeping your front heel on the floor.
Press your front knee over your toes.
Feel the stretch behind the ankle.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1893.name: 深蹲跟腱伸展
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Sink into a deep squat with your heels down.
Hold on to a support if needed.
Gently shift your weight forward over your toes.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
Stand up slowly.

1894.name: 站姿雙膝外開內收肌伸展

1895.name: 站姿髖旋轉伸展
instructions: Stand tall near a support.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Sit your hips back as if sitting into a chair.
Feel the stretch in the hip of the crossed leg.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1896.name: 站姿抬腿髖內收肌伸展
instructions: Stand tall and place one foot on a bench or raised surface to the side.
Keep your standing leg straight and your toes forward.
Shift your weight toward the raised leg side until you feel a stretch.
Keep your chest upright and your hips square.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換腿。

1897.name: 站姿腿上抬內收肌伸展
instructions: Stand next to a bench or low support.
Place one foot on it with the leg out to the side.
Keep your hips square.
Shift your weight toward the raised leg.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1898.name: 跪姿腿外伸內收肌伸展
instructions: Kneel on all fours with your knees under your hips.
Extend one leg out to the side with the foot flat.
Sit your hips back toward the opposite heel.
Keep your back straight and your extended leg straight.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換腿。

1899.name: 側弓步內收肌伸展
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat.
Keep your chest tall.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1900.name: 站姿屈膝髖內收肌伸展
instructions: Stand with your feet wide.
Bend one knee and lower into that side.
Keep your other leg straight.
Push the bent knee gently out with your hand.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1901.name: 跪姿俯身內收肌伸展
instructions: Kneel on a mat, then lower your chest and forearms to the floor.
Slide your knees wide apart and sink your hips back toward your heels until you feel the inner thighs stretch.
Keep your breathing slow and stay relaxed, without bouncing.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1902.name: 坐姿寬腿內收肌伸展
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide.
Keep your knees pointing up.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long spine.
Walk your hands forward until you feel the stretch.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
Come up slowly.

1903.name: 髖外展前屈伸展
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front of you.
Place the other leg to the side.
Lean your torso forward over the front shin.
Keep your hips grounded.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1904.name: 站姿寬腿內收肌伸展
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart, toes pointing slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee while the other leg stays straight, and feel the inner thigh stretch.
Keep your chest up and the straight leg's foot flat on the floor.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1905.name: 仰臥靠牆伸展
instructions: Lie on your back with your hips close to a wall.
Rest your legs straight up the wall.
Let your legs fall slowly out to the sides.
Relax and let gravity do the work.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
Bring your legs together to finish.

1906.name: 單腿外展屈曲伸展
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bend one knee, let it fall out to the side and, if needed, ease it down with your hand until the inner thigh stretches.
Keep your lower back and the opposite hip flat on the floor.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1907.name: 輔助仰臥內收肌伸展
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Have your partner lift one leg slightly and move it out to the side.
髖部保持水平。
Tell your partner to stop at a comfortable stretch.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1908.name: 站姿腳尖下壓腿後肌伸展
instructions: Stand with one heel on the floor in front of you.
Point your toes down.
Hinge forward from the hips with a flat back.
Keep the front leg nearly straight.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
換邊並重復。

1909.name: 站姿腳尖上翹腿後肌伸展
instructions: Stand tall and step one foot forward, resting the heel on the floor with the toes pulled up.
Keep the front leg straight and the back knee slightly bent.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel a pull behind the thigh.
Keep your chest open and avoid rounding your spine.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1910.name: 站姿抬腿腿後肌伸展
instructions: Stand facing a low support and place one heel on it with the leg straight.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long back until you feel the back of the thigh stretch.
Keep your toes pointing up and your standing knee soft.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1911.name: 抬腿膝屈肌伸展
instructions: Place one heel on a low bench or step in front of you with the leg straight.
Stand tall with the standing knee soft.
Hinge forward from the hips, keeping your back flat, until you feel a stretch behind the raised thigh.
Keep your toes pointing up and breathe slowly.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1912.name: 站姿高抬腿屈膝腿後肌伸展
instructions: Stand tall and place one heel on a high support with the knee slightly bent.
Lean your chest toward your thigh with a flat back until you feel the stretch behind the thigh.
Straighten the knee a little more as you get looser.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1913.name: 跪姿腳尖上翹腿後肌伸展
instructions: Kneel on one knee and extend the other leg in front, heel on the floor and toes pulled up.
Place your hands on the floor or the front thigh for support.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel a pull behind the extended leg.
Keep the extended knee straight but not locked.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1914.name: 坐姿膝屈肌與髖內收肌伸展

1915.name: 坐姿膝屈肌伸展
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight out in front of you.
Reach toward your toes with a long back until you feel the back of the thigh stretch.
Keep your knee straight but not locked, and avoid rounding your back too much.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1916.name: 站姿向下伸手腿後肌伸展
instructions: Stand with your feet hip width apart.
Hinge at the hips and reach your hands down toward your shins or toes until you feel the back of the thighs stretch.
Let your head and neck hang relaxed and keep a slight bend in the knees.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1917.name: 站姿向下伸手交叉腿腿後肌伸展
instructions: Stand tall and cross one foot over the other.
Hinge forward at the hips and reach toward the floor until the back of the thighs stretch.
Keep both legs fairly straight and let your head hang relaxed.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1918.name: 坐姿髖外旋肌與髖伸肌伸展
instructions: Sit upright on the floor or a chair and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Gently press the raised knee down and lean your chest forward with a long back until the buttock stretches.
Keep your spine long instead of collapsing forward.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1919.name: 坐姿髖部伸展(對側腿從後方)
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front of you and the other leg bent behind.
Lean your chest forward over the front shin until you feel the stretch deep in the hip and buttock.
Keep both sit bones as level as you can.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1920.name: 蹠屈伸展
instructions: Sit on a chair or the floor with one leg extended.
Point your toes away from you as far as is comfortable.
Gently press the top of the foot with your hand for a little extra stretch.
Keep the movement slow and avoid forcing the ankle.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1921.name: 平躺膝屈肌伸展
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Lift one leg toward the ceiling, holding behind the thigh or calf.
Keep the knee as straight as is comfortable and the other leg flat on the floor.
Gently draw the leg toward you until you feel a pull behind the thigh.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1922.name: 平躺膝屈肌伸展(毛巾)
instructions: Lie on your back and loop a towel around the ball of one foot.
Raise that leg toward the ceiling, holding both ends of the towel.
Keep the knee nearly straight and the other leg flat on the floor.
Gently pull the towel until you feel a stretch behind the thigh.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1923.name: 輔助仰臥腿後肌伸展
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and relax completely.
Have a partner lift one leg by the heel, keeping the knee straight.
Tell your partner to stop when you feel a pull behind the thigh.
Keep your other leg and lower back flat on the floor.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換腿。

1924.name: 站姿腳尖上翹小腿伸展
instructions: Stand facing a wall or step and place the ball of one foot against it with the heel on the floor.
Keep the leg straight.
Lean your hips gently toward the wall until you feel a stretch in the calf.
Keep your heel down and your back tall.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1925.name: 單腳墊高落跟小腿伸展
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step with the ball of one foot on it and hold a rail for balance.
Slowly lower that heel below the step until you feel the calf stretch.
Keep the knee straight to hit the calf, then bend it slightly to reach deeper into the soleus.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1926.name: 蹠屈肌與足外翻肌伸展
instructions: Sit with one leg extended and hold the foot with your hand.
Point the foot down and turn the sole slightly outward.
Gently press the foot until you feel a stretch along the front and outer ankle.
Move slowly and stop at a mild stretch.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1927.name: 蹠屈肌與足內翻肌伸展
instructions: Sit with one leg extended and hold the foot with your hand.
Point the foot down and turn the sole slightly inward.
Gently press the foot until you feel a stretch along the front and inner ankle.
Move slowly and stop at a mild stretch.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1928.name: 牆梯脛部屈曲伸展
instructions: Stand facing the wall bars and place the front of one foot against a low bar.
Lean your body forward and press your heel toward the floor until the lower leg stretches.
Hold the bars with your hands to stay balanced.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1929.name: 半屈膝脛部伸展
instructions: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and the toes pressed against the wall or floor.
Bend the knee of the stretching leg slightly.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch low in the calf.
Keep the heel on the floor.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1930.name: 蹲姿後腳跟小腿伸展
instructions: Crouch down with your feet flat and hands on the floor for balance.
Shift one heel backward and press it toward the floor.
Keep the other leg bent and supporting your weight.
Feel the stretch in the calf of the pressing leg.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1931.name: 髖膝屈曲深蹲伸展
instructions: Stand with your feet a little wider than your shoulders and toes turned slightly out.
Sink down into a deep squat and press your elbows against your inner knees to open the hips.
Keep your heels on the floor and your chest tall.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1932.name: 輔助仰臥髖部伸展
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and relax.
Have a partner bring one knee slowly toward your chest.
Tell them to stop when you feel a stretch in the hip and buttock.
Keep the other leg flat on the floor.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換腿。

1933.name: 坐姿抬膝旋轉伸展
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and the other knee bent, foot flat on the floor.
Cross the bent leg over the straight one, and rotate your torso toward the raised knee, hugging it with the opposite arm.
Sit tall and twist from the middle of your back.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1934.name: 坐姿抬膝伸直旋轉伸展
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg extended and the other knee bent and crossed over it.
Rotate your torso toward the bent knee, using the opposite elbow to guide it, until the hip stretches.
Keep your spine long and look over your back shoulder.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1935.name: 仰臥交叉膝上拉伸展
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the knee of the lower leg or behind the thigh and pull it up toward your chest.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1936.name: 仰臥交叉膝下拉伸展
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Use your hand to guide the crossed knee gently down and across your body.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1937.name: 坐姿屈膝抱胸臀部伸展
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs out in front.
Bend one knee, hold it with both hands and gently pull it toward your chest.
Keep your back tall and avoid rounding it as you pull.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1938.name: 坐姿微屈腿髖部伸展
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg slightly bent in front of you and the other leg folded comfortably.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long back until you feel the hip and buttock stretch.
Keep the knee of the front leg soft throughout.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1939.name: 平躺髖外旋肌與髖伸肌伸展
instructions: Lie on your back and bend both knees.
Bring one knee toward your chest and turn it slightly outward.
Hold the shin and ankle and draw the leg closer.
Keep your lower back resting on the floor.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1940.name: 坐姿腳抱胸臀部伸展
instructions: Sit on the floor with your back tall and legs extended.
Bend one knee and hold the foot and shin.
Pull the foot gently toward your chest while keeping your spine upright.
Feel the stretch deep in the buttock and hip.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1941.name: 站姿髖內收伸展
instructions: Stand tall and cross one leg behind the other, feet close together.
Lean your torso away from the back leg and push the hip out slightly until you feel the outer hip stretch.
Keep both feet flat on the floor.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1942.name: 站姿髂脛束伸展
instructions: Stand next to a wall or support and cross your outer leg behind the other.
Lean your hips toward the wall and reach the outer arm overhead until the outside of the hip and thigh stretches.
Keep your chest facing forward.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1943.name: 鴿式髖部伸展
instructions: Start on hands and knees and slide one knee forward behind your wrist.
Extend the other leg straight behind you.
Lower your hips toward the floor and keep your chest tall.
Fold forward over the front leg for a deeper stretch if comfortable.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1944.name: 髖外旋肌伸展
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee and pull the lower thigh toward your chest until the buttock stretches.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1946.name: 站姿收腿髖部伸展
instructions: Stand tall, holding a wall or support for balance.
Lift one knee and hold the shin and ankle with both hands.
Pull the leg gently toward your chest and slightly across the body.
Keep your standing leg soft and your back straight.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1947.name: 站姿髖外側伸展
instructions: Stand next to a wall and cross one leg behind the other.
Push your hips sideways toward the wall.
Lean your upper body away from the hips until you feel the outer hip stretch.
Keep both feet flat on the floor.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1948.name: 坐姿髖旋轉伸展
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and both feet flat.
Let both knees drop to one side and rotate your torso the opposite way until you feel the hip stretch.
Keep your hands behind you for support.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1949.name: 站姿髖屈肌伸展
instructions: Stand and step one foot forward and the other back into a staggered stance.
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift your hips slightly forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
上身保持挺直。
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1951.name: 坐姿單腿外伸展
instructions: Sit on the floor and bend one leg so the foot rests against the opposite thigh.
Lean your chest forward over the bent leg while pressing the knee toward the floor until the hip stretches.
Keep your back long.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1952.name: 輔助單腿伸展
instructions: Lie on your back and relax.
Have a partner support one leg and gently extend it.
Let the partner move the leg only to a mild stretch.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換腿。

1953.name: 支撐單腿站姿髖屈肌與膝伸肌伸展
instructions: Stand tall holding a wall or chair for support.
Bend one knee and hold the ankle behind you.
Pull the heel toward your glutes and push the hip slightly forward.
Keep your knees close together.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1954.name: 箱上股四頭肌伸展
instructions: Stand facing away from a box or bench and place the top of one foot on it behind you.
Stand tall on the front leg with a soft knee.
Tuck your pelvis and lower the hips slightly until you feel a stretch in the front of the thigh.
Hold a support for balance if needed.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1955.name: 單腿後仰股四頭肌伸展
instructions: Kneel on both knees, then lift one foot out in front so that the other leg is folded.
Place your hands behind you on the floor.
Lean back slowly until you feel a stretch in the front of the folded thigh.
Keep your hips lifted and avoid sagging into the lower back.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1956.name: 雙腿後仰股四頭肌伸展

1957.name: 站姿脛前伸展
instructions: Stand tall and hold a wall for balance.
Place the top of one foot on the floor behind you with the toes curled under.
Gently press the foot down by bending the standing knee.
Feel the stretch along the front of the shin and ankle.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1958.name: 站姿腳趾伸肌伸展
instructions: Stand next to a support and place the top of one foot on the floor behind you with the toes curled under.
Gently bend your standing knee and press the toes down until you feel the stretch on top of the foot and shin.
Keep the pressure light and controlled.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1959.name: 抬腳脛前伸展
instructions: Stand next to a wall and lift one foot behind you onto a low support with the top of the foot down.
Keep your torso upright and your standing leg soft.
Press your hips forward gently until you feel the shin stretch.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1960.name: 雙跪姿脛前伸展
instructions: Kneel on a mat with your feet pointing straight back and the tops of the feet on the floor.
Slowly sit back toward your heels until you feel the shins and ankles stretch.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you to control the pressure.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1962.name: 坐姿腳趾伸肌伸展
instructions: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the top of the foot and toes with your hand.
Gently curl the toes and foot downward until you feel a stretch on the top.
Keep the motion gentle.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1963.name: 坐姿腳趾伸肌與足外翻肌伸展
instructions: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the top of the foot and toes with your hand.
Curl the toes down and turn the sole gently outward.
Feel the stretch along the top and outer edge of the foot.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1964.name: 坐姿腳趾伸肌與足內翻肌伸展
instructions: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the top of the foot and toes with your hand.
Curl the toes down and turn the sole gently inward.
Feel the stretch along the top and inner edge of the foot.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1965.name: 坐姿腳趾屈肌伸展
instructions: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the toes with your hand.
Gently pull the toes back toward your shin.
Feel the stretch along the sole of the foot.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1966.name: 坐姿腳趾屈肌與足外翻肌伸展
instructions: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the toes with your hand.
Pull the toes back toward your shin and turn the sole gently outward.
Feel the stretch along the sole and inner edge of the foot.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1967.name: 坐姿腳趾屈肌與足內翻肌伸展
instructions: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the toes with your hand.
Pull the toes back toward your shin and turn the sole gently inward.
Feel the stretch along the sole and outer edge of the foot.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1968.name: 站姿腳趾屈肌伸展
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place the toes of one foot on it with the heel on the floor.
Lean forward gently until you feel the stretch along the bottom of the foot and into the calf.
Keep your heel firmly on the floor.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1970.name: 站姿直立肩部伸展
instructions: 站直，雙腳分開與髖同寬。
Clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and lift them gently away from your body.
Keep your chest open and your neck relaxed.

1971.name: 反向肩部伸展
instructions: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and lift your hands up and away from your body until the shoulders and chest stretch.
Keep your chest open and avoid leaning forward.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1973.name: 輔助坐姿反向肩部伸展

1975.name: 坐姿肩屈肌下壓肌後縮肌伸展

1976.name: 單臂肩屈肌伸展
instructions: Stand next to a wall or post and place one hand on it behind you with the arm straight.
Slowly turn your body away until you feel the front of the shoulder stretch.
Keep the arm straight and the shoulder relaxed.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1977.name: 背後手臂內收伸展
instructions: Stand or sit tall.
Reach one arm behind your back.
Grab that wrist with the other hand and gently pull it across your body.
Keep your shoulders level.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1978.name: 肩伸肌內收肌與後縮肌伸展
instructions: Stand tall and extend one arm behind you.
Reach across to grab it with the other hand.
Draw the arm gently back and across the body.
Keep your chest open and your shoulders down.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1979.name: 肩內收肌上提肌與前引肌伸展
instructions: Stand or sit tall and bring one arm across your chest.
Use the opposite hand to press the arm toward you until the shoulder and upper back stretch.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1980.name: 橫跨胸前肩部伸展
instructions: Stand tall and bring one arm straight across your chest.
Use your other forearm to press the arm gently toward your body.
Keep the shoulder relaxed and down.
Feel the stretch in the back of the shoulder.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1981.name: 屈臂肩部伸展
instructions: Stand tall and bring one arm across your chest with the elbow bent.
Hold the elbow with your other hand.
Gently pull the elbow toward the opposite shoulder.
Keep your shoulders level and your neck relaxed.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1982.name: 肩部旋轉伸展
instructions: Stand tall and bend one elbow to 90 degrees at your side.
Slowly rotate your forearm outward or inward, using the other hand to assist, until you feel the shoulder stretch.
Keep your elbow tucked in close to your body.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1983.name: 向上伸手肩部伸展
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Reach one or both arms overhead and up as high as you can, then press them slightly backward.
Do not arch your lower back as you reach.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1984.name: 旋轉肌袖伸展
instructions: Stand tall and bring one arm across your body at chest height.
Hold the arm just above the elbow with the other hand and draw it in until the back of the shoulder stretches.
Keep the shoulder blade down and relaxed.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1985.name: 肘外展旋轉肌伸展
instructions: Stand tall and lift one elbow out to the side, hand behind your head.
Hold the elbow with your other hand.
Gently press the elbow back and slightly down.
Feel the stretch in the shoulder.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1986.name: 手臂上舉旋轉肌伸展
instructions: Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow, palm resting on your upper back.
Use your other hand to hold the elbow.
Gently press the elbow back and down.
Keep your ribs down and chest open.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1987.name: 手臂下放旋轉肌伸展
instructions: Stand tall and place one arm behind your back, bent at the elbow.
Hold the wrist with the other hand.
Gently draw the hand away from your body and slightly up.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

1988.name: 跪姿單臂跨身伸展
instructions: Kneel on a mat and slide one arm across the floor in front of you, palm down.
Sink your chest toward the floor and keep reaching until the shoulder and upper back stretch.
Keep your hips over your knees.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1990.name: 肩外旋伸展
instructions: Stand next to a doorframe and bend your elbow to 90 degrees with your forearm on the frame.
Slowly turn your body away from the arm until you feel the front of the shoulder stretch.
Keep your elbow level with your shoulder.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

1991.name: 肩內旋伸展
instructions: Stand tall and place one hand behind your lower back with the elbow bent.
Use the other hand or a towel to gently draw the hand up your back until the back of the shoulder stretches.
Keep your shoulders level and do not twist.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

2072.name: 臀推
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and knees bent.
Plant your feet flat, hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is level.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
慢慢放下並重復。

2087.name: 肩內收肌前引肌與上提肌伸展
instructions: Stand tall and bring one arm across your chest.
Hold it with the other arm just above the elbow.
Gently pull while rounding the upper back slightly forward.
Keep your neck relaxed.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

2088.name: 毛巾背後肩部伸展
instructions: Hold a towel in one hand and raise that arm overhead, bending the elbow.
Reach the other hand up from behind your back and grab the towel.
Gently pull the towel down with the lower hand.
Keep your head upright.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

2089.name: 手指伸展
instructions: Hold one arm out in front of you with the elbow straight.
Use the other hand to gently pull the fingers back until you feel a stretch in the palm and forearm.
Keep the fingers straight and relaxed.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

2091.name: 手指向下前臂伸展
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm facing down.
Bend the wrist so the fingers point toward the floor.
Use your other hand to press the back of the hand gently toward you.
Keep your elbow straight.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

2092.name: 靠牆屈肌伸展
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place one palm on it with the fingers pointing down.
Keep your arm straight.
Slowly turn your body away until you feel the stretch in the forearm.
Keep your fingers flat on the wall.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

2093.name: 坐姿腕尺偏與屈肌伸展
instructions: Sit tall and extend one arm forward with the palm facing up.
Use the other hand to bend the wrist back and tilt it toward the thumb side until the forearm stretches.
Keep the elbow straight.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

2094.name: 拇指伸展
instructions: Extend one arm with the palm facing up.
Use your other hand to hold the thumb.
Gently pull the thumb back and away from the palm.
Stop at a mild stretch.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

2095.name: 手指伸直伸展
instructions: Extend one arm in front with the palm facing up.
Use your other hand to hold the fingers.
Gently pull the fingers back toward you.
Keep your elbow straight and the wrist relaxed.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

2096.name: 手指屈曲伸展
instructions: Hold one arm out in front of you with the palm facing down.
Use your other hand to press the fingers of the extended hand gently downward.
Keep the elbow of the extended arm straight and the shoulders relaxed.
Stop at a mild pull, never at pain.
Release and repeat on the other hand.

2097.name: 手指分開伸展
instructions: Hold one hand up in front of you with the palm facing you.
Spread your fingers as far apart as feels comfortable.
If you want more stretch, press between the fingers with your other hand.
Keep the wrist straight and the shoulder relaxed.
Relax the hand and switch sides.

2098.name: 肘伸直手內收伸展
instructions: Stand tall and extend one arm in front of you with the elbow straight.
Turn the palm so the thumb points up.
Grab the hand with your other hand and tilt it gently toward the little finger side.
Keep the elbow locked and the shoulder down.
Release and repeat on the other arm.

2099.name: 平躺髖外旋肌與髖伸肌伸展(交叉腿)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee, then pull the legs toward your chest until the buttock stretches.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

2100.name: 坐姿股四頭肌伸展
instructions: Sit sideways on a bench or sturdy seat with one leg hanging off the side.
Bend the hanging knee and bring the heel back toward your glutes.
Hold the foot or ankle with your hand and gently pull the heel closer.
Keep your torso upright and your knees close together.
Release and switch legs.

2101.name: 前交叉脛前伸展
instructions: Stand tall and cross one leg in front of the other.
Point the toes of the back foot against the floor and gently bend the knee until the shin and ankle stretch.
Hold a wall or chair for balance.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

2102.name: 坐姿拉腳尖小腿伸展
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight out in front of you.
Reach forward and grab the toes or the ball of the foot of that leg.
Gently pull the toes toward your shin while keeping the knee straight.
Sit tall and avoid rounding your back.
Release and switch legs.

2104.name: 傾斜後腳跟跟腱伸展
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it at chest height.
Step one foot back and keep that heel on the floor.
Bend both knees slightly and lean forward until you feel a pull low in the back calf.
Keep the back heel flat and the toes pointing forward.
換腿。

2105.name: 下軀幹屈肌伸展
instructions: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Press up through your hands and let your hips sink toward the floor until the lower abdomen stretches.
Keep your hips on the floor and your shoulders relaxed.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

2108.name: 站姿後仰腹部伸展
instructions: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Gently lean back and push your hips slightly forward until you feel a stretch across the stomach.
Keep your movement small and avoid cranking your lower back.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

2109.name: 跪姿腹部伸展
instructions: Kneel with your knees hip width apart and place your hands on your lower back.
Push your hips forward and lean back until the abdominal muscles stretch.
Tuck your chin a little and avoid dropping your head back.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

2110.name: 站姿腹部旋轉伸展
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed.
Place your hands on your hips or hold them out to the sides.
Keep the hips facing forward and turn your upper body slowly to one side.
Look over your shoulder and breathe steadily.
Return to the front and rotate to the other side.

2111.name: 旋轉腹部伸展
instructions: Lie face down and prop yourself up on your forearms or hands.
Keep your hips on the floor and lift your chest.
Slowly turn your head and shoulders toward one side.
Stay relaxed and avoid pushing into pain in the lower back.
Return to centre and rotate to the other side.

2113.name: 站姿下軀幹側屈肌伸展
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than hip-width.
Place one hand on your hip and reach the other arm overhead.
Push the hips slightly to the side opposite your reach.
Bend sideways from the waist without leaning forward or back.
Return to upright and switch sides.

2114.name: 坐姿下軀幹側屈肌伸展
instructions: Sit tall on the floor or a chair with your legs crossed or feet flat.
Reach one arm overhead and bend sideways away from it until you feel the side of the waist stretch.
Keep both hips grounded and avoid leaning forward.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

2116.name: 仰臥膝滾動伸展
instructions: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and knees bent.
Keep your shoulders flat on the floor.
Slowly lower both knees to one side.
Turn your head the other way if it feels comfortable.
Bring the knees back to centre and roll to the other side.

2117.name: 站姿側向伸展
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Reach one arm overhead and bend sideways away from it until you feel the side stretch.
Keep your chest open and your hips level.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

2118.name: 坐姿側向伸展
instructions: Sit tall with your legs crossed or feet flat on the floor.
Reach one arm overhead and lean sideways away from it, placing the other hand on the floor for support.
Keep both sit bones grounded.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

2119.name: 站姿側身伸展
instructions: 站直，雙腳分開與髖同寬。
Raise one arm overhead with the palm facing inward.
Lean your torso sideways away from the raised arm.
Keep both hips level and your chest facing forward.
Return upright and repeat on the other side.

2120.name: 站姿持棍側身伸展
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a stick with both hands overhead.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Lean your torso slowly to one side without twisting.
Keep your hips steady and your chest facing forward.
Return to upright and lean to the other side.

2121.name: 仰臥側彎
instructions: Lie on your back with legs together and arms stretched overhead.
Slide both feet and both hands to the same side so the body forms a gentle arc.
Keep your hips and shoulders on the floor.
Breathe slowly and relax into the curve.
Return to centre and bend to the other side.

2122.name: 輔助側彎
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and one arm overhead.
Have your partner stand behind you with a hand on your hip and a hand on your raised arm.
Lean sideways as your partner gently guides the movement.
Tell your partner to stop at a mild pull.
Return upright and switch sides.

2123.name: 輔助腹斜肌伸展
instructions: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead while your partner steadies your hips.
Lean away from the raised arm while your partner gently guides your arm.
Keep your chest open and avoid leaning forward.
Come back to upright and switch sides.

2124.name: 跪姿地面側彎
instructions: Kneel on a mat and extend one arm sideways along the floor.
Walk your hands to one side and sink your hips the other way until the side of the waist stretches.
Keep your hips over your knees.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

2125.name: 仰臥地面側伸展
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms extended overhead.
Shift your feet and your upper body to one side to form a gentle banana curve until the opposite side stretches.
Keep both shoulders and hips on the floor.
保持 20-30 秒，感受輕微牽拉而非疼痛。
慢慢放鬆並重復；如果拉伸的是單側，就換邊。

2127.name: 負重羅馬椅抬腿
instructions: Position yourself on a captain's chair with your forearms on the pads and back against the backrest.
Hold the weight securely between your feet or on your ankles.
Brace your core and raise your knees or legs up toward your chest.
Curl your pelvis slightly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.
按計劃的次數重複。

2130.name: 負重下斜捲腹
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and hook your feet under the pads.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest.
Curl your upper body up by contracting the abs.
Pause briefly at the top without pulling on your neck.
Lower back down with control.
按計劃的次數重複。

2133.name: 農夫行走
instructions: 站直，雙手各握一啞鈴垂於體側（農夫走路 Farmer's Walk）。
背部挺直，雙肩後收下沉。
步伐穩定受控向前邁步走，維持軀幹完全直立不晃動。
持續行走至指定距離或時間。
停步並小心將啞鈴放回地面。

2135.name: 負重前棒式
instructions: 俯臥趴在地上。
前臂貼地，手肘正對肩膀下方。
雙腿向後伸直，腳尖點地。
啟動核心將身體撐離地面（肘棒式）。
身體從頭到腳跟保持成一直線。
維持此姿勢至指定時間。
放鬆降回地面。
重複所需次數。

2136.name: 啞鈴古巴推舉 v. 2
instructions: 雙腳與肩同寬站立，雙手各握一啞鈴置於肩前，手腕旋轉掌心朝向自己。
核心收緊背打直，將啞鈴向上推舉過頭頂，同時手腕向外旋轉（阿諾推舉 Arnold Press）。
頂端手臂打直時掌心朝前。
慢慢將啞鈴降回肩部，同時手腕旋轉回掌心朝向自己。
重複所需次數。

2137.name: 啞鈴阿諾推舉
instructions: 坐在有靠背的重訓椅上，手持啞鈴於肩前，手肘彎曲，掌心朝向自己。
向上推舉啞鈴，手臂完全伸直，推舉過程中旋轉手腕使掌心轉向正前方。
在最高點稍作停頓，慢慢將啞鈴放回肩部並將手腕轉回原位。
重複所需次數。

2138.name: 固定式腳踏車跑 v. 3
instructions: 調整飛輪車或健身車的座椅高度與把手。
腳掌踏入踏板，拉緊腳套固定。
以舒適踩踏節奏開始熱身踩踏。
維持穩定踏頻，視訓練需求增加阻力。
收緊核心維持軀幹穩定與良好騎姿。
踩踏至指定時間。
逐漸降低阻力與踏頻緩衝，直至完全停止。
下車進行腿部伸展放鬆。

2139.name: 手搖車
instructions: 調整手搖自行車（手臂測力計）的座椅高度與把手距離。
坐直，雙腳踩實地面。
雙手握住手柄，雙臂呈 90 度。
以受控的旋轉動作推拉把手開始手搖踩踏。
持續進行至指定時間或圈數。

2141.name: 橢圓機步行
instructions: 調整橢圓機的阻力與坡度至預設值。
踩上踏板，雙手握緊活動手柄。
雙腳向下踩踏，同時雙手交替推拉握把。
維持手腳協調交替，模擬自然跑步滑行動作。
全程保持均勻節奏與核心收緊。
持續進行有氧訓練至指定時間。
結束前逐步調低阻力與步頻以緩和心率。

2142.name: 滑雪測功儀
instructions: 調整機台座椅高度與踏板。
正握抓把手，掌心朝下。
坐直，雙腳踩在腳踏板上。
雙臂伸展於身前，手肘微屈。
收緊三頭肌將把手向下推向大腿。
在底部停頓片刻，慢慢送回。
重複所需次數。

2143.name: 啞鈴站姿環繞世界
instructions: 雙腳分開與肩同寬站立，雙手各持一啞鈴。
手臂向兩側平舉與肩同高，掌心朝下。
手臂維持打直，以肩膀為軸心畫圓旋轉，將啞鈴經身前旋轉至頭頂。
持續旋轉回到起始位置。
重複所需次數。

2144.name: 滑輪坐姿胸推
instructions: 調整滑輪推胸機座椅高度與把手位置。
背靠椅背坐直，雙腳踩實地面。
正握握把於肩部高度。
向前推動把手充分伸展雙臂。
頂峰停頓片刻，慢慢降回把手。
重複所需次數。

2147.name: 槓桿式彈力帶臀推
instructions: Sit on the machine with your upper back on the pad and a band around your thighs above the knees.
Place your feet flat and push your knees gently out against the band.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso and thighs are in line.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
Lower slowly and repeat, keeping the knees pressed out.

2151.name: 彈力帶外旋
instructions: Anchor a band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the hand farther from the anchor.
Tuck your elbow against your side with the elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your belly.
慢慢回到起始位置。
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

2152.name: 彈力帶前棒式抬腿後踢

2155.name: 彈力帶跪姿側棒式
instructions: Wrap a band around your thighs and lie on one side with your knees bent.
Place your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from knees to head.
Push your top knee gently out against the band.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

2157.name: 彈力帶仰臥抬腿
instructions: Place a band around your thighs or ankles and lie on your side with your legs straight.
Rest your head on your arm and keep your hips stacked.
Raise the top leg against the band without rolling backward.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

2159.name: 彈力帶單腿臀橋
instructions: Lie on your back with a loop band above your knees and knees bent.
Lift one foot off the floor and extend that leg.
Drive through the other heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glutes at the top and keep the hips level.
控制着慢慢放下。
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

2163.name: 彈力帶反向背部伸展
instructions: Lie face down over a bench or box with a band anchored near your feet.
Hold the bench edge and loop the band around your ankles.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your legs until they are in line with your body.
Avoid swinging or arching the lower back.
Lower the legs slowly.
按計劃的次數重複。

2164.name: 彈力帶側棒式
instructions: Place a band around your thighs and lie on one side with your legs straight.
Put your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Press your top leg gently up against the band.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

2186.name: EZ槓下斜三頭伸展
instructions: 躺在下斜長凳上，頭低腳高，雙腳固定。
正握抓住 EZ 槓，雙手與肩同寬。
雙臂完全伸展，手肘貼近頭部。
手肘彎曲將槓鈴慢慢放低至額頭上方。
停頓片刻，手臂伸展推回起始位置。
重複所需次數。

2187.name: 槓鈴反握窄握臥推
instructions: 平躺在平凳上，雙腳踩實，背部緊貼椅面。
反握抓住槓鈴，握距與肩同寬。
起槓將槓鈴垂直推在胸口正上方。
慢慢將槓鈴降向胸部，手肘貼近身體。
槓鈴接近胸部時停頓片刻。
發力推回起始位置，雙臂伸展。
重複所需次數。

2188.name: 啞鈴坐姿三頭伸展
instructions: 坐在重訓椅上，背部打直，雙腳踩實。
雙手合握一個啞鈴，高舉過頭頂。
手肘彎曲將啞鈴放低至後頸，上手臂貼近耳側。
停頓片刻，手臂伸展推回原位。
重複所需次數。

2189.name: 雙啞鈴坐姿三頭伸展
instructions: 坐在重訓椅上，背部挺直，雙腳平踩。
雙手正握啞鈴高舉過頭。
手肘彎曲將啞鈴放至腦後，上手臂固定貼近耳側。
三頭肌發力將啞鈴推回頭頂。
重複所需次數。

2198.name: 槓桿式三頭伸展 v. 3
instructions: Adjust the seat and sit with your upper arms on the pad.
Grip the handles with your elbows bent.
Press down by straightening your elbows.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start without lifting your shoulders.
按計劃的次數重複。

2202.name: 滾筒髖部伸展
instructions: 坐在地上，雙腿向前伸展。
將滾筒置於臀部下方。
雙手撐在身後地面支撐體重。
在滾筒上前後滾動按摩臀部肌肉，感受深層筋膜放鬆。
痛點處稍作停留加強按壓。
慢慢滾動維持均勻呼吸。
重複所需時間。

2203.name: 滾筒坐姿肩屈肌下壓肌後縮肌
instructions: 坐在平坦地面上，雙腿向前伸直。
雙手握住健腹輪手柄，置於大腿上。
稍微前傾，推動健腹輪向前滾出，雙臂伸展。
稍作停頓，然後手臂與核心發力將健腹輪拉回大腿處。
重複所需次數。

2204.name: 滾筒身體鋸
instructions: 從棒式姿勢開始，前臂靠在滾筒上，身體成一直線。
啟動核心慢慢向前滾動滾筒，在受控範圍內盡可能向前伸展身軀。
在最遠延伸點停頓片刻，核心發力將滾筒拉回起始位置。
重複所需次數。

2205.name: 滾筒髖部背闊肌伸展
instructions: 雙膝跪地，將滾筒置於大腿前側髖部下方。
雙手撐地支撐體重。
前後滾動放鬆髖屈肌與股四頭肌。
維持深層拉伸數秒後放鬆。
重複所需次數。

2206.name: 滾筒反向捲腹
instructions: 平躺在地上，雙臂伸過頭頂，雙腿向前伸直。
雙腳夾住滾筒。
收緊腹肌將雙腿抬離地面，屈膝將滾筒帶向胸前。
頂峰停頓片刻，慢慢伸展雙腿將滾筒推離身體。
重複所需次數。

2207.name: 滾筒側向背闊肌伸展
instructions: 雙腳與肩同寬站立，雙手在身前持滾輪。
屈膝屈髖前傾，背部維持打直。
手臂向前伸展推動滾輪向前，感受背闊肌拉伸。
保持拉伸數秒，緩慢拉回。
重複所需次數。

2208.name: 滾筒背部伸展
instructions: 坐在地上，雙腿向前伸展。
將滾筒橫放在下背部下方。
慢慢向後躺倒，雙腳推地讓滾筒沿著背部向上滾動。
持續滾動至上背部與肩胛骨處。
停頓片刻，緩緩滾回。
重複所需次數。

2209.name: 滾筒坐姿單腿肩屈肌下壓肌後縮肌
instructions: 坐在平坦地面上，雙腿向前伸直。
雙手正握滾輪手柄置於大腿前。
微向後傾收緊核心。
雙臂伸直將滾輪抬高至肩部高度。
慢慢放回大腿前。
重複所需次數。

2234.name: 啞鈴站姿側平舉
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and brace your core.
Raise both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows and avoid shrugging.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower slowly to the start and repeat.

2265.name: 槓桿式坐姿划船 v. 2
instructions: Adjust the seat and chest pad, then sit with your chest against the pad.
Grip the handles with arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your torso by driving the elbows back.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Return slowly until your arms are straight again.
按計劃的次數重複。

2266.name: 槓桿式背部伸展 v. 2
instructions: Adjust the machine and sit with your back against the pad.
Cross your arms or hold the handles as the machine allows.
Push back by extending at the hips and lower back.
Stop when your torso is in a neutral, tall position.
慢慢回到起始位置。
按計劃的次數重複。

2267.name: 槓桿式坐姿腿推舉
instructions: Adjust the seat and sit with your back flat against the pad.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder-width apart.
Push through your heels until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees.
Bend your knees slowly to return.
按計劃的次數重複。

2268.name: 槓桿式坐姿捲腹(手靠墊)
instructions: Sit on the machine and adjust the seat so your hands reach the pad.
Place your hands on the pads and brace your feet.
Curl your torso forward by contracting your abs.
Pause briefly at the bottom.
Return slowly to the upright start.
按計劃的次數重複。

2271.name: 左勾拳 拳擊
instructions: 雙腳分開與肩同寬站立，膝蓋微彎採格鬥站姿。
左手抬起護頭，右手護於下巴。
轉動髖部以左腳為軸心旋轉，同時向前打出左直拳。
旋轉軀幹，運用核心與下盤力量爆發出拳。
快速將手臂收回防守姿勢，重複所需次數。

2276.name: 槓桿式仰臥捲腹
instructions: Lie back on the machine and place your hands or arms as indicated.
Hook your feet or grip the handles for stability.
Curl your torso up by contracting your abs.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower slowly back to the start.
按計劃的次數重複。

2277.name: 槓桿式胸推 v. 4
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height.
Sit back with your shoulder blades pulled together.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Do not lock your elbows.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
按計劃的次數重複。

2278.name: 槓桿式下斜胸推 v. 2
instructions: Adjust the seat and sit with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with elbows bent.
Press forward and slightly downward until your arms are almost straight.
Keep your shoulders down and your chest up.
Return slowly under control.
按計劃的次數重複。

2282.name: 槓桿式頸部後伸(片裝式)
instructions: Set the weight light and adjust the pad to rest on the back of your head.
Sit tall and bring your chin slightly down.
Press your head back against the pad slowly.
Move only through a comfortable range.
慢慢回到起始位置。
Repeat for the planned reps with control.

2283.name: 槓桿式頸部左側屈(片裝式)

2284.name: 槓桿式頸部右側屈(片裝式)

2285.name: 槓桿式仰臥拉舉
instructions: 調整機械滑輪下拉機的座椅與把手。
坐上機台，背靠支撐墊，正握抓住把手。
手臂微屈，核心收緊。
慢慢將把手拉向胸前，擠壓背闊肌。
在頂峰收縮處停頓片刻，緩緩回到原位。
重複所需次數。

2286.name: 槓桿式髖伸展 v. 2
instructions: 調整機台以符合身形，背靠椅背坐好。
雙腳踩在腳踏板上，握緊把手固定。
啟動臀肌與腿後肌群，踩動踏板蹬展髖部向後推。
頂端停留片刻，慢慢收回雙腿。
重複所需次數。

2287.name: 槓桿式交替腿推舉
instructions: 調整推腿機的座椅與踏板。
背靠椅背坐穩，雙腳踩在踏板上。
雙手握住兩側把手維持穩定。
單腳用力推蹬踏板，直到腿部接近打直（不鎖死）。
停頓片刻，慢慢屈腿收回。
換另一條腿重複。
雙腿交替進行至所需次數。

2288.name: 槓桿式握力器
instructions: 調整座椅高度，握住握力機手柄。
背部挺直，雙腳平踩。
吐氣用力擠壓捏緊握把，收縮前臂肌肉。
用力維持收縮一秒，慢慢放鬆放開。
重複所需次數。

2289.name: 槓桿式小腿推舉
instructions: 調整小腿訓練機座椅，使肩膀與肩墊貼合。
前腳掌踩在踏台邊緣，腳跟懸空。
握住把手維持穩定。
蹬展腳踝收縮小腿將重量推起。
頂點稍作停頓。
放低腳跟至低於踏板，感受深層拉伸後再次推起。
重複所需次數。

2290.name: 啞鈴保加利亞分腿蹲
instructions: Stand a stride length in front of a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Rest the top of your back foot on the bench.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through your front heel to stand back up.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

2292.name: 啞鈴後三角肌平舉
instructions: 雙腳分開與肩同寬站立，雙手各握一啞鈴，掌心朝向身體。
微屈膝蓋，屈髖前傾，背部維持打直。
手肘微彎，將手臂向兩側抬起至平行地面（俯身側平舉）。
頂端稍作停頓，然後慢慢降回。
重複所需次數。

2293.name: 啞鈴站姿佐特曼牧師椅彎舉
instructions: 站直，雙手各持一啞鈴，掌心朝前。
上手臂貼在牧師斜墊上，手肘微屈。
將啞鈴向上彎舉向肩膀，上手臂固定。
在彎舉最高點旋轉手腕使掌心朝下。
慢慢將啞鈴放回，同時將手腕轉回掌心朝前。
重複所需次數。

2294.name: 啞鈴佐特曼牧師椅彎舉
instructions: 坐在牧師椅上，手持啞鈴掌心朝上，手肘靠在墊上。
上手臂固定，將啞鈴向上彎舉至肩前。
在動作頂端旋轉手腕使掌心朝下（旋腕彎舉）。
控制著將啞鈴放回，同時旋轉回掌心朝上。
重複所需次數。

2297.name: 健身球捲腹(全幅度雙手抱頭)
instructions: 坐在抗力球上，雙腳踩實，膝蓋呈 90 度。
雙手放於後腦勺，手肘朝外展開。
收緊腹肌向前捲動上半身，使胸部靠近膝蓋（抗力球捲腹）。
頂點停頓片刻，慢慢降回上半身。
重複所需次數。

2298.name: 長凳反向划船
instructions: 擺放一張高度適合身體懸掛於下方的重訓椅或單槓。
仰臥躺在地面，頭部朝向長凳。
向上伸手正握抓住重訓椅邊緣或橫槓，握距略寬於肩。
腳跟著地身體伸展打直。
核心收緊，肩胛骨向內夾緊，將胸口拉向長凳（澳洲引體向上/仰臥懸垂划船）。
頂點停頓片刻，慢慢放回身體。
重複所需次數。

2300.name: 屈膝反向划船
instructions: 在腰部高度架設橫槓，仰臥躺在槓下。
正握抓住槓鈴，握距略寬於肩寬。
腳跟著地，身體維持一條直線。
兩側肩胛骨向後夾緊，挺胸將胸口拉向槓鈴。
頂端停頓片刻，緩慢降回。
重複所需次數。

2311.name: 階梯機步行
instructions: 調整踏步機至適合的步頻與阻力。
站上踏板，雙手扶在扶手上保持平衡。
雙腳交替踩踏踏板，模擬爬樓梯動作。
維持抬頭挺胸直立騎姿，收緊核心。
持續踩踏至指定時間或步數。
適應後可逐漸提高速度或阻力。
運動結束後記得進行小腿與大腿伸展放鬆。

2312.name: 仰臥肘碰膝
instructions: 平躺，雙膝彎曲，雙腳平踩。
雙手輕扶後腦勺，手肘朝外。
腹肌發力抬起上半身，右肘轉向靠攏左膝。
同時右腿向前水平伸直懸空（腳踏車捲腹 Bicycle Crunch）。
停頓片刻，換左肘碰右膝、左腿伸直。
雙側交替進行踩踏動作至所需次數。

2314.name: 槓桿式仰臥捲腹 v. 2
instructions: Lie back on the machine and set your feet or hands as the machine requires.
Grip the handles lightly and set your lower back against the pad.
Curl your ribs toward your hips to crunch up.
Exhale and squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly without letting the weight stack rest.
按計劃的次數重複。

2315.name: 槓桿式旋轉小腿
instructions: 調整座椅高度，使膝蓋微彎，雙腳平放踏板。
前腳掌踩在踏板邊緣，腳跟懸空。
手握把手維持穩定。
前腳掌發力將腳跟推至最高點。
頂峰停頓片刻，慢慢降回。
重複所需次數。

2317.name: 啞鈴坐姿屈臂側平舉
instructions: 坐在重訓椅上，背部打直，雙腳平放。
雙手各握一啞鈴，掌心朝向身體，手肘呈 90 度。
保持手肘 90 度屈曲，將雙臂向兩側抬起至平行地面（側平舉）。
頂端稍作停頓，慢慢放回。
重複所需次數。

2318.name: 槓桿式肩推 v. 3
instructions: 調整機械推肩機座椅高度與靠背。
坐上機台，背靠椅背，雙腳踩實。
正握抓把手，間距略寬於肩。
向上前方推動把手，手臂伸直（不鎖死）。
頂端停留片刻，慢慢降回。
重複所需次數。

2321.name: 啞鈴站姿內側二頭彎舉 v. 2
instructions: 站直，雙手各持一啞鈴，掌心朝向軀幹。
手肘貼緊軀幹，向上旋轉前臂使掌心朝前。
上手臂維持不動，彎舉啞鈴收縮二頭肌。
舉至二頭肌完全收縮、啞鈴與肩同高。
頂峰停頓片刻。
吸氣慢慢放回啞鈴。
重複指定次數。

2324.name: 滑輪直腿穿越拉(繩索)
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and stand facing away from the stack.
Reach through your legs and grab the rope, then step forward to add tension.
Keep your legs nearly straight and hinge forward at the hips.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall while the rope passes between your legs.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
Hinge back with control and repeat.

2325.name: 啞鈴正握轉中立握划船
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, holding dumbbells with an overhand grip.
Let your arms hang straight below your shoulders.
Row the weights toward your hips while rotating your palms to face each other.
在頂部將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Lower the dumbbells slowly while turning your palms back down.
Keep your torso still.

2326.name: 啞鈴正握划船
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang with palms facing your legs.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your lower ribs.
Keep your elbows close to your body and squeeze your shoulder blades.
慢慢放下直到手臂伸直。
Avoid jerking with your torso.

2327.name: 啞鈴反握划船(女)
instructions: 雙腳分開與肩同寬站立，膝蓋微彎。
雙手各持一啞鈴，正握，掌心朝向身體。
屈髖前傾，背部維持挺直，核心收緊。
手臂自然下垂伸直，手肘微屈。
將啞鈴拉向胸腹兩側，肩胛骨用力夾緊。
頂端停留片刻，慢慢降回。
重複所需次數。

2328.name: 健身球窄距伏地挺身
instructions: 將抗力球放地上，擺出高棒式姿勢，雙手撐在球面上，間距略窄於肩。
收緊核心維持軀幹穩定成一直線。
手肘微收彎曲，將胸口沉向抗力球。
底部停頓片刻，手臂推直回到高棒式。
重複所需次數。

2329.name: 脊椎扭轉
instructions: 坐在地上，雙腿向前伸展。
彎曲膝蓋雙腳踩實，與臀部同寬。
雙手輕扶後腦勺，手肘展開。
收緊腹肌，軀幹慢慢向右旋轉，右肘朝向左膝。
轉到底部稍作停頓，回到中央。
換向左旋轉，左肘朝向右膝。
交替進行至所需次數。

2330.name: 滑輪背闊肌下拉全幅度
instructions: 坐在滑輪下拉機上，大腿固定在大腿護墊下方。
正握抓握橫桿，握距略寬於肩。
身體微後傾挺胸，下背維持自然微弓。
將長桿向下拉向上胸鎖骨處，肩胛骨向內夾緊。
動作底部停頓片刻，慢慢放回橫桿。
重複所需次數。

2331.name: 交叉訓練機騎乘
instructions: 調整座椅高度，坐穩飛輪交叉訓練機。
雙腳踩入踏板並握緊手把。
以平穩受控的節奏開始踩踏。
維持均勻步頻並視需要調整阻力。
持續踩踏至有氧訓練指定時間。

2333.name: 吊掛直腿甩臂
instructions: 懸掛在單槓上，手臂完全伸直，雙腿下垂。
啟動核心，保持雙腿打直，將雙腿抬至身前與地面平行（懸垂 L 抬腿）。
在水平頂端維持片刻，慢慢降回雙腿。
重複所需次數。

2334.name: 雪橇仰臥小腿推舉
instructions: 調整推腿機至適當重量。
背貼靠墊坐穩，雙腳踩在平台上。
前腳掌踩在踏板下邊緣，腳跟懸空。
伸展腳踝將踏板向前推起，膝蓋保持微屈。
持續用力直到小腿完全收縮。
頂峰停頓片刻，慢慢放低腳跟。
重複所需次數。

2335.name: 槓桿式坐姿小腿推舉
instructions: 調整座姿提踵機，使大腿墊壓在大腿遠端近膝處。
前腳掌踩在踏板下緣，腳跟懸空。
雙手握住兩側把手。
伸展腳踝將墊子頂起，盡可能抬高腳跟。
頂峰停留片刻，慢慢降回。
重複所需次數。

2336.name: 槓鈴臥推前臂(動作檢查)
instructions: Lie on a bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet planted.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Keep your forearms vertical when the bar is at your chest.
Lower the bar with control to the mid-chest.
Press it up to straight arms without flaring the elbows.
按計劃的次數重複。

2337.name: 啞鈴飛鳥手臂(動作檢查)
instructions: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
肘部保持微微彎曲。
Lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc.
Stop when you feel a gentle stretch across the chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together above your chest.
按計劃的次數重複。

2338.name: 臥推臀部(動作檢查)
instructions: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat on the floor.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your hips stay planted on the pad and never lift off.
用小重量緩慢完成，全程保持正確姿勢。
照鏡子或從側面拍一組，檢查自己的姿勢。
先把動作要領做對再加重量，組間休息，讓姿勢保持標準。

2339.name: 臥推握距(動作檢查)
instructions: Lie on the bench and grip the bar at a moderate width.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your forearms are vertical at the bottom, with hands just wider than the shoulders.
用小重量緩慢完成，全程保持正確姿勢。
照鏡子或從側面拍一組，檢查自己的姿勢。
先把動作要領做對再加重量，組間休息，讓姿勢保持標準。

2340.name: 臥推肩部(動作檢查)
instructions: Lie on the bench and pinch your shoulder blades together before unracking.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your shoulder blades stay pulled back and down against the bench.
用小重量緩慢完成，全程保持正確姿勢。
照鏡子或從側面拍一組，檢查自己的姿勢。
先把動作要領做對再加重量，組間休息，讓姿勢保持標準。

2341.name: 臥推手臂(動作檢查)
instructions: Lie on the bench and unrack the bar over your shoulders.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your arms move in a controlled line and the bar tracks over the lower chest.
用小重量緩慢完成，全程保持正確姿勢。
照鏡子或從側面拍一組，檢查自己的姿勢。
先把動作要領做對再加重量，組間休息，讓姿勢保持標準。

2342.name: 臥推手肘(動作檢查)
instructions: Lie on the bench with the bar unracked above your chest.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your elbows sit at roughly 45 degrees from the torso instead of flaring wide.
用小重量緩慢完成，全程保持正確姿勢。
照鏡子或從側面拍一組，檢查自己的姿勢。
先把動作要領做對再加重量，組間休息，讓姿勢保持標準。

2343.name: 俯身划船背部(動作檢查)
instructions: Hold the bar and hinge forward at the hips with soft knees.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your spine stays long and flat, not rounded.
用小重量緩慢完成，全程保持正確姿勢。
照鏡子或從側面拍一組，檢查自己的姿勢。
先把動作要領做對再加重量，組間休息，讓姿勢保持標準。

2344.name: 捲腹背部(動作檢查)
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands by your head.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your lower back stays gently on the floor while only the upper back curls up.
用小重量緩慢完成，全程保持正確姿勢。
照鏡子或從側面拍一組，檢查自己的姿勢。
先把動作要領做對再加重量，組間休息，讓姿勢保持標準。

2345.name: 雪橇哈克深蹲雙腿(動作檢查)
instructions: Set your back and shoulders against the pads and place your feet on the platform.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your knees track over your toes and your feet sit flat on the platform.
用小重量緩慢完成，全程保持正確姿勢。
照鏡子或從側面拍一組，檢查自己的姿勢。
先把動作要領做對再加重量，組間休息，讓姿勢保持標準。

2346.name: 長凳撐體背部手臂(動作檢查)
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench, grip it beside your hips and slide your butt off.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your back stays close to the bench and your elbows point straight behind you.
用小重量緩慢完成，全程保持正確姿勢。
照鏡子或從側面拍一組，檢查自己的姿勢。
先把動作要領做對再加重量，組間休息，讓姿勢保持標準。

2348.name: 牧師椅彎舉手腕(動作檢查)
instructions: Sit at the preacher bench with your upper arms flat on the pad.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your wrists stay neutral and straight rather than bending back or curling in.
用小重量緩慢完成，全程保持正確姿勢。
照鏡子或從側面拍一組，檢查自己的姿勢。
先把動作要領做對再加重量，組間休息，讓姿勢保持標準。

2349.name: 側棒式臀部(動作檢查)
instructions: Lie on your side with your forearm on the floor and elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet and lift your hips off the floor.
Make a straight line from your head to your feet.
Avoid letting your butt stick out or your hips drop.
Squeeze your abs and glutes to stay level.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

2350.name: 伏地挺身起始姿勢(動作檢查)
instructions: Set your hands on the floor under your shoulders and extend your legs back.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your body forms one straight line from head to heels with hands under the shoulders.
用小重量緩慢完成，全程保持正確姿勢。
照鏡子或從側面拍一組，檢查自己的姿勢。
先把動作要領做對再加重量，組間休息，讓姿勢保持標準。

2351.name: 伏地挺身結束姿勢(動作檢查)
instructions: Start in a high plank and lower yourself under control.
