Hold a medicine ball against your chest or overhead.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Reach the ball toward your knees.
慢慢放下。
Keep your lower back on the floor.

4254.name: 單腿垂直跳
instructions: 單腿站立，膝蓋微屈。
Swing your arms back.
Jump straight up as high as you can.
Land softly on the same leg.
Reset your balance.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

4255.name: 直腿臀橋
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and heels on the floor.
Place your arms by your sides.
Press through your heels and lift your hips.
Form a straight line from shoulders to heels.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
慢慢放下。

4279.name: 船式伸展
instructions: Lie on your stomach with your legs together.
Place your hands under your shoulders.
Press up, lifting your chest and straightening your arms.
Keep your hips on the floor.
Lower slowly and relax.

4280.name: 仰望天花板伸展 v. 2
instructions: 站直，雙腳分開與髖同寬。
Reach both arms overhead and slightly back.
Tilt your head back to look at the ceiling while pressing your hips forward.
Keep your core engaged so your lower back is not over-arched.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then relax.

4282.name: 腳掌與腳踝伸展
instructions: Sit on a chair or the floor with one leg extended.
Point your toes away from you.
Hold for 15 seconds.
Pull your toes back toward your shin.
Hold for another 15 seconds.
換腿並重復。

4288.name: 中背伸展
instructions: Stand or sit and clasp your hands in front of you.
Straighten your arms and push them forward.
Round your upper back and tuck your chin.
Feel the stretch between your shoulder blades.
Release slowly and repeat.

4290.name: 啞鈴定點弓步
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand in a long split stance, rear heel lifted.
Keep your torso upright and core braced.
Bend both knees and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Press through the front heel to stand back up without moving your feet.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4296.name: 交叉跪姿髖屈肌伸展
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward in a lunge, on a mat.
Tuck your pelvis slightly and keep your torso upright.
Reach the arm on the kneeling side up and across toward the opposite side.
Shift your hips gently forward until you feel the stretch at the front of the hip.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

4299.name: 仰臥股四頭肌伸展
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs stacked and your head resting on one arm.
Bend the top knee and grab that ankle with your top hand.
Pull your heel toward your glutes while keeping your knees close together.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

4300.name: 股四頭肌伸展
instructions: Stand tall, using a wall or support for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab the ankle behind you.
Pull your heel toward your glutes, keeping your knees together and hips square.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換腿。

4312.name: 斜向伸展
instructions: 站直，雙腳分開與髖同寬。
Raise one arm overhead and keep the other hand resting on your hip.
Lean slowly toward the opposite side, lengthening along the raised arm.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸均勻。
Return to upright and switch sides.

4318.name: 啞鈴地板仰臥拉舉
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
肘部保持微微彎曲。
Lower the weight in an arc behind your head until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pull it back over your chest using your lats.
Keep your ribs down and core tight throughout.

4322.name: 站姿側彎(屈臂) v. 2
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and one hand behind your head, elbow bent.
Place your other hand on your hip.
Bend sideways toward the hand on your hip without leaning forward.
Squeeze your side to return upright.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

4328.name: 站姿剪刀腿
instructions: Stand tall with one foot forward and one back, arms ready.
Hop lightly and switch your leg positions in the air.
Swing your arms opposite to your legs for balance.
用前腳掌輕輕落地。
Keep a quick, steady rhythm for the set.

4332.name: 捲腹停留
instructions: 仰臥，膝蓋彎曲，雙腳平放。
Place your hands lightly behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor.
Hold the top position for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Lower down with control.

4334.name: 側棒式斜向捲腹
instructions: Set up in a side plank on one forearm, feet stacked or staggered.
Put your free hand behind your head.
Bring your top knee and elbow together beneath your torso.
Extend back to the side plank position.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

4336.name: 槓桿式二頭彎舉
instructions: Adjust the seat so your elbows line up with the machine pivot.
Grip the handles with palms up.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders.
在頂部夾緊二頭肌。
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

4338.name: 槓鈴蜘蛛彎舉
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with your arms hanging and a barbell in your hands.
Grip the bar with palms facing up, shoulder-width.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders without moving your upper arms.
在頂部收緊。
Lower slowly to full extension.

4339.name: 槓鈴仰臥拉舉 v. 2
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a barbell over your chest with a close grip.
肘部保持微微彎曲。
Lower the bar in an arc behind your head until you feel a deep stretch.
Pull it back over your chest using your lats.
Keep your core braced and your ribs down.

4343.name: 啞鈴單臂三頭伸展
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and press it overhead.
Keep your upper arm close to your head with the elbow pointing up.
Bend the elbow and lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend the elbow to press the weight back up.
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

4344.name: 槓鈴上斜三頭伸展碎顱者
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench holding a barbell above your chest, arms straight.
上臂保持靜止。
Bend your elbows and lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your arms to return to the start.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.

4345.name: 滑輪上斜窄握彎舉
instructions: Lean back on an incline bench in front of a low cable with a straight bar.
Grip the bar close together with palms up.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders, upper arms still.
在頂部收緊。
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

4346.name: 徒手站姿軍事推舉
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and fists at your shoulders.
收緊內核，夾緊臀部。
Press your arms straight overhead.
Lower back to your shoulders with control.
Avoid leaning back.

4349.name: 槓鈴單腿深蹲
instructions: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand on one leg, other leg lifted in front.
收緊內核，抬起胸口。
Sit your hips back and lower as deep as you control.
Drive through your heel to stand.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4350.name: 滑輪仰臥一般握彎舉
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet toward a low pulley and grab the bar with an underhand grip.
Pin your upper arms to the floor beside you.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
在頂部夾緊二頭肌。
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight and repeat.

4351.name: 滑輪上斜碎顱者
instructions: Set an incline bench facing away from a low cable and hold the bar overhead.
上臂保持靜止。
Bend your elbows and lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your arms to return.
Keep your elbows from flaring.

4352.name: 地板長凳撐體 v. 2
instructions: Sit on the floor with your back to a bench and place your hands on its edge.
Lift your hips and extend your legs slightly in front.
Bend your elbows and lower your body.
推回到手臂伸直。
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

4353.name: 滑輪仰臥三頭伸展(繩索)
instructions: Lie on a bench with your head toward a low pulley and hold the rope above your chest.
上臂保持靜止。
Bend your elbows and lower the rope behind your head.
Extend your arms to return.
Spread the rope slightly at the end.

4355.name: 滑輪三頭下壓(V型握把) v. 2

4356.name: 滑輪水平帕洛夫推 v. 2

4357.name: 彈力帶二頭彎舉 v. 2
instructions: Stand on the band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ends, palms up.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Curl your hands toward your shoulders.
在頂部收緊。
Lower slowly against the band.

4358.name: 彈力帶跪姿背闊肌下拉
instructions: Anchor a band high and kneel facing it, holding the ends.
Lean back slightly and brace your core.
Pull your elbows down toward your ribs.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Return slowly with control.

4359.name: 彈力帶過頭三頭伸展 v. 3
instructions: Stand holding a band behind your head, one hand low and one hand high.
Keep your elbows close to your head.
Extend your top arm straight overhead.
短暫停頓。
Lower slowly, then switch sides.

4360.name: 雙腳放長凳上長凳撐體
instructions: Place your hands on one bench behind you and your heels on another in front.
Straighten your legs and lift your hips.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
推回起始位置。
Keep your back close to the bench.

4362.name: 槓鈴深蹲停留2秒
instructions: Set a barbell on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and sit down into a deep squat.
Pause for two seconds at the bottom.
腳後跟發力站起。
Keep your chest up throughout.

4364.name: 地板單腿撐體
instructions: Sit on the floor with hands behind you and knees bent.
Lift your hips and extend one leg out.
Bend your elbows to lower.
推回起始位置。
Switch legs after your reps.

4365.name: 動物休息瑜伽式
instructions: Kneel on a mat and sit back toward your heels.
Fold forward and stretch your arms ahead.
Rest your forehead on the floor.
Breathe deeply and hold for 30-60 seconds.
慢慢放鬆。

4367.name: 滑輪俯身反握划船
instructions: Stand facing a low cable and hinge forward with a flat back.
Grip the bar with palms up.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
慢慢放下。

4368.name: 滑輪俯身繩索握把划船
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hinge forward with a flat back.
Grip the rope with palms facing each other.
Pull the rope toward your lower chest.
Spread the rope as you squeeze your back.
控制着慢慢放下。

4369.name: 徒手站姿二頭彎舉 v. 2
instructions: Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Make fists and curl your hands to your shoulders.
Tense your biceps at the top.
慢慢放下。
Keep your elbows pinned.

4370.name: 史密斯機坐姿提踵
instructions: Sit on a bench under the bar with the balls of your feet on a raised block.
Rest the bar across your thighs with a pad.
Lift your heels as high as possible.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly for a full stretch.

4371.name: 槓桿式上斜單臂胸推(掛片式)

4374.name: 滑輪站姿交替低位飛鳥
instructions: Stand between two low pulleys holding the handles.
Take a small step forward with a slight lean.
Sweep one arm up and across toward the center of your chest.
慢慢回到起始位置。
交替進行。

4378.name: 槓桿式反握高位划船(掛片式)

4379.name: 彈力帶反向划船
instructions: Anchor the band to a sturdy bar or rack and hold it while lying under the anchor point.
Keep your body in a straight line with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up toward your hands, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower yourself under control until your arms are straight.

4380.name: 站姿單腿毛巾滑行
instructions: Stand on a smooth floor with one foot on a towel and hold a support if needed.
Bend the standing knee slightly and keep your chest tall.
Slide the towel foot out to the side or back as far as you can control.
Pull it back to the start using your hip and thigh muscles.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4382.name: 槓鈴前架弓步 v. 2
instructions: Rest the barbell on the front of your shoulders with elbows high.
站直，雙腳分開與髖同寬。
Step forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs, keeping your torso upright.

4390.name: 槓鈴前架後弓步
instructions: Rest the barbell across your front shoulders with elbows high.
站直，雙腳分開與髖同寬。
Step one leg back and lower until both knees are around 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs and keep your torso upright.

4391.name: 滑輪繩索握把低位划船
instructions: Sit at the low pulley with the rope attached, feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grab the rope ends with a neutral grip and sit tall.
Pull the rope toward your lower stomach, driving your elbows back.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Return slowly until your arms are straight without rounding your back.

4392.name: 划船瑜伽式
instructions: Sit with your knees bent and your feet on the floor.
Lean back slightly, keeping your chest lifted and back long.
Lift your feet and extend your legs into a V shape.
Reach your arms forward alongside your legs.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸均勻。

4397.name: 槓鈴前架分腿蹲
instructions: Rest the barbell on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Take a split stance with one foot well in front of the other.
Lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your torso upright.
Press through the front foot to rise.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4398.name: 彈力帶深蹲
instructions: Stand on the band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the handles at your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your chest tall.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat.
膝蓋方向與腳尖一致。
Drive through your feet to stand up.

4400.name: 壺鈴登階
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench holding a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Press through that heel to stand tall on top.
Lower back down slowly with control.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4401.name: 槓鈴抬膝登階
instructions: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand facing a box.
Place one foot on the box and press up through that heel.
Drive the other knee up toward your hip at the top.
Lower the knee and step back down under control.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4405.name: 老鷹瑜伽式
instructions: Stand tall and bend both knees slightly.
Lift one leg and wrap it across the other thigh.
Cross your arms in front, one elbow over the other, palms together.
Lift your elbows and sink your hips slightly.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

4407.name: 虎尾按摩棒三頭肌
instructions: Set up facing your anchor or support, with your upper arms close to your body.
Brace your core and keep your elbows still.
Straighten your arms fully to engage the triceps.
Squeeze at the bottom for a moment.
慢慢回到起始位置。

4408.name: 壺鈴直立划船
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Keep it close to your body.
Pull it up toward your chest, leading with your elbows.
Stop at about chest height.
控制着慢慢放下。

4410.name: 戰士二式瑜伽
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart and turn your front foot out.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Gaze over your front fingertips and keep your torso upright.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

4411.name: 槓鈴坐姿高位前平舉
instructions: Sit on a bench holding a barbell with an overhand grip, in front of your thighs.
Keep your back straight and your core braced.
Lift the bar forward and up to eye level or higher.
短暫停頓。
控制着慢慢放下。

4412.name: 彈力帶拉開(旋前90度)
instructions: Stand holding a band in front of you at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and your core braced.
Pull your hands apart until the band touches your chest.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
慢慢回到起始位置。

4414.name: 槓鈴臥推加彈力帶懸吊壺鈴

4416.name: 滑行腿鳥狗式
instructions: Start on all fours with a sliding disc or towel under one foot.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Slide that leg straight back as you extend the opposite arm forward.
Return to the start in a controlled way.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

4417.name: 相撲深蹲觸地
instructions: Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out.
Push your hips back and squat down.
Touch the floor with your fingertips between your feet.
Keep your chest lifted and your knees tracking over your toes.
腳後跟發力站起。

4422.name: EZ槓拖曳二頭彎舉
instructions: Stand holding an ez bar with an underhand grip at your thighs.
Keep the bar close to your body.
Curl it up while moving your elbows back behind you.
Let the bar slide up your torso to chest height.
控制着慢慢放下。

4423.name: 槓鈴架上仰臥窄握反握划船

4424.name: 槓鈴架上仰臥窄握正握划船
instructions: Set a barbell in a rack at about waist height.
Lie beneath it and grip the bar overhand with hands close together.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Pull your chest to the bar and squeeze your shoulder blades.
控制着慢慢放下。

4425.name: 啞鈴架上仰臥窄握平行握划船

4426.name: 啞鈴架上仰臥寬握划船
instructions: Lie face down on a high bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the dumbbells up with elbows flaring out to the sides.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
控制着慢慢放下。

4431.name: 負重仰臥頸部左右移動

4435.name: 高抬膝深蹲 v. 2
instructions: 雙腳分開與肩同寬站立。
Squat down with your chest lifted.
Stand up explosively and drive one knee up toward your chest.
Land softly and drop into the next squat.
Alternate knees on each rep.

4438.name: 開合跨步
instructions: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
Step one foot out to the side while raising your arms overhead.
Step it back as you lower your arms.
在另一側重複。
Keep a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.

4440.name: 壺鈴登階 v. 2
instructions: Stand facing a bench or box holding a kettlebell.
Place one foot flat on the box.
Press through that heel to stand up.
Lower back down slowly.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4443.name: 啞鈴輔助保加利亞分腿蹲

4444.name: 壺鈴輔助保加利亞分腿蹲

4446.name: 壺鈴半跪姿單臂倒握推舉
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the opposite foot flat in front, back upright.
Hold a kettlebell by the handle with the bell pointing up, at shoulder height.
Squeeze the handle tight and brace your core.
Press straight overhead while keeping the bell balanced.
Lower under control back to the shoulder.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

4450.name: 吊帶寬握反向划船
instructions: Hold the handles of a suspension trainer with a wide overhand grip and lean back, arms straight.
Walk your feet forward to set the difficulty.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Pull your chest toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower yourself with control until your arms are straight.

4451.name: 懸吊帶寬握地板反向划船
instructions: Hold the handles with a wide, overhand grip and lie back with your body straight.
Keep your heels on the floor and your core tight.
Pull your chest toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight and repeat.

4452.name: 彈力帶俯身寬握划船
instructions: Stand on the band with feet hip width apart and grab it with a wide overhand grip.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Pull your hands toward your lower ribs, elbows flaring out.
在頂部將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
慢慢放下直到手臂伸直。
Keep your torso still throughout.

4453.name: 彈力帶站姿單臂寬握低位划船
instructions: Anchor a band low and stand facing it, holding the end in one hand.
Step back until the band is taut, feet hip width apart.
Pull your elbow back and out, leading with the elbow.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Return slowly to a straight arm.
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

4454.name: 彈力帶坐姿寬握划船
instructions: Sit with your legs extended and loop the band around your feet.
Grab the band with a wide grip and sit tall.
Pull your hands toward your chest with elbows flared.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Return slowly with control and repeat.

4462.name: 滾球腳掌
instructions: Place the ball under your foot sole while seated or standing.
把重心移到球上，直到感到適度、可忍受的壓迫感。
在短距離內慢慢來回滾動，每次約 2-3 釐米。
找到痠痛點時，在那裏停留並呼吸 20-30 秒。
保持呼吸均勻，避免在骨骼或關節處滾動。
如需要，在另一側重複。

4466.name: 滾球膕肌

4474.name: 滾球梨狀肌 v. 2

找到痠痛點時，在那裏停留並呼吸 20-30 秒。
Use gentle pressure and breathe slowly so your stomach stays relaxed.
如需要，在另一側重複。

4476.name: 滾球腹部腰大肌
instructions: Place the ball under your psoas area beside the belly button while lying face down.

如需要，在另一側重複。

4481.name: 滾球腰部斜向

4482.name: 滾球橫膈膜

在短距離內慢慢來回滾動，每次約 2-3 釐米。
找到痠痛點時，在那裏停留並呼吸 20-30 秒。
Use gentle pressure and breathe slowly so your stomach stays relaxed.
如需要，在另一側重複。

instructions: Place the ball under your mid chest (sternal pectoralis major) while leaning on a wall or lying face down.

4498.name: 滾球肱二頭肌
instructions: Place the ball under your front of the upper arm (biceps brachii) on a table or against a wall.
把重心移到球上，直到感到適度、可忍受的壓迫感。
在短距離內慢慢來回滾動，每次約 2-3 釐米。
找到痠痛點時，在那裏停留並呼吸 20-30 秒。
保持呼吸均勻，避免在骨骼或關節處滾動。
如需要，在另一側重複。

4499.name: 徒手全深蹲加過頭推舉

4500.name: 徒手前棒式轉下犬式
instructions: Start in a straight-arm plank with hands under shoulders.
收緊內核，夾緊臀部。
Push your hips up and back into an inverted V.
Press your heels toward the floor and lengthen your spine.
Return to plank with control.
Keep moving smoothly for reps.

4509.name: 下巴碰胸伸展
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Place your hands lightly on the back of your head if you want a deeper stretch.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
Return slowly to neutral.

4510.name: 小腿伸展
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your hands on it.
Step one foot back with the heel on the floor.
Bend your front knee and lean forward.
Feel the stretch in the back calf.
換腿並重復。

4511.name: 橋式瑜伽
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet hip width apart.
Place your arms alongside your body, palms down.
Press through your feet and lift your hips.
Roll your shoulders under and lengthen your chest.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸均勻。
Lower down slowly.

4512.name: 內收肌伸展
instructions: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together.
Hold your ankles and sit tall.
Let your knees fall out to the sides.
Gently press your elbows on your thighs.
慢慢放鬆。

4515.name: 背部胸肌伸展 v. 2
instructions: 站直，雙腳分開與髖同寬。
Clasp your hands together behind your back.
Straighten your arms and lift them gently away from your body.
Open your chest and pull your shoulder blades together.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
Release and repeat.

4521.name: 壺鈴伏地挺身
instructions: Place two kettlebells on the floor shoulder-width apart and grip the handles.
Extend your legs into a plank position.
Lower your chest between the handles with elbows at about 45 degrees.
身體保持一條直線。
Press back up until your arms are straight and repeat.

4535.name: 壺鈴單臂仰臥起坐
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a kettlebell held straight up in one hand.
Keep your eyes on the kettlebell and your arm locked.
Curl up and sit all the way to standing or upright.
Control your descent back to the floor.
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

4536.name: 壺鈴後三角肌划船
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a kettlebell in each hand.
Let the weights hang below your chest.
Pull your elbows out wide and up toward the ceiling.
在頂部將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
慢慢放下並重復。

4538.name: 壺鈴屈臂仰臥拉舉(屈膝)

4539.name: 鑽石推舉
instructions: Start in a plank position with your hands under your chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows tracking back close to your ribs.
Pause briefly just above your hands.
推回到手臂伸直。
Keep your core tight so your hips do not sag.

4540.name: 啞鈴單臂推舉深蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your shoulder with one hand and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your heels.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder as you sink into the next squat.
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

4545.name: 滑輪俯身單臂後踢
instructions: Set a low pulley with a single handle and hinge forward at the hips.
Hold the handle with your elbow bent at your side, upper arm parallel to the floor.
Keep your upper arm still and straighten your elbow back.
Squeeze your triceps at full extension.
慢慢回到起始位置。
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

4546.name: 史密斯機拖曳彎舉
instructions: Stand close to the smith bar with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Let the bar hang at arm length against your thighs.
Pull your elbows back and drag the bar up along your torso.
在頂部夾緊二頭肌。
Lower the bar along the same line with control.
Keep your torso still and avoid leaning back.

4548.name: 波比深蹲
instructions: 雙腳分開與肩同寬站立。
Drop into a squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest down, then press back up.
Jump your feet forward to your hands.
Stand and finish with a bodyweight squat before the next rep.

4552.name: 斜向弓步
instructions: 站直，雙腳分開與髖同寬。
Step one foot out diagonally, about 45 degrees away from you.
Bend both knees and lower into a lunge, keeping your chest up.
Push off the front foot to return to the start.
Alternate legs each rep.
Keep your front knee pointing the same way as your toes.

4554.name: 坐姿臀部伸展 v. 2
instructions: Sit on a chair or the floor with your back tall.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Keep your back straight and lean your chest forward slowly.
Feel the stretch in the glute of the crossed leg.
換腿。

4557.name: 沙發伸展
instructions: Kneel facing away from a wall or couch with one shin up against it.
Place your other foot flat on the floor in front in a lunge.
Squeeze your glute and tuck your pelvis under.
Lift your torso upright until you feel the stretch in the front of your rear thigh.
Hold for 30-60 seconds.
換腿。

4559.name: 長凳跪姿背闊肌伸展
instructions: Kneel in front of a bench and place both elbows on top of it.
Keep your hands together or hold a light stick.
Sit your hips back and let your chest sink toward the floor.
Keep your lower back relaxed.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
Come back up carefully.

4563.name: 啞鈴深蹲停留提踵
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and sink into a half squat.
Keep your chest tall and weight over your feet.
Lift your heels as high as you can.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower your heels slowly without standing up.
Stay in the squat for the full set.

4565.name: 啞鈴抬膝登階
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand facing a bench or box.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Push through that heel and step up.
Lift the other knee toward your chest at the top.
Step down with control.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4567.name: 滑輪俯身單臂中立握繩索握把後踢

4568.name: 彈力帶拉開
instructions: Hold a resistance band in front of you at chest height, arms straight.
Keep your hands about shoulder-width apart.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
慢慢回到起始位置。
Keep your ribs down and shoulders relaxed.

4569.name: 彈力帶單臂俯身划船
instructions: Stand on the band with a staggered stance and hinge forward.
Hold the handle in one hand with your arm extended.
收緊內核，背部貼緊。
Pull your elbow back toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch sides.

4570.name: 彈力帶俯身中立握划船
instructions: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and hinge forward.
Hold the handles with a neutral grip, arms straight.
Keep your back flat and neck neutral.
Pull both handles toward your lower ribs.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
控制着慢慢放下。

4572.name: 啞鈴半跪姿上提與下劈
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold a dumbbell with both hands.
Start with the weight by your low outside hip.
Lift the dumbbell diagonally across your body to above the opposite shoulder.
Rotate your torso and keep your hips square.
Chop it back down along the same line.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

4573.name: 彈力帶半跪姿下劈
instructions: Anchor a band high and kneel on one knee side-on to the anchor.
Hold the band with both hands near your high shoulder.
Pull the band diagonally down across your body.
Rotate your torso and keep your hips square.
慢慢回到起始位置。
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

4574.name: 啞鈴站姿二頭彎舉轉肩推

4576.name: 彈力帶站姿直臂下拉
instructions: Anchor a band overhead and hold the ends with arms extended in front of you.
Stand with a slight forward lean and a braced core.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Pull the band down in an arc until your hands reach your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
慢慢回到起始位置。

4578.name: 滑輪俯身中立握繩索握把後踢
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold both ends.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Keep your upper arms parallel to the floor and close to your sides.
Straighten your elbows and spread the rope slightly at the end.
Squeeze your triceps.
慢慢回到起始位置。

4595.name: 踢拳前膝撞(與搭檔)
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad at waist height.
Stand in a fighting stance with hands up.
Drive your rear knee up and forward into the pad.
Rise slightly onto the toes of your standing foot.
上身保持挺直。
Lower the leg and switch sides.

4601.name: 開書式伸展
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent and stacked, arms straight in front of you.
Keep your knees together and lift the top arm up and over.
Rotate your chest open toward the ceiling, following your hand with your eyes.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
Return the arm and repeat, then switch sides.

4603.name: 塑膠管前架伸展
instructions: Stand tall holding a PVC pipe across your upper chest in a front rack grip.
Lift your elbows forward and up as high as you comfortably can.
Keep your chest up and your lower back from arching.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸均勻。
Lower the elbows and repeat.

4612.name: 徒手站姿環繞(靠牆支撐)

4613.name: 徒手站姿軍事推舉(靠牆支撐)

4616.name: 腿前踢
instructions: Stand tall with your arms out for balance or hands on your hips.
Shift your weight onto one foot.
Swing the other leg forward and up in a controlled kick, keeping it fairly straight.
Lower it with control without leaning back.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4617.name: 單臂伏地挺身(靠牆支撐)
instructions: Stand facing a wall at arm's length and place one hand on it at chest height.
Keep your other arm behind your back or at your side.
Bend your elbow to lower your chest toward the wall, body in a straight line.
Press back to the start.
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

4619.name: 彈力帶站姿錘式彎舉
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms facing each other.
肘部貼近身體兩側。
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders without turning your wrists.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower slowly back to the start.

4621.name: 啞鈴窄握肩推仰臥起坐

4623.name: 負重坐姿屈腿捲腹(地板)

4624.name: 啞鈴捲腹上抬
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a dumbbell held against your chest.
Brace your abs.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor.
在頂部暫停。
Lower back down slowly.

4625.name: 啞鈴俄羅斯轉體窄握肩推仰臥起坐
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding dumbbells at your shoulders.
Sit up and rotate your torso to one side.
Rotate back to center and press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and roll back down.
每次都換邊。

4626.name: 啞鈴坐姿屈腿捲腹(地板)

4627.name: 啞鈴前棒式抬手抬腿
instructions: Start in a high plank with a dumbbell in one hand.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift the dumbbell forward and the opposite leg back at the same time.
Lower both under control.
每次都換邊。

4628.name: 啞鈴坐姿屈腿扭轉捲腹(地板)
instructions: Sit on the floor holding a dumbbell at your chest and lean back slightly.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Pull your knees in and rotate your torso to one side.
Extend your legs and rotate back to center.
在另一側重複。

4631.name: 蠍子式伸展
instructions: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides.
Bend one knee and swing that foot up and across your body.
Reach toward the opposite hand and keep shoulders on the floor.
Return and switch sides.

4633.name: 世界最偉大伸展
instructions: Step into a long lunge with both hands on the floor inside your front foot.
Drop your hips low.
Rotate your chest toward the front leg and raise that arm.
Return the hand to the floor and straighten the front leg.
換邊並重復。

4634.name: 高抬膝轉後踢臀
instructions: 站直，雙腳分開與髖同寬。
Drive one knee up to hip height.
Lower it and kick the same heel toward your glutes.
Alternate sides at a steady, light pace.
Keep your core braced and stay on the balls of your feet.

4646.name: 雙手放胸前俄羅斯轉體

4653.name: 站姿單腿高抬膝轉後踢臀(支撐)

4658.name: 跪姿觸肩伏地挺身
instructions: Start in a kneeling push-up position with hands under your shoulders.
將胸口向地面靠近。
推回到手臂伸直。
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder, then switch.
Keep your hips steady and repeat.

4663.name: 反手上舉
instructions: Lie face down with your arms by your sides, palms up.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Raise your hands up and back by squeezing your shoulder blades.
在頂部暫停。
慢慢放下並重復。

4672.name: 手肘後拉伸展
instructions: Stand tall with your hands behind your head and elbows pointing out.
Draw your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lift your chest slightly.
Relax and repeat.

4673.name: 髖部後伸伸展
instructions: Stand or kneel with one foot forward in a lunge position.
Tuck your pelvis under and squeeze the back glute.
Lean slightly forward to feel the stretch at the front of the hip.
換邊。

4674.name: 髖屈肌伸展(後腳墊高)
instructions: Place the top of your back foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot forward into a lunge.
Tuck your pelvis and push your hips forward.
Keep your chest tall and hold for 20-30 seconds.
換邊。

4677.name: 彈力帶跪姿單腿後踢
instructions: Get on all fours with a band looped around your foot and hands.
收緊內核，背部貼緊。
Extend one leg back, squeezing your glute.
Pause briefly at full extension.
Return with control and repeat, then switch legs.

4678.name: 彈力帶擺盪
instructions: Stand on the band holding the other end with both hands.
Hinge your hips back with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to swing your arms up to chest height.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
Control the return and repeat.

4679.name: 彈力帶分腿蹲 v. 2
instructions: Stand on the band with your front foot and hold the other end at your shoulders.
Step your other foot back into a split stance.
將後側膝蓋向地面靠近。
Keep your torso upright and your front knee stable.
Drive up through the front foot, then switch legs after your set.

4682.name: 彈力帶俯身後三角飛鳥
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends in each hand.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Raise your arms out to the sides with slight elbow bends.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
慢慢放下並重復。

4683.name: 彈力帶深蹲 v. 2
instructions: Stand on the band with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ends at your shoulders.
收緊內核，抬起胸口。
Sit your hips back and down.
Go to at least parallel without letting your knees cave in.
Drive up through your heels and repeat.

4685.name: 彈力帶站姿側彎
instructions: Stand on one end of the band and hold the other end at your side.
Keep your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend sideways at the waist away from the band.
Squeeze your obliques and return upright.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

4686.name: 彈力帶站姿頸後軍事推舉

4687.name: 彈力帶錘式彎舉
instructions: Stand on the middle of the band and hold the handles with palms facing in.
肘部貼近身體兩側。
Curl the handles up toward your shoulders.
在頂部收緊。
Lower slowly under tension.

4688.name: 彈力帶三頭下壓
instructions: Anchor the band high and hold the handles with elbows bent at your sides.
Keep your elbows pinned.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
慢慢回到起始位置。

4689.name: 彈力帶分腿蹲
instructions: Stand in a split stance with the band under your front foot and handles at your shoulders.
上身保持挺直。
將後側膝蓋向地面靠近。
Press through the front heel to rise.
Complete your reps and switch legs.

4690.name: 腿跨膝臀橋
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and one ankle crossed over the other knee.
Press through the grounded foot.
Lift your hips until your body forms a line.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
Lower slowly and switch sides.

4694.name: 彈力帶過頭三頭伸展 v. 4
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends behind your head with elbows bent.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Extend your arms overhead.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
慢慢放下並重復。

4695.name: 彈力帶站姿單臂直立划船
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the other end in one hand at your thigh.
Keep your elbow leading the movement.
Pull your hand up toward your chest, elbow higher than the wrist.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly, then repeat and switch arms.

4698.name: 彈力帶俯身划船 v. 3
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends, hinging forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row your elbows back toward your hips.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
慢慢放下並重復。

4700.name: 彈力帶側彎推舉
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the end in one hand at your shoulder.
Press the band overhead as you bend gently to the opposite side.
Keep your hips steady and your chest open.
Return to upright as you lower your hand.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

4701.name: 彈力帶單腿反向背部伸展
instructions: Lie face down with a band looped around one foot and anchored under you.
Rest your arms under your head.
Lift one leg up, keeping it straight.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
Lower slowly, repeat, then switch legs.

4703.name: 徒手全深蹲加過頭推舉(第二版)

4709.name: 投籃跳
instructions: Stand in an athletic stance with hands at chest height.
Dip into a quarter squat.
Jump up and extend one arm like shooting a basketball.
屈膝輕輕落地。
Reset and repeat.

4714.name: 空氣深蹲(第二版)
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees.
Lower until thighs are at least parallel with chest up.
腳後跟發力站起。
膝蓋方向與腳尖一致。

4716.name: 輔助反握引體向上(低槓位置)
instructions: Set a bar at about chest height and sit or lie beneath it.
Grip the bar with palms facing you.
Pull your chest toward the bar using your arms and back.
Use your legs only as much as needed.
控制着慢慢放下。

4717.name: 輔助突擊隊員引體向上
instructions: Grip a bar with one hand in front of the other.
Use a band or feet for assistance.
Pull until your head passes the bar to one side.
控制着慢慢放下。
Switch the head side on the next rep.

4718.name: 彈力帶輔助反握引體向上
instructions: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip and the band looped under your feet.
Engage your lats and keep your core tight.
Pull your chin over the bar.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly until your arms are straight and repeat.

4719.name: 彈力帶輔助雙槓撐體(第二版)
instructions: Loop a band across dip bars and place your knees in it.
Support yourself with straight arms.
Lower until your elbows reach about 90 degrees.
推回起始位置。
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

4721.name: 槓鈴二頭彎舉
instructions: Stand holding a bar with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
肘部貼近身體兩側。
Curl the bar up to shoulder height.
Squeeze your biceps.
慢慢放下，不要借擺動。

4723.name: 徒手站姿西西深蹲
instructions: Stand holding a support, feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Bend your knees forward and lean back.
Lower as far as you can control.
推回起始位置。

4725.name: 反握引體向上(等長與負向)

4727.name: 捲腹(雙手放胸前)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor.
在頂部收緊腹部。
慢慢放下並重復。

4729.name: 啞鈴雙腿墊高長凳撐體

4730.name: 啞鈴俯身單臂划船 v. 2

4734.name: 啞鈴下斜過頭仰臥起坐

4736.name: 啞鈴深度伏地挺身接叛徒划船

4738.name: 啞鈴高腳杯深蹲接二頭彎舉
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a dumbbell by one end at your chest.
Squat down with your chest up and elbows inside your knees.
At the bottom, lower the dumbbell and curl it back up.
腳後跟發力站起。
Repeat the full sequence for each rep.

4740.name: 啞鈴懸垂爆發式高拉挺舉

4741.name: 啞鈴頭部支撐划船
instructions: Set a bench at a slight incline and lie chest down on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
Rest your forehead on the top and let your arms hang.
Row both dumbbells toward your ribs.
在頂部將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Lower slowly to straight arms.

4743.name: 啞鈴上斜二頭彎舉 v. 3
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight.
Keep your elbows back and your shoulders against the bench.
Curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders.
在頂部夾緊二頭肌。
Lower slowly until your arms are fully extended and repeat.

4744.name: 啞鈴上斜頭部支撐划船

4745.name: 啞鈴跪姿阿諾推舉
instructions: Kneel tall holding dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you.
收緊內核，夾緊臀部。
Press up while rotating your palms to face forward.
Finish with your arms straight overhead.
Reverse the rotation as you lower back to the start.

4749.name: 啞鈴羅馬尼亞硬舉接俯身划船

4750.name: 啞鈴俄羅斯轉體(雙腳離地)

4751.name: 啞鈴臀橋 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Rest a dumbbell on your hips and hold it in place.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
慢慢放下並重復。

4755.name: 啞鈴單腿臀推
instructions: Sit with your upper back on a bench and a dumbbell across your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg off the floor.
Drive through the planted heel to raise your hips until level.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

4756.name: 啞鈴仰臥起坐
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat or anchored.
Hold a dumbbell against your chest with both hands.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting.
頸部保持中立。
Lower back down slowly.

4757.name: 啞鈴錯步羅馬尼亞硬舉

4762.name: 腿後肌臀肌訓練椅髖伸展

4763.name: 腿後肌臀肌訓練椅仰臥起坐加俄羅斯轉體

4764.name: 腿後肌臀肌訓練椅背伸展轉體

4765.name: 腿後肌臀肌訓練椅單腿背伸展
instructions: Set up on the bench with one foot planted and the other lifted behind you.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your torso with a flat back.
Raise to a straight line, squeezing your glute.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4768.name: 上斜交替踢腿
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench and hold the edges behind your head.
Lift your legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down alternately in small motions.
下背保持貼緊凳面。
Continue for the set time or reps.

4769.name: 反向划船滑行
instructions: Lie under a bar or rings and grab with an overhand grip.
Keep your body straight with heels on a slick surface.
Pull your chest toward the bar while your feet slide forward.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Lower slowly with control.

4770.name: 反向寬握划船
instructions: Lie under a bar and grab it with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your body in a straight line, heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up toward the bar.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Lower under control to straight arms.

4772.name: 跪姿直腿後踢 v. 2
instructions: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Extend one leg straight behind you with the toes on the floor.
Squeeze the glute and lift the straight leg to hip height.
Pause briefly, then lower the leg without letting the back arch.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4773.name: 窄握坐姿引體向上
instructions: Sit under a low bar with your hands close together, palms facing you.
Extend your legs in front with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up toward the bar.
Squeeze your back and arms at the top.
慢慢放下直到手臂伸直。

4775.name: 平行槓伏地挺身加三頭撐體

4777.name: 地板反向背部伸展
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front or under your head.
Keep your legs straight.
Raise both legs off the floor by squeezing your glutes.
在頂部暫停。
慢慢放下並重復。

4778.name: 反向捲腹 v. 3
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides.
Lift your knees to a tabletop position.
Curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest.
在頂部暫停。
慢慢放下，不要借擺動。

4779.name: 地板反向交替踢腿(手放頭下)
instructions: Lie on your back and place your hands under your head.
Lift your legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick up and down alternately in small, quick motions.
下背保持貼緊凳面。
Continue for the set time.

4780.name: 坐姿引體向上(低槓位置)

4781.name: 坐姿引體向上
instructions: Sit under a bar with an underhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your chin toward the bar.
Squeeze your back and biceps at the top.
慢慢放下直到手臂伸直。

4782.name: 坐姿突擊兵引體向上
instructions: Sit under a bar and grab it with one hand in front of the other.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your body up and bring your head to one side.
控制着慢慢放下。
Alternate sides each rep or each set.

4783.name: 坐姿引體向上(雙腿墊高)

4784.name: 坐姿引體向上(低槓位置)
instructions: Set a bar low and sit beneath it.
Grab it with an overhand grip, a little wider than your shoulders.
Extend your legs in front with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar.
控制着慢慢放下。

4785.name: 坐姿引體向上
instructions: Sit under a bar and grab it with an overhand grip.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your chest up toward the bar.
Squeeze your back at the top.
慢慢放下直到手臂伸直。

4787.name: 雙手放胸前側向捲腹
instructions: Lie on your side with knees slightly bent and arms crossed over your chest.
Brace your core and lift your shoulders and legs toward each other.
Crunch sideways, squeezing the side of your waist.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Keep the movement small and controlled, without pulling on your neck.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

4790.name: 單腿長凳深蹲
instructions: Stand in front of a bench with your back to it and lift one foot off the floor.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and lower until you lightly touch the bench.
Keep the working knee in line with your toes.
Drive through the heel to stand back up.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4791.name: 單腿臀橋(雙臂放胸前)
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent, foot flat, and the other leg extended or raised.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Push through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glute at the top so your body forms a straight line.
Lower your hips slowly without touching the floor fully.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4792.name: 單腿臀推 v. 2
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench with one foot flat on the floor.
Lift the other leg off the floor, knee bent or straight.
Drive through the planted heel and raise your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top until your torso is level.
Lower your hips under control.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4794.name: 單腿跳躍臀橋
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot planted and the other leg lifted.
Drive through the planted heel and thrust your hips up.
Push hard enough that your hips leave the floor.
Land softly back in the bridge.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4795.name: 單腿長凳登階
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy bench and place one foot fully on top.
Lean slightly forward and press through that heel.
Step up until the leg is straight and you stand tall.
Lower yourself slowly back down with control.
Avoid pushing off the trailing foot.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4797.name: 支撐深蹲
instructions: Stand holding a stable support at about chest height, feet shoulder width apart.
收緊內核，抬起胸口。
Sit your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go as deep as you can with your heels down.
Push through your feet to stand back up.
Use the support for balance, not to pull yourself up.

4806.name: 寬握坐姿引體向上
instructions: Sit under a pull-up bar and take a wide overhand grip.
Hang with arms extended and your chest lifted.
Pull your elbows down and toward your ribs to bring your chest toward the bar.
在頂部將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Lower yourself slowly to full arm extension.

4810.name: 站姿側彎 v. 2
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width apart and one arm overhead.
Brace your core lightly.
Bend sideways at the waist, reaching over with the raised arm.
Pause when you feel the side muscles work.
Return to upright with control.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

4812.name: 側向捲腹 v. 3
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and one hand behind your head.
Rest the other hand on the floor for balance.
Lift your shoulders and knees toward each other.
Squeeze the side of your waist at the top.
Lower slowly without relaxing fully.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

4816.name: 啞鈴高腳杯深蹲(停留2秒)
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly out.
Squat down with your chest tall until your thighs are at least parallel.
Hold the bottom position for two seconds.
腳後跟發力站起。

4818.name: 吊環墊高划船
instructions: Set the rings at about chest height and rest your heels on a bench.
Grab the rings and hang with arms extended and body straight.
Pull your chest toward your hands, driving your elbows back.
在頂部將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Lower with control without letting your hips sag.

4819.name: 吊環腿彎舉
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels in the ring straps and legs extended.
抬起髖部形成橋式。
Bend your knees to pull your heels toward your glutes.
Keep your hips high the whole time.
Extend your legs slowly to return.

4821.name: 啞鈴單腿長凳登階
instructions: Stand facing a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Place one foot fully on the bench.
Press through that heel to stand up on the bench.
Lower your other foot back down slowly.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4822.name: 啞鈴羅馬尼亞硬舉接跳躍聳肩
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Hinge your hips back and lower the weights along your legs with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward and jump as you shrug your shoulders.
屈膝輕輕落地。
Reset into the hinge and repeat.

4826.name: 交替抬腿
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and arms at your sides.
將下背壓向地面。
Raise one leg up toward the ceiling.
Lower it slowly while lifting the other leg.
Keep alternating without arching your back.

4829.name: 跳繩
instructions: Hold the rope handles at hip height with elbows near your sides.
Swing the rope over your head using your wrists.
Jump just high enough to clear the rope.
用前腳掌輕輕落地。
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds, rest, and repeat.

4831.name: 毛巾滑行地板下拉 v. 2
instructions: Kneel with your hands on a towel placed on a smooth floor, arms stretched forward.
收緊內核，背部貼緊。
Pull your elbows down and back as your hands slide toward you.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Slide back out slowly to the start.

4832.name: 俯臥後側平舉
instructions: Lie face down on a bench holding a light dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang down with a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
慢慢放下。

4833.name: 啞鈴站姿單臂阿諾推舉

4838.name: 滑輪單側二頭彎舉
instructions: Attach a handle to a low cable and stand facing the machine.
Hold the handle with one hand, elbow at your side.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder.
在頂部夾緊二頭肌。
Lower slowly and switch arms.

4839.name: 彈力帶下肢死蟲式
instructions: Lie on your back with a band around your feet and legs bent over your hips.
將下背壓向地面。
Extend one leg away against the band.
Return it and switch legs.
Keep your ribs down and your core braced.

4840.name: 直腿死蟲式
instructions: Lie on your back with arms and legs straight up toward the ceiling.
將下背壓向地面。
Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Return to the start and switch sides.
Keep your lower back flat the whole time.

4841.name: 槓鈴彈力帶輔助硬舉
instructions: Attach a band to the barbell and anchor it overhead or to a rack.
Stand with the bar over midfoot and grip just outside your knees.
Brace and push the floor away to lift.
Stand tall and lock out your hips.
控制着慢慢放下。

4846.name: 壺鈴仰臥地板單臂倒握胸推

4847.name: 槓片站姿高位前平舉
instructions: Stand holding a weight plate with both hands at your thighs.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Raise the plate up and overhead.
在頂部暫停。
慢慢放下。

4849.name: 彈力帶腿後肌臀肌挺身 v. 2
instructions: Set up on a glute-ham bench or anchor your feet with a band assisting you.
Start with your torso down and hips locked.
Curl up using your hamstrings.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
控制着慢慢放下。

4851.name: 槓鈴安全桿早安體前屈

4852.name: 啞鈴交替側平舉
instructions: Stand holding light dumbbells at your sides.
肘部保持微微彎曲。
Raise one arm out to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly.
換臂。

4858.name: 側向移動伏地挺身
instructions: 從高位平板支撐開始。
Do one push-up.
Step your hands and feet to the side.
Do another push-up.
Alternate direction after a set.

4859.name: 伏地挺身轉側棒式 v. 2
instructions: 從高位平板支撐開始。
Lower into a push-up.
Push up and rotate into a side plank, raising one arm.
Return to plank.
每次都換邊。

4860.name: 伏地挺身加提膝
instructions: 從高位平板支撐開始。
Lower into a push-up.
Push back up.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Return and alternate legs.

4861.name: 壺鈴羅馬尼亞硬舉
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees.
Push your hips back and lower the bell along your legs.
背部貼緊地面。
Squeeze your glutes to stand.

4862.name: 槓鈴站姿抓舉握法聳肩
instructions: Hold a barbell with a wide snatch grip at your thighs.
Stand tall with your chest up.
Shrug your shoulders straight up.
在頂部暫停。
慢慢放下。

4866.name: 槓鈴z推舉
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs straight and the bar at your shoulders.
收緊內核。
Press the bar overhead.
Lock out your arms.
Lower to the shoulders.

4870.name: 髖部蚌式開合
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and feet together.
Keep your feet touching.
Lift your top knee.
慢慢放下。
Switch sides after your reps.

4875.name: 徒手站姿背部伸展
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width apart.
Clasp your hands in front of you and press your arms forward.
Round your upper back and tuck your chin slightly.
Feel the stretch between your shoulder blades and along the spine.
Release slowly and stand tall.

4882.name: 側臥剪刀腿
instructions: Lie on your side with your body in a straight line and head supported.
Stack your legs and lift the top leg slightly.
Raise the top leg up while the bottom leg lifts toward it.
Bring them back together in a smooth scissor motion.
Keep your hips stacked and still.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

4884.name: 側臥向外踢膝
instructions: Lie on your side with your hips stacked and bottom leg bent.
Bend the top knee and bring it toward your chest.
Kick the top leg straight out to the side.
Pull the knee back in under control.
Keep your torso still the whole time.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

4887.name: 啞鈴臀橋 v. 2
instructions: 仰臥，膝蓋彎曲，雙腳平放。
Rest a dumbbell on each hip and hold them in place.
Push through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top in a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Lower your hips slowly.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back.

4890.name: 雙臂前伸腿後肌臀肌挺身

4892.name: 墊高單腿深蹲
instructions: Stand on a bench or box on one leg with the other leg hanging off the edge.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and bend the standing knee to lower.
Go as deep as you can while the knee tracks over your toes.
Push through the foot to stand back up.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4894.name: 錯腿側橋式
instructions: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder.
Stagger your feet, top foot in front of the bottom one.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Keep the hips high and avoid rolling forward.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

4896.name: 跪姿直腿側踢
instructions: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Extend one leg out to the side with the knee straight.
Lift the leg to about hip height.
Keep your hips and back steady.
Lower with control without touching down.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4897.name: 毛巾地板反向滑行腿彎舉
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on a towel on a smooth floor.
抬起髖部形成橋式。
Slide your feet away from you by extending the knees.
Pull the heels back toward your hips with your hamstrings.
Keep your hips high the whole set.
Lower to the floor when you finish.

4899.name: 槓桿式俯身寬握划船(槓片負重)
instructions: Load the machine and set your chest against the support.
Grab the wide handles with arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your lower chest, elbows flaring out.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the pad throughout.

4900.name: 墊高坐姿提踵
instructions: Sit on a bench with the balls of your feet on a raised step.
Rest weight or your hands on your thighs.
Lower your heels as far as you comfortably can.
Press up onto your toes as high as possible.
在頂部短暫停頓。
慢慢放下並重復。

4902.name: 墊高單腿臀推
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench and put one foot on the floor or a raised step.
Lift the other leg off the ground.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glute at the top with your torso level.
控制着慢慢放下。
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4904.name: 腳尖跳
instructions: Stand tall with feet close together and knees slightly bent.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Hop up quickly using mainly your ankles.
用前腳掌輕輕落地。
Keep your hops small and rhythmic.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

4905.name: 彈力帶腿後肌臀肌挺身 v. 3

4907.name: 側棒式抬腿 v. 2
instructions: Set up in a side plank on your forearm with your body in a line.
Lift your top leg to hip height.
Keep your hips high and your core tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without dropping.
Lower down gently.
在另一側重複。

4908.name: 啞鈴長凳上反握腕彎舉(墊子)

4909.name: 側向轉寬站姿深蹲
instructions: Stand with your feet together and arms in front.
Step one foot out to the side into a wide stance.
Sit down into a squat with your chest up.
Stand up and bring your feet back together.
Alternate the stepping side.
膝蓋方向與腳尖一致。

4911.name: 反向寬轉窄划船
instructions: Set a bar or straps at waist height and lie underneath.
Grab it with a wide grip and straighten your body.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Bring your hands closer on the way up or between reps.
Lower yourself with control.
身體保持一條直線。

4912.name: 吊環腿彎舉 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels in the rings.
抬起髖部形成橋式。
Pull the rings toward your glutes by bending the knees.
Pause and squeeze the hamstrings.
Extend your legs slowly back out.
Keep your hips high throughout.

4914.name: 啞鈴硬舉(中立握)
instructions: Stand with feet hip width and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and lower the weights.
Keep the dumbbells close to your legs.
Push through your heels to stand tall.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
Do not round your lower back.

4916.name: 反向腿伸展
instructions: Get on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
收緊內核，背部貼緊。
Extend one leg back and up.
Squeeze the glute at the top.
Lower the leg without touching the floor.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4917.name: 高槓反向划船
instructions: Set a bar at about chest height and grab it overhand.
Walk your feet forward until your arms are straight.
身體保持一條直線。
Pull your chest toward the bar.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Lower yourself slowly.

4919.name: 跪姿輔助滑行引體向上

4920.name: 腿部輔助吊環引體向上
instructions: Hold the rings with a firm grip and stand with a bend in the knees.
Place your feet on the floor for light help.
Pull your elbows down and your chest between the rings.
Use your legs only as much as you need.
控制着慢慢放下。
收緊內核。

4921.name: 吊環高位划船
instructions: Hold the rings and lean back with a straight body.
Pull the rings toward your forehead.
Flare your elbows out and squeeze your shoulder blades.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

4922.name: 吊環飛鳥
instructions: Set the rings low and hold them in a plank position.
Keep your arms nearly straight with a small bend in the elbows.
Open your arms out to the sides, lowering your chest.
Pull the rings back together with your chest.
身體保持一條直線。
Go only as wide as you can control.

4923.name: 吊環反向飛鳥
instructions: Hold the rings with arms straight and lean back.
身體保持一條直線。
Open your arms out to the sides.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
慢慢回到起始位置。
Keep your elbows only slightly bent.

4924.name: 長槓桿仰臥背部伸展
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead.
Squeeze your glutes to stabilize.
Lift your chest and arms off the floor.
在頂部短暫停頓。
控制着慢慢放下。
Keep your neck neutral by looking down.

4928.name: 坐姿小腿伸展 v. 2
instructions: Sit with one leg straight in front of you.
Loop your hands or a strap around the ball of your foot.
Gently pull your toes toward you.
Feel the stretch in the calf.
換腿。

4929.name: 仰臥小腿伸展
instructions: Lie on your back and lift one leg toward the ceiling.
Hold behind the thigh or use a strap on your foot.
Pull your toes toward your shin.
Keep the knee as straight as you comfortably can.
換腿。

4930.name: 弓步伸展
instructions: Step one foot forward into a lunge, back knee down on a mat.
上身保持挺直。
Push your hips gently forward.
Feel the stretch in the front of the back hip and thigh.
換腿。

4931.name: 單腿小腿伸展
instructions: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and heel on the floor.
Place your hands on the wall.
Lean forward with a straight back leg.
Feel the stretch in the calf.
換腿。

4933.name: 站姿腿部繞圈
instructions: Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Lift one leg slightly off the floor.
Draw a smooth circle with the leg.
Keep your torso still.
Reverse the direction after several reps.
換腿。

4934.name: 反向棒式 v. 2
instructions: Sit with your legs straight and your hands behind you.
Press into your hands and lift your hips.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Keep your chin neutral.
Squeeze your glutes.

4939.name: 超人式划船
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Pull your elbows back toward your ribs as if rowing.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Extend your arms forward again.
頸部保持中立。

4944.name: 站姿屈膝8字
instructions: Stand tall and hold a support if needed.
Lift one knee in front of you.
Trace a slow figure eight with your knee.
Keep your standing leg steady.
上身保持挺直。
換腿。

4945.name: 挺胸雙手背後(停留)
instructions: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms.
Lift your chest and gently raise your hands.
Feel the stretch across the chest and shoulders.
慢慢放鬆。

4948.name: 滑輪跪姿單臂背闊肌下拉
instructions: Kneel facing the cable stack and grab the handle with one hand.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handle down toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your lat at the bottom.
Let the arm rise back up slowly.
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

4950.name: 徒手前弓步(小步幅軀幹直立)

4951.name: 槓桿式擺錘深蹲(槓片負重)

4957.name: 仰臥背闊肌下拉
instructions: Lie on a bench under a high pulley.
Grab the bar overhand.
Pull the bar down toward your chest.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly with straight arms.
收緊內核。

4958.name: 滑輪過頭單臂三頭伸展(繩索握把)
instructions: Hold a rope with one hand overhead and face away from the stack.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Extend your elbow until the arm is straight.
Squeeze the triceps.
慢慢放下。
Finish reps, then switch arms.

4959.name: 弓步大腿(姿勢檢查)
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width.
Step forward into a lunge.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
上身保持挺直。
Push back up to the start.
Compare with the incorrect position to correct your form.

4960.name: 滑輪高位三頭伸展
instructions: Set the cable high and face it.
Hold the attachment with elbows bent.
Press down by extending your elbows.
Squeeze at the bottom.
慢慢回到起始位置。
Keep your elbows near your sides.

4961.name: 啞鈴俯臥三頭後踢
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding dumbbells.
Bend your elbows to 90 degrees and keep your upper arms close.
Extend your elbows until your arms are straight.
Squeeze the triceps.
慢慢放下。
上臂保持靜止。

4962.name: 槓鈴箱式深蹲
instructions: Place a box behind you and a barbell on your upper back.
Push your hips back and sit onto the box.
Pause briefly without relaxing.
Drive through your feet to stand.
抬起胸口。
膝蓋方向與腳尖一致。

4963.name: 壺鈴箱式深蹲
instructions: Stand in front of a box holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Push your hips back and sit onto the box.
短暫停頓。
Drive through your feet to stand.
抬起胸口。
Keep your elbows close.

4964.name: 跳躍聳肩
instructions: Stand holding a barbell at hip height.
Dip slightly with your knees.
Jump explosively and extend fully.
Shrug your shoulders at the top.
屈膝輕輕落地。
Keep the bar close to your body.

4965.name: 跳箱 v. 2
instructions: Stand facing a box with feet shoulder width.
Dip and swing your arms back.
Jump onto the box with both feet.
屈膝輕輕落地。
Stand tall on the box.
Step down carefully.

4966.name: 下方推
instructions: Hold a barbell overhead with a wide grip.
Press up so your arms lock out.
Drop into a squat while keeping the bar overhead.
Keep your arms locked.
Stand up tall.
收緊內核。

4967.name: 側平舉手臂(姿勢檢查)
instructions: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides.
Stop at shoulder height.
慢慢放下。
肘部保持微微彎曲。
Compare with the incorrect position to correct your form.

4968.name: 四足跪姿腿彎舉
instructions: Get on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
收緊內核。
Curl one heel toward your glutes.
Squeeze the hamstring.
慢慢放下。
Finish reps, then switch legs.

4970.name: 輔助引體向上(深蹲姿勢)
instructions: Grab a bar with an underhand grip.
Bend your knees into a squat position.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Use your legs only as much as you need.
慢慢放下。
Keep your shoulders down.

4971.name: 徒手單腿羅馬尼亞硬舉
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Hinge forward as the other leg lifts behind you.
背部貼緊地面。
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

4972.name: 下斜仰臥起坐加俄羅斯轉體

4973.name: 啞鈴上斜二頭彎舉(70度)
instructions: Set a bench to 70 degrees and sit back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang by your sides, palms forward.
Curl the weights up without moving your elbows.
在頂部夾緊二頭肌。
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
Keep your back against the bench.

4974.name: 地板反向划船滑行
instructions: Lie under a bar or lower support with sliders under your heels.
Grab the bar overhand.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Keep your body straight.
慢慢放下。
Keep your hips up.

4976.name: 登山者跳
instructions: 從高位平板支撐開始。
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs with a small jump.
Keep your hips low.
Maintain a fast, steady pace.
Rest when your form slips.

4980.name: 地板反向交替踢腿(手放頭下) v. 2

4984.name: 跪姿改良印度伏地挺身

4985.name: 彈力帶輔助地板腿後肌臀肌挺身

4986.name: 啞鈴登階 v. 2
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing a sturdy bench.
Place one foot fully on the bench.
Drive through that heel to stand up tall on the bench.
Lower your trailing foot back down under control.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

4987.name: 仰臥腿部8字
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands under your hips and legs lifted.
將下背壓向地面。
Trace a figure eight in the air with your feet, slowly and in control.
Keep your legs close together.
Change direction halfway through the set.

4991.name: 側棒式旋轉
instructions: Set up in a side plank on one forearm or hand with your top arm raised.
Lift your hips so your body is in a straight line.
Thread your top arm under your torso, rotating your chest toward the floor.
Rotate back and reach the arm up to the ceiling.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

5001.name: 啞鈴坐姿肩外旋
instructions: Sit holding a light dumbbell with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked to your side.
Rest your arm on your thigh or a pad for support.
Rotate your forearm upward and outward, keeping the elbow in place.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower slowly, then switch arms after your reps.

5002.name: 啞鈴單臂y字上舉
instructions: Hold a light dumbbell in one hand and hinge slightly or lie chest down on an incline bench.
Start with your arm hanging down.
Raise your arm diagonally overhead to form a Y with your thumb up.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly, finish your reps, and switch sides.

5003.name: 站姿單腿提踵(階梯)
instructions: Stand on the edge of a stair on one foot, holding the rail for balance.
Let your heel drop below the step.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your set.

5004.name: 懸吊帶相撲深蹲
instructions: Stand facing the anchor holding the handles with a wide stance.
Turn your toes out slightly.
Sit your hips down, keeping knees over toes.
Use the straps lightly for balance.
Push through your heels to stand.
在頂部夾緊臀部。

5005.name: 彈力帶坐姿反握划船
instructions: Sit with your legs extended and the band looped around your feet.
Hold the band ends with an underhand grip, arms straight.
Pull your hands toward your lower ribs, keeping elbows close.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
慢慢回到起始位置。

5006.name: 懸吊帶反握反向划船
instructions: Hold the handles palms up and lean back with a straight body.
收緊內核。
Pull your chest toward your hands.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Lower yourself slowly.
Walk your feet forward to make it harder.

5007.name: 懸吊帶錘式彎舉
instructions: Hold the handles with palms facing each other and lean back.
身體保持一條直線。
Curl your hands toward your head.
Keep your elbows high and still.
Lower slowly until arms are straight.
收緊內核。

5008.name: 懸吊帶引體向上
instructions: Hold the handles palms facing you and lean back.
Brace your core and keep your body straight.
Pull your chest toward the handles.
Squeeze your elbows close to your sides.
控制着慢慢放下。
Adjust your foot position to change difficulty.

5024.name: 彈力帶前鋸肌靠牆滑動

5026.name: 彈力帶前鋸肌靠牆滑動(泡沫軸)

5027.name: 泡沫軸前鋸肌靠牆滑動

5028.name: 啞鈴高腳杯分腿蹲 v. 2
instructions: Hold a dumbbell vertically at your chest and step into a long split stance.
上身保持挺直。
將後側膝蓋向地面靠近。
Drive through your front heel to stand back up.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

5031.name: 藥球仰臥抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with a medicine ball squeezed between your feet.
將下背壓向地面。
Raise your legs until they are vertical.
Lower them slowly without letting your back arch.
Keep your grip on the ball firm.

5033.name: 滑輪單臂三頭下壓(繩索握把)

5034.name: 地雷管單臂俯身划船 v. 2

5036.name: 健身球腿彎舉
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on a stability ball.
抬起髖部形成橋式。
Curl the ball toward your glutes by bending your knees.
Extend your legs again slowly.
Keep your hips high the whole time.

5038.name: 雙搖跳繩
instructions: Hold a jump rope with the handles at your hips.
Jump slightly higher than normal.
Spin the rope fast with your wrists so it passes twice under your feet.
用前腳掌輕輕落地。
Rest between short rounds as needed.

5041.name: 俯臥t字
instructions: Lie face down with arms straight out to the sides, thumbs up.
頸部保持中立。
Lift your arms off the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades.
Hold briefly.
慢慢放下。

5042.name: 俯臥w字
instructions: Lie face down with elbows bent and hands by your head.
頸部保持中立。
Lift your elbows and hands off the floor, pulling the shoulder blades together.
Hold for a second.
控制着慢慢放下。

5047.name: 屈腿側橋式
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and your forearm under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from shoulder to knee.
Keep your hips stacked and core tight.
Lower and switch sides.

5049.name: 超人式w
instructions: Lie face down with elbows bent and hands by your head.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lift your chest, arms and legs slightly off the floor.
Pull your shoulder blades together and hold for a second.
慢慢放下。

5050.name: 仰臥交替觸碰腳尖地板

5051.name: 腿後肌臀肌訓練椅轉體
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat and arms out wide.
抬起髖部形成橋式。
Rotate your knees and hips to one side.
Return to center and rotate to the other side.
Stay controlled and keep your shoulders on the floor.

5052.name: 階梯單腿提踵
instructions: Stand on one foot on the edge of a step, holding a rail for balance.
Let your heel lower below the step.
Rise as high as possible on your toes.
短暫停頓。
Lower slowly, then switch legs.

5054.name: 螃蟹式
instructions: Sit with knees bent and hands behind you, fingers pointing toward your feet.
Press into your hands and feet.
Lift your hips until your torso is flat.
Let your head relax back gently.

5055.name: 死懸掛伸展
instructions: Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder width apart.
Hang with your arms straight and feet off the floor.
Relax your shoulders and let your body lengthen.
Breathe steadily.

5058.name: 跪姿頸部伸展
instructions: Kneel tall with your back straight.
Tilt your head to one side, ear toward shoulder.
Place a hand lightly on your head for a gentle pull.
Keep the opposite shoulder low.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

5059.name: 腳跟下壓
instructions: Stand with the ball of one foot on a low step or wall, heel on the floor.
Hold something for balance.
Press your heel gently down and back.
Keep your knee straight for the calf.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換腿。

5060.name: 俯臥頸部伸展
instructions: Lie face down with your forehead on the floor or a towel.
Keep your arms by your sides.
Slowly lift your head a few inches, keeping your chin tucked.
短暫停頓。
慢慢放下並重復。

5061.name: 俯臥頸部伸展等長握持

5064.name: 啞鈴跪姿握持站起(高拉握法)
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front and hold dumbbells at your shoulders.
收緊內核，抬起胸口。
Drive through the front foot to stand tall.
Lower back down under control to half kneeling.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

5067.name: 啞鈴上斜夾擠推舉
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie back with dumbbells pressed together over your chest.
Keep squeezing them against each other the whole set.
Lower them slowly to your upper chest.
推回到手臂伸直。
Keep your shoulder blades pinched back and feet planted.

5070.name: 壺鈴後弓步
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and front heel down.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

5078.name: 坐姿胸部蚌式開合
instructions: Sit tall with your fingers lightly behind your head.
Start with your elbows pointing forward.
Slowly open your elbows out and back as far as is comfortable.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸均勻。

5079.name: 地板飛鳥
instructions: Lie on your back holding dumbbells above your chest, palms facing in.
肘部保持微微彎曲。
Open your arms out until your upper arms touch the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the weights back together.
Keep your wrists straight and the motion slow.

5080.name: 掌心向上掌心向下旋轉

5087.name: 滑輪肩外旋(90度)
instructions: Set a cable at shoulder height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with your upper arm out at 90 degrees and elbow bent 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm up and back without moving your upper arm.
Pause, then return slowly.
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

5088.name: 滑輪肩內旋
instructions: Set a cable at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with your elbow tucked against your side at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm across your stomach.
Return slowly, keeping your elbow pinned.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

5089.name: 滑輪肩內旋(90度)
instructions: Set a cable at shoulder height and face away from it.
Hold the handle with your upper arm out at 90 degrees and elbow bent 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm forward and down, keeping your upper arm still.
Pause, then return slowly.
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

5090.name: 滑輪站姿划船
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and hold the handle, stepping back until there is tension.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Pull the handle toward your ribs, driving your elbows back.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

5092.name: 啞鈴單臂反握前平舉
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing forward.
收緊內核。
Raise the dumbbell in front of you to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly to your thigh.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.

5093.name: 啞鈴單臂地板推舉
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, holding a dumbbell at chest level.
Rest your other arm on the floor.
Press the dumbbell straight up until your arm is straight.
Lower it until your upper arm touches the floor.
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

5095.name: 啞鈴單臂過頭弓步
instructions: Press a dumbbell overhead with one arm and lock it out.
Step forward into a lunge.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return.
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

5096.name: 單臂過頭啞鈴深蹲
instructions: Press a dumbbell overhead with one arm and keep it locked out.
雙腳分開與肩同寬站立。
Sit your hips back and down into a squat.
Keep your ribs down and the weight over your shoulder.
Drive up to standing, then switch arms after your reps.

5097.name: 啞鈴單臂交替下斜臥推
instructions: Lie on a decline bench holding a dumbbell in each hand over your chest.
Lower one dumbbell to the side of your chest.
Press it back up until your arm is straight.
換另一隻手臂重複。
Keep your core tight and the bench-side arm steady.

5105.name: 交叉開合跳
instructions: Stand with your feet together and arms by your sides.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead.
Jump again, crossing your legs and your arms in front of you.
用前腳掌輕輕落地。
Keep a steady rhythm and continue for 30-60 seconds.

5106.name: 交替點腳尖抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs raised straight up.
將下背壓向地面。
Reach one leg up so your toes tap toward the ceiling.
Alternate legs with control.
Keep your core tight and breathe steadily.

5107.name: 羅馬椅抬腿
instructions: Rest your forearms on the pads and press your back against the support.
Let your legs hang straight down.
Raise your knees or straight legs to hip height or higher.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.

5119.name: 啞鈴硬舉 v. 2
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, dumbbells at your sides or in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees slightly.
Lower the dumbbells along your legs with a flat back.
髖部向前送，站直身體。
在頂部夾緊臀部。

5121.name: 啞鈴相撲深蹲
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding a dumbbell with both hands in front of you.
Keep your chest tall.
Sit down until your thighs are about parallel.
Push your knees out over your toes.
腳後跟發力站起。

5124.name: 側跳轉體
instructions: Stand with your feet together and arms bent.
Jump and twist your hips and legs to one side while your shoulders face forward.
用前腳掌輕輕落地。
Jump again and twist to the other side.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-45 seconds.

5128.name: 坐姿背部夾擠
instructions: Sit tall with arms at your sides or elbows bent.
Draw your shoulder blades back and together.
Hold the squeeze for 2-3 seconds.
慢慢放鬆。
Keep your neck relaxed.
Repeat for your reps.

5133.name: 坐姿背後上舉
instructions: Sit tall with hands clasped behind your back.
Straighten your arms.
Lift your hands slightly away from your body.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
慢慢放下。
Keep your chest lifted.

5135.name: 坐姿旋轉伸展
instructions: Sit tall with legs crossed or extended.
Place one hand behind you and the other on the opposite knee.
Rotate your torso toward the back hand.
Keep your spine long.
換邊。

5142.name: 史密斯機懸垂高拉
instructions: Stand at the bar with it hanging at your knees, hands just outside your legs.
背部貼緊地面。
Extend your hips and shrug explosively.
Pull your elbows high and catch the bar on your shoulders.
Lower the bar back to your knees and repeat.

5146.name: 懸掛槓背部伸展
instructions: Hold a bar with an overhand grip.
Lean your body back and let your arms and shoulders lengthen.
Relax your ribs and breathe slowly.
Step out of the stretch carefully.

5147.name: 彈力帶輔助前架位伸展
instructions: Loop a band around a sturdy anchor and hold it with both hands in a front rack position.
Step back and let the band help your elbows lift.
Keep your elbows high and chest tall.
Release the tension slowly.

5152.name: 徒手跪姿握持站起
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front.
Hold your arms in front of you for balance.
Drive through the front foot to stand tall.
Lower back down under control.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

5154.name: 側向登階
instructions: Stand sideways next to a box.
Place your near foot on the box.
Press through that foot to step up.
Lower back down slowly.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

5155.name: 側向登階加提膝
instructions: Stand sideways next to a box with one foot on top.
Press through that foot to step up.
Drive your other knee up toward your chest.
Lower back down with control.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

5157.name: 手肘棒式開合跳
instructions: Get into a forearm plank with your elbows under your shoulders.
身體保持一條直線。
Jump your feet wide apart.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and continue for 20-40 seconds.

5158.name: 毛巾棒式開合跳滑行
instructions: Put your feet on towels on a smooth floor and get into a high plank.
收緊內核。
Slide your feet wide apart.
Slide them back together.
Keep your hips level and repeat.

5160.name: 上斜窄距伏地挺身
instructions: Place your hands close together on a bench or sturdy box, just under your chest.
Step back until your body is straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the edge, elbows tucked close to your ribs.
推回到手臂伸直。
Keep your hips from sagging throughout.

5162.name: 坐姿頸部伸展
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Place one hand on the back of your head.
Gently guide your chin toward your chest until you feel a stretch.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
Release slowly and repeat.

5165.name: 毛巾棒式屈體滑行
instructions: Put your toes on towels on a smooth floor and get into a straight-arm plank.
Brace your abs and keep your arms straight.
Slide your feet toward your hands as your hips rise into a pike.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Slide your feet back to the plank without letting your hips drop.

5166.name: 單腿跳箱
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box on one foot.
Swing your arms and dip into a short quarter squat.
Jump up and land softly on the box on the same foot.
Stand tall, then step down carefully.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

5178.name: 槓桿式單腿伸展(槓片負重)

5179.name: 滑輪站姿窄握划船
instructions: Attach a close grip handle to a cable at chest height and step back.
Stand with a slight knee bend and a braced core.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs, elbows close to your body.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

5187.name: 波比跳跳遠加伏地挺身

5193.name: 動力雪橇後退拖行 v. 2

5195.name: 坐姿頸部側向伸展
instructions: Sit tall and relax your shoulders.
Tilt your ear toward one shoulder.
Rest your hand lightly on your head for a gentle added stretch.
Return to centre and switch sides.

5198.name: 單直腿臀橋停留
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Straighten one leg.
Lift your hips with the planted foot.
Hold with hips level.
Lower and switch legs.

5201.name: 啞鈴服務生二頭彎舉
instructions: 站直，雙手各握一啞鈴，掌心朝前。
上手臂貼緊身體兩側，手肘微收。
慢慢將啞鈴向上彎舉向肩膀，手腕打直。
頂峰停頓片刻，慢慢降回。
重複所需次數。

5205.name: 彈力帶過頭肩推
instructions: Stand on the middle of the band and hold a handle in each hand at your shoulders.
Brace your abs and stand tall.
Press both handles overhead until your arms are straight.
短暫停頓。
Lower slowly back to shoulder height.

5206.name: 彈力帶跪姿腹肌捲腹 v. 2

5213.name: 登山者 v. 2
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
收緊內核。
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips low and level.
Continue for 20-40 seconds.

5223.name: 史密斯機寬握聳肩
instructions: Set the bar at thigh height and grip it wider than shoulder width.
Stand tall with your arms straight.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly without rolling your shoulders.

5224.name: 槓鈴寬握聳肩
instructions: Stand holding a barbell in front with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and your chest up.
Lift your shoulders straight toward your ears.
Hold the top for a second.
控制着慢慢放下。

5225.name: 史密斯機背後寬握聳肩
instructions: Stand with your back to the bar, set at thigh height, and grip it wide behind you.
Lift the bar off the hooks and stand tall.
Shrug your shoulders straight up.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly and keep your arms straight.

5232.name: 啞鈴硬舉接俯身划船
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Row the dumbbells toward your lower ribs.
夾緊肩胛骨。
Lower the weights slowly and stand back up.

5237.name: 單啞鈴下斜過頭仰臥起坐
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Hold one dumbbell with both hands above your head.
Curl up and sit forward, keeping the weight overhead.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly to the start.

5239.name: 健身球啞鈴二頭彎舉加過頭伸展

5241.name: 老派反向背部伸展
instructions: Lie face down over a bench with your hips at the edge.
Hold the bench and keep your legs hanging down.
