Lift your legs behind you until your body is straight.
Pause and squeeze your glutes.
慢慢放下，不要借擺動。

5243.name: 滑輪仰臥三頭伸展(低位)
instructions: Lie on a bench with a low pulley behind your head.
Hold the bar or rope with your arms up over your face.
上臂保持靜止。
Bend your elbows to lower the handle toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back up.

5250.name: 仰臥單車捲腹
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Extend one leg while turning your opposite elbow toward the other knee.
Switch sides in a smooth pedalling motion.
下背保持貼緊凳面。

5274.name: 仰臥屈膝捲腹
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended just off the floor.
Place your hands behind your head.
Pull your knees in and crunch your chest toward them.
在頂部收緊腹部。
Extend and lower slowly.

5277.name: 徒手臀肌導向登階
instructions: Stand in front of a bench and place one foot on it.
Lean your torso slightly forward.
Press through your heel and step up until standing.
Lower slowly back down.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

5278.name: 跪姿錯位伏地挺身
instructions: Kneel and place your hands on the floor, one slightly forward of the other.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
將胸口向地面靠近。
推回起始位置。
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Switch hand positions on the next set.

5286.name: 站姿手部位置(旋前旋後中立)

5297.name: 滑輪跪姿牧師椅彎舉
instructions: Kneel in front of a bench with a low cable beside you.
Rest your upper arms on the pad.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulders.
在頂部夾緊二頭肌。
慢慢放下直到手臂伸直。

5299.name: 槓桿式牧師椅彎舉(轉體)
instructions: Sit at the machine and adjust the seat so your arms rest on the pad.
Turn your torso slightly toward the working arm.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
在頂部收緊。
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

5301.name: 壺鈴墊高完整深蹲
instructions: Stand on a low platform holding a kettlebell at chest height.
收緊內核。
Sit your hips down as deep as you can.
Keep your chest up and heels down.
Drive through your feet to stand.
Keep the kettlebell close to your body.

5303.name: 啞鈴後三角飛鳥(45度)
instructions: Set a bench to 45 degrees and lie chest down on it, a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang below you with a soft bend in the elbows.
Raise the weights out to the sides until your arms are level with your torso.
在頂部將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
控制着慢慢放下。
Keep your neck neutral and avoid swinging.

5304.name: 六角槓深蹲
instructions: Stand inside the trap bar with feet shoulder-width apart and grip the handles.
Brace your core and keep your chest tall.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your whole foot to stand up.
Lock out your hips at the top without leaning back.
膝蓋方向與腳尖一致。

5307.name: 地雷管單腿直腿硬舉
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar in front of you with both hands.
單腿站立，膝蓋微屈。
Hinge at the hips and lower the bar while your free leg reaches back.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Squeeze your glutes to return to standing.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

5308.name: ez槓俄羅斯轉體仰臥起坐
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold the EZ bar over your chest.
Curl up into a sit-up position.
At the top, rotate your torso to one side, moving the bar with you.
Rotate back to center and lower yourself with control.
每次都換邊。
Keep the weight light enough to move smoothly.

5310.name: 墊高側弓步
instructions: Stand tall next to a low step or platform.
Step one foot sideways onto the platform.
Push your hips back and bend that knee while the other leg stays straight.
Keep your chest up and the planted foot flat.
Push back to the start.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

5311.name: 健身球前鋸肌靠牆滑動

5312.name: 墊高後弓步
instructions: Stand on a low step with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and down off the step.
Lower until the front thigh is about parallel.
Keep your torso tall and front knee stable.
Push through the front heel to return to the step.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

5314.name: 啞鈴臀肌導向登階
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and face a bench or box.
Place one foot fully on the box and lean your torso slightly forward.
Push through the heel of that foot to stand up.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
控制着慢慢放下。
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

5315.name: 滑輪臀肌導向登階
instructions: Hold the cable handle and stand facing a step.
Place one foot on the step.
Lean slightly forward from the hips.
Drive through the heel to stand up.
慢慢放下。
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

5316.name: 史密斯機俯身窄握旋前划船
instructions: Set the bar at knee height and grip it with hands close together, palms down.
Hinge forward with a flat back and unlock the bar.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Lower the bar slowly.
Keep your hips back and torso still.

5317.name: 彈力帶拉開(45度)
instructions: Hold a resistance band in both hands in front of you.
Raise your arms to about 45 degrees above horizontal.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
慢慢回到起始位置。
Keep your ribs down and your shoulders away from your ears.

5326.name: 槓桿式多模式繩索背闊肌下拉

5327.name: 槓桿式t槓羅馬尼亞硬舉

5330.name: 啞鈴仰臥拉舉 v. 2
instructions: Lie across or along a bench holding one dumbbell with both hands over your chest.
肘部保持微微彎曲。
Lower the dumbbell back behind your head in an arc.
Feel the stretch through your chest and lats.
Pull it back over your chest.
Keep your hips low and ribs down.

5333.name: 槓桿式軀幹旋轉
instructions: Sit in the machine and adjust the pads so your hips are fixed.
Hold the handles or brace your arms on the pads.
Rotate your torso to one side in a smooth motion.
Pause briefly at the end.
Return to center slowly.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

5334.name: 交叉扭轉仰臥起坐 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Sit up while rotating your torso.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower back down slowly.
每次都換邊。
Avoid pulling on your neck.

5335.name: 壺鈴擺盪高拉前蹲過頭推舉

5337.name: 波比跳伏地挺身登山者組合

5344.name: v字起身停留
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Lift your legs and straighten them to form a V.
Reach your arms forward alongside your legs.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Keep your chest open and back from rounding.
控制着慢慢放下。

5349.name: 槓桿式外展抬腿
instructions: Set up in the machine with the pad on the outside of your leg.
Hold the supports for stability.
Raise your leg out to the side in a controlled motion.
在頂部暫停。
慢慢放下。
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

5369.name: 滑輪跪姿單臂划船
instructions: Kneel facing the cable stack and grab the handle with one hand.
Keep your torso upright and core braced.
Pull your elbow back toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
慢慢回到起始位置。
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

5370.name: 滑輪站姿單臂錘式彎舉(繩索)
instructions: Attach the rope to a low pulley and hold it with one hand, thumb up.
Stand tall with your elbow tucked in.
Curl the rope toward your shoulder.
Squeeze the top for a second.
慢慢放下。
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

5371.name: 地板仰臥滾軸頸部旋轉
instructions: Lie on your back with the roller under the base of your skull.
Place the roller under the neck and let your body weight settle onto it.
Gently turn your head slowly from side to side.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5372.name: 地板仰臥滾軸頸部減壓
instructions: Lie on your back with the roller under the base of your skull.
Place the roller under the neck and let your body weight settle onto it.
Gently nod your chin and let your head relax into the roller.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5373.name: 靠牆站姿滾軸前臂放鬆
instructions: Stand facing a wall with the roller held against it.
Place the roller under the forearm and let your body weight settle onto it.
Lean in and roll your forearm up and down the roller.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5374.name: 地板仰臥滾軸二頭肌放鬆
instructions: Lie face down with the roller under one upper arm.
Place the roller under the biceps and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly from the elbow toward the shoulder.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5375.name: 地板側臥滾軸三頭肌放鬆
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under the back of your upper arm.
Place the roller under the triceps and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly from the elbow toward the armpit.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5376.name: 地板仰臥滾軸擴胸放鬆
instructions: Lie lengthwise on the roller along your spine with knees bent.
Place the roller under the chest and let your body weight settle onto it.
Open your arms out to the sides and let your chest relax.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5377.name: 地板仰臥滾軸胸部放鬆
instructions: Lie face down with the roller under one side of your chest.
Place the roller under the chest and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly side to side across the muscle.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5378.name: 地板仰臥滾軸前肩與胸部放鬆
instructions: Lie face down with the roller under your front shoulder.
Place the roller under the front shoulder and chest and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll small amounts toward the chest and back.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5379.name: 地板仰臥滾軸肩後側放鬆
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under your rear shoulder.
Place the roller under the back of the shoulder and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly along the back of the shoulder.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5380.name: 地板仰臥滾軸肩後旋放鬆
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under your upper back.
Place the roller under the shoulder and upper back and let your body weight settle onto it.
Rotate your top arm back and forth to open the shoulder.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5381.name: 滾軸菱形肌放鬆
instructions: Sit with the roller behind your upper back and cross your arms.
Place the roller under the rhomboids and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll up and down between your shoulder blades.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5382.name: 地板仰臥滾軸中背放鬆
instructions: Lie on your back with the roller under your mid back, hands behind your head.
Place the roller under the middle back and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly up and down.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5383.name: 地板仰臥滾軸下背(側面)放鬆
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under your lower back.
Place the roller under the side of the lower back and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly up and down in a small range.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5384.name: 地板仰臥滾軸胸椎放鬆
instructions: Lie on your back with the roller under your upper back, arms crossed.
Place the roller under the thoracic spine and let your body weight settle onto it.
Lift your hips and roll up and down the upper back.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5385.name: 地板仰臥滾軸肩胛前伸放鬆
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under your shoulder blade.
Place the roller under the shoulder blade and let your body weight settle onto it.
Reach your top arm forward and back as you roll.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5386.name: 地板仰臥滾軸環繞世界
instructions: Lie on your back with the roller under your upper back.
Place the roller under the upper back and shoulders and let your body weight settle onto it.
Sweep your arms in a wide arc overhead, like a snow angel.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5387.name: 地板仰臥滾軸豎脊肌放鬆
instructions: Lie on your back with the roller under your lower back.
Place the roller under the lower back muscles and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly with small movements and keep your core engaged.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5388.name: 滾軸跪姿上背旋轉
instructions: Kneel beside the roller and place one hand on it.
Place the roller under the upper back and let your body weight settle onto it.
Slide the roller forward as you rotate your chest open.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5389.name: 滾軸鴿式伸展
instructions: Sit on the roller and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Place the roller under the glutes and hip and let your body weight settle onto it.
Lean toward the crossed leg and roll gently.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5390.name: 地板坐姿滾軸臀部放鬆
instructions: Sit on the roller with your hands behind you.
Place the roller under the glutes and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly back and forth under your glutes.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5391.name: 地板仰臥滾軸臀部扭轉放鬆
instructions: Lie on your back with the roller under one glute.
Place the roller under the glutes and let your body weight settle onto it.
Let the knees drop to one side and twist gently.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5392.name: 地板坐姿滾軸腿後肌與臀部放鬆
instructions: Sit with the roller under your thighs and hands behind you.
Place the roller under the hamstrings and glutes and let your body weight settle onto it.
Lift your hips and roll from the knee toward the glutes.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5393.name: 地板仰臥滾軸股四頭肌(股外側肌)放鬆
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under the outer thigh.
Place the roller under the outer thigh and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll from the hip down to above the knee.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5394.name: 滾軸脛前肌放鬆
instructions: Kneel on all fours with the roller under your shins.
Place the roller under the shin and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll gently from below the knee to the ankle.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5395.name: 地板仰臥滾軸脛前肌(單腿)放鬆
instructions: Rest one shin on the roller, supporting yourself on your hands.
Place the roller under the shin and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll gently from below the knee to the ankle, then switch legs.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5396.name: 地板側臥滾軸腓骨肌放鬆
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under your outer lower leg.
Place the roller under the outer lower leg and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll gently from the knee to the ankle.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5397.name: 地板側臥滾軸腓骨肌(單腿)放鬆
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under the outer lower leg, other foot behind for support.
Place the roller under the outer lower leg and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll gently from the knee to the ankle, then switch legs.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5398.name: 滾軸足底放鬆
instructions: Stand or sit with the roller under one foot.
Place the roller under the sole of the foot and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll the sole from heel to toes, then switch feet.
在痠痛點停留，慢慢呼吸 20-30 秒。
收緊內核，避免在關節或骨骼處滾動。
滾動 30-60 秒，如需要就換邊。

5399.name: 棍棒輔助等長核心
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold a stick in both hands.
Raise the stick to the position you are cued for and keep your arms steady.
Brace your abs as if preparing for a light punch and tuck the ribs down.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸均勻。
Lower the stick slowly and shake out your arms.

5401.name: 棍棒肩部伸展
instructions: Stand tall and hold the stick behind your back with both hands.
Keep your arms straight and lift the stick slightly away from your body.
Stay tall and avoid arching your lower back.
Release slowly and repeat.

5402.name: 棍棒弓步過頭上舉伸展

5406.name: 棍棒側向轉前彎伸展
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold the stick overhead.
Bend sideways to one side and hold briefly.
Then turn the torso forward and fold from your hips with a long back.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, then rise slowly.
在另一側重複。

5407.name: 棍棒過頭完整相撲深蹲伸展

5447.name: 槓桿式旋前握坐姿划船(槓片負重)
instructions: Sit at the machine with your chest on the pad.
Grab the handles with palms facing down.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
短暫停頓。
Return slowly until your arms extend.
Keep your torso steady.

5448.name: 槓桿式旋前握坐姿肩胛後縮聳肩(槓片負重)

5449.name: 啞鈴站姿拖曳彎舉 v. 2

5458.name: 啞鈴站姿單臂交叉上舉
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell by your opposite hip.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise the dumbbell diagonally up and across to head height.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
慢慢放下。
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

5460.name: 爆發式伏地挺身
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
將胸口向地面靠近。
Push up explosively so your hands lift off.
Land softly with bent elbows.
Go straight into the next rep.
身體保持一條直線。

5466.name: 前棒式加手腳抬起(姿勢檢查)
instructions: Start in a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Hold for a couple of seconds.
Return and switch sides.
髖部保持水平。

5470.name: 滑輪臀中肌後踢
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and clip it to one ankle.
Stand side-on to the stack, hold the frame and keep your torso tall.
Sweep the working leg out and slightly back, leading with the heel.
Pause briefly, then return slowly without leaning.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

5482.name: 單腿跳
instructions: 單腿站立，膝蓋微屈，雙臂準備。
用腳踝與膝蓋發力向上、向前跳，或原地跳。
用同一只腳的前腳掌輕柔落地。
保持平衡，髖部保持水平。
完成所有次數，然後換腿。
5482.description: 低衝擊的單腿跳躍，提升踝關節剛度、平衡與腿部力量。

5484.name: 負重坐姿單腿提踵 v. 2

5513.name: 健身球長凳撐體
instructions: Sit on a bench edge with hands beside your hips and heels on a stability ball.
Slide your hips off the bench with arms straight.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees, keeping them close.
推回到手臂伸直。
Keep your shoulders down and the ball steady.

5517.name: 反握反向划船
instructions: Lie under a bar set at about waist height and grip it with palms facing you.
Hang with your body straight and heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower with control until your arms are straight.

5518.name: 滑輪跪姿前傾單臂划船

5527.name: 槓桿式坐姿俯身後三角飛鳥
instructions: Sit on the machine with your chest on the pad and grip the handles.
肘部保持微微彎曲。
Open your arms out and back, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause, then return slowly.
Do not shrug.

5528.name: 滑輪站姿交叉過頭三頭伸展

5529.name: 負重完整深蹲加過頭推舉

5553.name: 滑輪坐姿背闊肌導向划船
instructions: Sit at the cable row with feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grab the handle and lean back slightly.
Pull your elbows down and back toward your hips.
Squeeze your lats, then extend slowly.
抬起胸口。

5557.name: 靠門站姿胸部伸展
instructions: Stand in a doorway with your forearm against the frame, elbow at shoulder height.
Step through gently with the opposite foot.
Turn away until you feel a chest stretch.
換邊。

5576.name: 槓桿式單臂上斜胸推(槓片負重)

5581.name: 滑輪跪姿單臂背闊肌下拉

5606.name: 啞鈴俯臥後三角擺動
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Swing the weights out and up to shoulder height.
慢慢放下。
Keep your torso still.

5607.name: 彈力帶面拉
instructions: Anchor a band at head height and hold the ends.
Step back to create tension.
Pull the band toward your face, elbows high.
夾緊肩胛骨。
慢慢回到起始位置。

5608.name: 彈力帶站姿胸推 v. 2
instructions: Anchor a band behind you and hold the ends at chest height.
Stand in a split stance for balance.
Press your hands forward until arms are straight.
慢慢回到起始位置。
收緊內核。

5609.name: 滑輪站姿面拉
instructions: Set a cable at upper chest height with a handle.
Stand tall and pull toward your face.
Spread your hands apart at the end.
夾緊肩胛骨。
慢慢回到起始位置。

5628.name: 地雷管哈克深蹲
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder width.
Squat down with your chest up.
腳後跟發力站起。
Keep the bar close.

5631.name: 啞鈴站姿屈臂側平舉
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with elbows bent about 90 degrees.
Raise your elbows out to the sides to shoulder height.
短暫停頓。
慢慢放下。
Avoid swinging.

5632.name: 槓鈴肩寬握直立划船
instructions: Stand holding a barbell at your thighs with hands shoulder width.
Pull the bar up along your body.
Lead with your elbows up to chest height.
慢慢放下。
Keep the bar close.

5633.name: 槓鈴窄站距深蹲 v. 2
instructions: Rest a barbell on your upper back with feet close together.
收緊內核。
Squat down with your chest up.
Stand back up through your feet.
膝蓋方向與腳尖一致。

5634.name: 啞鈴窄站距深蹲
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides with feet close together.
收緊內核。
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up to stand.
Keep your heels down.

5635.name: 啞鈴屈臂側平舉
instructions: Stand with dumbbells and elbows bent.
Raise your elbows out to shoulder height.
在頂部暫停。
慢慢放下。
Keep your torso still.

5636.name: 地雷管跪姿單臂肩推 v. 2
instructions: Kneel holding the end of a landmine bar at your shoulder.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
慢慢放下。
Switch sides after your set.

5637.name: 上斜伏地挺身(長凳)
instructions: Place hands on a bench slightly wider than shoulders.
Walk your feet back into a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bench.
推回起始位置。
收緊內核。

5649.name: 空心搖擺
instructions: Lie on your back and lift your arms and legs into a hollow position.
將下背壓向地面。
Rock back and forth like a boat.
Keep your body rigid.
Continue for reps or time.

5656.name: 滑輪站姿面拉(繩索)
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley.
Grab it with both hands.
Pull toward your face, splitting the rope.
夾緊肩胛骨。
慢慢回到起始位置。

5657.name: 滑輪側彎 v. 2
instructions: Stand side-on to a low cable holding the handle.
Keep your hips still.
Bend sideways away from the cable.
Return to upright.
換邊。

5658.name: 滑輪坐姿面拉(繩索)
instructions: Sit facing a cable with a rope attachment.
Sit tall.
Pull the rope toward your face.
夾緊肩胛骨。
慢慢回到起始位置。

5661.name: 啞鈴胸部支撐俯身划船
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with dumbbells.
Let your arms hang.
Row the weights up toward your ribs.
夾緊肩胛骨。
慢慢放下。

5663.name: 槓鈴背後硬舉
instructions: Stand in front of the bar behind your legs.
Squat down and grip the bar behind you.
Stand up by driving your hips forward.
Lower the bar under control.
背部貼緊地面。

5664.name: 滑輪坐姿腿伸展
instructions: Sit on a bench with an ankle strap attached to a low cable.
Hold the bench.
Extend your leg until straight.
慢慢放下。
換腿。

5665.name: 啞鈴俯身面拉
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Let the weights hang below your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Pull the dumbbells toward your face, flaring your elbows out and up.
在頂部將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Lower with control and repeat without swinging.

5668.name: 槓鈴站姿安全桿肩推
instructions: Set the bar on safety pins at about shoulder height in a rack.
Step under it and grip just outside shoulder width.
收緊內核，夾緊臀部。
Press the bar overhead, moving your head slightly back then through.
Lower the bar to rest on the pins, pause, and repeat.

5669.name: 槓鈴嚴格彎舉
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and your torso still.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
在頂部夾緊二頭肌。
Lower slowly until your arms are fully straight.

5672.name: 徒手b式站姿早安體前屈

5695.name: 前傾伸展
instructions: Stand or sit in a stable position with one leg in front of the other.
Keep your back long and chest open.
Hinge forward from your hips until you feel a stretch in the glutes and hamstrings.
Return upright and switch sides.

5697.name: 啞鈴架上仰臥划船
instructions: Lie face down on a raised bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the weights up toward your ribs, elbows close to your body.
在頂部將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Lower slowly to full arm extension.

5699.name: 45度側彎
instructions: Set up on a 45 degree bench, lying on your side with your feet anchored.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your upper body toward the floor.
Bend up sideways by contracting your oblique.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

5700.name: 徒手行走提踵
instructions: 站直，雙腳分開與髖同寬。
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Take a step forward, staying on your toes.
Keep alternating steps without dropping your heels.
Lower your heels when you reach the end of the set.

5703.name: 滑輪上斜二頭彎舉
instructions: Set a low cable and lie back on an incline bench facing away from the stack.
Hold the handles with your arms hanging behind you.
Curl the handles up toward your shoulders.
Keep your elbows back and still.
慢慢放下直到手臂伸直。

5737.name: 懸吊帶飛鳥
instructions: Hold the handles and lean forward with your body in a straight line.
Start with your arms out in front of you, slightly bent.
Open your arms out to the sides, lowering your chest between the handles.
肘部保持微微彎曲。
Squeeze your chest to bring your arms back together.

5745.name: 增強式深蹲
instructions: 雙腳分開與肩同寬站立。
Sit into a squat with your chest up.
Explode upward and jump as high as you can.
Land softly on bent knees and go straight into the next squat.
膝蓋方向與腳尖一致。

5774.name: 單腿推蹬
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench with one foot flat and the other leg lifted.
Keep your arms out for balance.
Drive through your heel to lift your hips until level.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
Lower with control and switch legs after your reps.

5784.name: 槓桿式反向垂直哈克深蹲
instructions: Set the machine and stand with your chest against the pad, feet on the platform.
Grip the handles and brace your core.
Bend your knees and lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Press through your whole foot to stand.
膝蓋方向與腳尖一致。

5803.name: 長凳反向背部伸展
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge and legs hanging.
Hold the bench for support.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your legs until level with your body.
在頂部暫停。
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.

5810.name: 屈腿踢
instructions: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keep your core tight and back flat.
Lift one leg with the knee bent, pressing your foot toward the ceiling.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
Lower and repeat, then switch legs.

5814.name: 滑輪低位胸推
instructions: Set the pulleys low and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a split stance with elbows bent.
Press the handles up and forward in an arc.
Squeeze your chest as your hands meet.
慢慢回到起始位置。

5816.name: 啞鈴單臂側臥臥推
instructions: Lie on your side on a flat bench with a dumbbell in the top hand.
Bring the weight to your chest.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to the chest.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

5817.name: 啞鈴側臥外旋(長凳)
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench with a light dumbbell in the top hand.
Keep your elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked to your side.
Rotate your forearm upward, keeping your elbow still.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly and switch sides after your set.

5818.name: 負重滿罐舉
instructions: Hold a light weight in each hand with thumbs pointing up.
Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Raise your arms diagonally forward to about shoulder height.
短暫停頓。
Lower slowly with control.

5820.name: 啞鈴俯臥滿罐舉
instructions: Lie face down on a bench or floor with light dumbbells hanging.
Turn your thumbs to the ceiling.
Raise your arms out diagonally into a Y.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
控制着慢慢放下。

5822.name: 俯臥y字上舉
instructions: Lie face down with arms stretched overhead in a Y.
Turn your thumbs up.
Lift your arms, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Hold briefly at the top.
控制着慢慢放下。

5823.name: 槓鈴走步弓步
instructions: Place a barbell on your upper back and stand tall.
Step forward and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
上身保持挺直。
Push through your front foot and bring the back leg forward into the next step.
Continue alternating legs for the set distance.

5825.name: 史密斯機後弓步 v. 2
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand tall.
Step one foot back behind you.
Lower until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push through your front heel to return.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

5844.name: 單臂側向直臂背闊肌下拉

5853.name: 槓鈴上斜後三角划船
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding a barbell with a wide grip.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the bar up with elbows flared out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
慢慢放下。

5854.name: 壺鈴站姿提踵
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the balls of your feet on a step if you like.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
Rise as high as you can on your toes.
在頂部暫停。
Lower your heels slowly.

5856.name: 壺鈴集中彎舉
instructions: Sit with your legs apart and a kettlebell in one hand.
Rest your elbow against your inner thigh.
Curl the kettlebell up toward your shoulder.
在頂部收緊。
Lower slowly and switch arms.

5857.name: 壺鈴二頭彎舉
instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell by the handle with both hands or one.
肘部貼近身體兩側。
Curl the kettlebell toward your chest.
Squeeze your biceps.
控制着慢慢放下。

5858.name: 壺鈴地板飛鳥
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell in each hand above your chest.
肘部保持微微彎曲。
Lower your arms out to the sides until the elbows touch the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the weights back up.
Repeat with control.

5859.name: 壺鈴前平舉
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell with both hands by the sides of the handle.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Raise the kettlebell to shoulder height.
短暫停頓。
慢慢放下，不要借擺動。

5861.name: 壺鈴仰臥三頭伸展(頭顱粉碎者)
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell above your chest.
上臂保持靜止。
Bend your elbows to lower the weight toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back to the start.
Repeat with control.

5862.name: 壺鈴腕彎舉
instructions: Sit with your forearm on your thigh, palm up, holding a kettlebell.
Let your wrist extend downward.
Curl your hand up toward you.
在頂部收緊。
Lower slowly and switch arms.

5865.name: 寬站姿跳躍深蹲轉窄站姿跳躍深蹲

5866.name: 下斜鑽石伏地挺身
instructions: Place your feet on a bench and your hands close together under your chest.
Form a diamond with your thumbs and index fingers.
Lower your chest toward your hands.
身體保持一條直線。
Push back up to straight arms.

5867.name: 壺鈴俯身交替扭轉划船

5874.name: 滑輪高位直槓過頭三頭伸展
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and face away from it.
Hold the bar behind your head with elbows bent.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Extend your arms forward and up.
慢慢回到起始位置。

5879.name: 壺鈴側棒式
instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Hold a kettlebell in your top hand pointing up.
Lower and switch sides.

5882.name: 徒手劈柴深蹲
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands clasped above one shoulder.
Squat down while chopping your hands diagonally toward the opposite knee.
Rotate through your trunk and let your back foot pivot.
Stand up as you swing your arms back up.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

5892.name: 蜥蜴式
instructions: Start in a low lunge with your back knee down or lifted.
Walk your front foot to the outer edge of your mat.
Place both hands inside the front foot.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
換腿。

5900.name: 扭轉側角式
instructions: Step into a lunge with your back heel lifted.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist and hook your elbow outside the front knee.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
換邊。

5902.name: 站姿四字式
instructions: Stand tall and shift your weight onto one leg.
Cross the other ankle over the standing thigh.
Bend your standing knee and sit your hips back.
Hold for 5 slow breaths with a long spine.
換腿。

5905.name: 老虎彎曲式
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a neutral spine.
Extend one leg behind you and look slightly forward.
Round your back and draw the knee toward your nose.
Extend again and repeat for 6-8 reps.
換腿。

5906.name: 扭轉腿弓步式
instructions: Step into a low lunge with your back knee down.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist toward the front leg and hook your elbow outside the knee.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
換腿。

5911.name: 安全槓早安體前屈
instructions: Set the safety bar on your upper back and shoulders and hold the handles.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lower your torso until it is near parallel to the floor.
Keep your back flat and neck neutral.
髖部向前送，站直身體。

5912.name: 槓鈴負重鏈條相撲硬舉
instructions: Loop chains over the ends of a barbell and take a wide stance, toes angled out.
Bend down and grip the bar with your hands inside your knees.
收緊內核，抬起胸口。
Push through your feet and stand, with the chains adding load as you rise.
Lock out your hips, then lower the bar with control.

5914.name: 四肢支撐式
instructions: 從高位平板支撐開始。
Shift slightly forward on your toes.
Bend your elbows straight back and lower.
Keep your body straight like a plank.
Hold briefly, then press back up.

5915.name: 三腿四柱支撐式
instructions: Start in a high plank and lift one leg behind you.
髖部保持水平。
Bend your elbows back and lower.
Hold briefly with your body in line.
Press up, lower the leg and switch.

5916.name: 滑輪坐姿高位過頭三頭伸展

5943.name: 滑輪單臂中立握前平舉

5944.name: 啞鈴單臂中立握前平舉

5963.name: 垂直仰臥起坐
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs raised straight toward the ceiling.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your torso up and reach toward your feet.
在頂部暫停。
Lower your upper body slowly to the floor.

5966.name: 跳躍轉體
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart in a slight squat.
Jump up and rotate your hips and feet to one side.
屈膝輕輕落地。
Jump again and twist to the other side.
Keep your chest up and land quietly.

5968.name: 波比跳轉體
instructions: 雙腳分開與肩同寬站立。
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Perform a push-up if you like.
Jump your feet forward under your hips.
Explode up, rotating your trunk as you jump, and land softly.
Alternate twist directions each rep.

5974.name: 增強式敏捷訓練
instructions: Set out a few markers within a small area.
Stand in an athletic stance on the balls of your feet.
Hop or step quickly between the markers in changing directions.
屈膝輕輕落地。
Work for 20-30 seconds, rest, then repeat.

5975.name: 單腿平衡交叉出拳
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and fists up.
收緊內核。
Throw a cross punch, rotating your hips and shoulders.
Pull your fist back to guard.
Keep your standing foot steady.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

5988.name: 瓶裝負重硬舉
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand and stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at your hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Lower the bottles along your legs to mid-shin.
髖部向前送，站直身體。
在頂部夾緊臀部。

5990.name: 高欄跳接衝刺變向
instructions: Stand facing a high hurdle with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms and jump over it, tucking your knees.
屈膝輕輕落地。
Sprint forward right away.
Plant and cut sharply to one side.
Walk back and repeat, alternating cut directions.

5998.name: 側臥髖內收(左)
instructions: Lie on your left side with your legs straight.
Bend your right knee and place that foot in front of you.
Raise your left leg a few inches off the floor.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.

6000.name: 單腿橋式伸腿(左)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Extend your left leg straight out.
Drive through your right heel to lift your hips.
髖部保持水平。
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly, finish your reps and switch legs.

6001.name: 單直腿臀橋停留(左)
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
Straighten your left leg in line with your torso.
Press through the right heel to lift your hips.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with your hips level.
慢慢放下。

6002.name: 仰臥點腳尖
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent at 90 degrees over your hips.
將下背壓向地面。
Lower one foot to tap the floor.
Bring it back to tabletop.
Alternate legs with control.

6006.name: 半蹲側伸
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width.
Sit into a half squat.
Reach one arm overhead and lean sideways.
Return to center.
Reach to the other side.
抬起胸口。

6007.name: 低弓步
instructions: Step one foot forward into a lunge and lower your back knee.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Reach your arms overhead if you like.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換腿。

6008.name: 低弓步(左)
instructions: Step your right foot forward and lower your left knee to the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Reach your arms overhead if you like.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換腿。

6010.name: 慶祝提膝
instructions: 站直，雙腳分開與髖同寬。
Drive one knee up as you raise your arms in a victory pose.
Lower and switch.
Keep a quick, bouncy rhythm.
Land lightly and work for 30 seconds.

6013.name: 前踢腿
instructions: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Kick one straight leg up in front of you.
Lower it under control.
Switch legs in a smooth rhythm.
上身保持挺直。

6014.name: 原地踏步舉臂
instructions: 站直，雙腳分開與髖同寬。
Step in place, lifting your knees.
Raise your arms overhead as you step.
Lower them as you continue.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.

6016.name: 扭轉捲腹 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Twist to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
慢慢放下。
Alternate sides for your reps.

6019.name: 俯臥背部伸展停留
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended.
Lift your chest, arms and legs a few inches.
頸部保持中立。
Squeeze your glutes and hold for 15-30 seconds.
慢慢放下。

6025.name: 仰臥蛙踢
instructions: Lie face down, knees bent and heels together.
Let your knees fall slightly out.
Lift both thighs off the floor by squeezing your glutes.
在頂部暫停。
Lower with control and repeat.

6026.name: 側棒式拉
instructions: Get into a side plank on your forearm with your body in a straight line.
Reach your top arm overhead.
Pull your elbow down toward your ribs.
Keep your hips lifted.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

6032.name: 滑輪低位坐姿划船(V型握把)

6033.name: 腹部收腿
instructions: Sit on the floor and lean back slightly.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your knees to your chest as you bring your torso forward.
Extend again under control.
收緊內核。

6034.name: 槓鈴墊塊硬舉
instructions: Set the bar on blocks or a raised platform.
Stand with the bar over your mid-foot.
Hinge and grip the bar just outside your knees.
收緊內核，背部貼緊。
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
Lower the bar back to the blocks with control.

6035.name: 滑輪後三角划船(平行握把)
instructions: Sit facing a low cable with a parallel bar attachment.
Hold the handles with your elbows flared.
Lean back slightly with a straight spine.
Pull the handles toward your chest.
夾緊肩胛骨。
慢慢回到起始位置。

6036.name: 滑輪直臂下拉 v. 2
instructions: Stand facing a high cable and grab the bar with straight arms.
Hinge slightly at the hips.
Pull the bar down in an arc to your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
慢慢回到起始位置。

6038.name: 史密斯機驢子踢腿
instructions: Set the bar of the Smith machine at a low height.
Get on all fours with one foot under the bar.
Press the bar up by extending your hip.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
Lower slowly and repeat before switching legs.

6041.name: 瓶裝負重羅馬尼亞硬舉
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees and push your hips back.
Lower the bottles along your legs with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
髖部向前送，站直身體。
Keep your shoulders back and your core braced.

6042.name: 瓶裝負重單腿羅馬尼亞硬舉
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a bottle in each hand, with a slight bend in the knee.
Hinge at the hips and extend the free leg straight behind you.
Lower the bottles toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to return to standing.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

6044.name: 瓶裝負重前蹲
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand at your shoulders, elbows pointing forward.
雙腳分開與肩同寬站立。
Sit your hips down and back until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to stand.

6046.name: 瓶裝負重分腿蹲
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand and step into a long split stance.
上身保持挺直。
將後側膝蓋向地面靠近。
Press through the front heel to rise.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

6050.name: 瓶裝負重臀橋
instructions: 仰臥，膝蓋彎曲，雙腳平放。
Hold a bottle across your hips with both hands.
Push through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, forming a straight line from shoulders to knees.
慢慢放下並重復。

6051.name: 瓶裝負重跪姿深蹲
instructions: Kneel on a mat with hips over knees, holding a bottle at your chest.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Pause lightly, keeping your back straight.
Drive your hips forward to return to upright.
在頂部夾緊臀部。

6052.name: 瓶裝負重過頭捲腹
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle with both hands above your chest.
Extend your arms overhead or keep them over your face.
Curl your ribs toward your hips and lift your shoulders off the floor.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly without dropping your head.

6054.name: 瓶裝負重側彎
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, a bottle in one hand at your side.
Place the other hand lightly behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the bottle without leaning forward.
Return to upright by squeezing your side.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

6056.name: 瓶裝負重深蹲交替波浪

6059.name: 瓶裝負重俯身划船
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang below your shoulders.
Pull the bottles toward your hips, elbows close to your body.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
慢慢放下。

6061.name: 瓶裝負重俯身反向飛鳥
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, a bottle in each hand hanging below you.
肘部保持微微彎曲。
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
夾緊肩胛骨。
慢慢放下。

6063.name: 瓶裝負重集中彎舉
instructions: Sit with feet wide, a bottle in one hand, and rest your elbow on your inner thigh.
Let your arm hang fully.
Curl the bottle toward your shoulder.
在頂部夾緊二頭肌。
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

6064.name: 瓶裝負重反握集中彎舉
instructions: Sit with feet wide, holding a bottle with an overhand grip, elbow resting on your inner thigh.
Let your arm hang straight.
Curl the bottle up without bending your wrist.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

6066.name: 瓶裝負重雙臂後踢
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, a bottle in each hand, upper arms parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows tucked.
Extend both arms straight behind you.
在頂部收緊。
慢慢回到起始位置。

6067.name: 瓶裝負重過頭三頭伸展
instructions: Stand or sit tall holding a bottle overhead with both hands.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Bend your elbows and lower the bottle behind your head.
Extend your arms to lift it back up.
上臂保持靜止。

6068.name: 瓶裝負重交替二頭彎舉

6069.name: 瓶裝負重交替錘式彎舉

6070.name: 瓶裝負重反握彎舉
instructions: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand with palms facing down.
肘部貼近身體兩側。
Curl the bottles up with straight wrists.
在頂部暫停。
慢慢放下。

6071.name: 瓶裝負重直立划船
instructions: Stand tall holding bottles in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Pull them up along your body, elbows leading.
Stop at about chest height.
慢慢放下。
Keep the bottles close to your torso.

6072.name: 瓶裝負重腋下划船
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand and hinge slightly forward.
Pull your elbows out and up, bottles moving toward your armpits.
夾緊肩胛骨。
慢慢放下。
Keep your neck relaxed.

6073.name: 瓶裝負重前平舉
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Raise both arms straight in front to shoulder height.
肘部保持微微彎曲。
Pause.
慢慢放下，不要借擺動。

6074.name: 瓶裝負重側平舉
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows.
短暫停頓。
慢慢放下。

6092.name: 蜘蛛平板撐
instructions: Start in a high or forearm plank.
身體保持一條直線。
Bring one knee toward the same elbow.
Return to plank.
Alternate sides without letting your hips sag.

6100.name: 徒手跳繩
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together.
Step and hop on one foot while driving the opposite knee up.
Swing the opposite arm forward as you hop.
Switch sides in a rhythmic skip.
用前腳掌輕輕落地。
Keep going for 30-60 seconds.

6123.name: 啞鈴單側肩胛上提
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Keep your arm straight and your chest up.
Lift your shoulder blade straight up toward your ear.
在頂部短暫停頓。
控制着慢慢放下。
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

6137.name: 徒手站姿肩胛划船
instructions: Stand tall with your arms out in front or at your sides.
Keep your arms mostly straight.
Pull your shoulder blades back and together.
Hold the squeeze for a second.
慢慢放鬆。
Avoid shrugging your shoulders to your ears.

6140.name: 啞鈴坐姿外旋
instructions: Sit on a bench holding a light dumbbell.
Rest your elbow on your thigh or bent at your side at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm upward and outward.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly back to the start.
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

6142.name: 啞鈴坐姿反向阿諾推舉

6143.name: 啞鈴坐姿單臂前平舉
instructions: Sit tall holding a dumbbell at your side.
Raise the dumbbell forward to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
在頂部暫停。
控制着慢慢放下。
Avoid leaning back.
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

6144.name: 啞鈴直臂捲腹 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Hold a dumbbell with straight arms over your chest.
Curl your upper back off the floor, reaching up.
在頂部暫停。
慢慢放下。
Keep your lower back on the floor.

6145.name: 啞鈴長凳反向背部伸展
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge.
Hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Hold the bench for support.
Raise your legs until they align with your body.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
慢慢放下。

6146.name: 啞鈴靠牆俯身划船
instructions: Stand a step from a wall and hinge forward.
Support your forehead or free hand on the wall.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging.
Row the weights toward your hips.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
控制着慢慢放下。

6147.name: 啞鈴交替嚴格錘式彎舉
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with your palms facing in.
肘部貼近身體兩側。
Curl one dumbbell up without swinging.
Lower it slowly.
換另一隻手臂重複。
Keep your torso still.

6148.name: 啞鈴坐姿交替過頭三頭伸展
instructions: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in each hand overhead.
Lower one dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbow.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Extend the arm back up.
換另一隻手臂重複。
收緊內核。

6149.name: 啞鈴坐姿拖曳彎舉
instructions: Sit holding dumbbells with your palms forward.
Keep the weights close to your body.
Pull your elbows back as you curl.
Drag the dumbbells up along your torso.
在頂部收緊。
控制着慢慢放下。

6150.name: 啞鈴坐姿雙臂集中彎舉
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet wide.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and lean forward.
Rest the backs of your upper arms on your inner thighs.
Curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
在頂部收緊。
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

6151.name: 啞鈴反向撐體
instructions: Place two dumbbells on the floor and grip them.
Set up in a plank position.
Lower your chest with your elbows close to your body.
Stop just above the floor.
Press back up to the start.
身體保持一條直線。

6156.name: 壺鈴俯身划船
instructions: Hold a kettlebell and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arm hang straight down.
Row the kettlebell toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back.
慢慢放下。
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

6158.name: 啞鈴坐姿單臂過頭三頭伸展
instructions: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in one hand overhead.
Keep the upper arm close to your head.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbow.
Extend the arm back to full lockout.
收緊內核。
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

6159.name: 啞鈴坐姿單臂過頭三頭伸展(左)
instructions: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in your left hand overhead.
Keep the upper arm close to your head.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbow.
Extend the arm back to full lockout.
收緊內核。
Finish your reps, then switch to the right arm.

6160.name: 啞鈴蛙式髖推
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees out.
Rest a dumbbell on your hips.
Drive your hips up by pressing through your feet.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
慢慢放下。
Keep your ribs down.

6161.name: 啞鈴俯臥腿彎舉
instructions: Lie face down on a bench.
Grip a dumbbell between your feet.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze the hamstrings at the top.
控制着慢慢放下。
Keep your hips on the bench.

6193.name: 壺鈴哥薩克深蹲
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest and stand wide.
Shift your weight to one side.
Squat down with the other leg straight.
Keep the bent knee over your toes.
Push back to the center.
交替進行。

6194.name: 壺鈴聳肩
instructions: Stand holding kettlebells at your sides.
Keep your arms straight.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause for a second at the top.
慢慢放下。
Keep your chest tall and neck relaxed.

6195.name: 彈力帶站姿反握彎舉
instructions: Stand on a band holding the ends with an overhand grip.
肘部貼近身體兩側。
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
在頂部暫停。
慢慢放下。
Keep your wrists straight.

6208.name: 側平板撐抬腿 v. 2(左)
instructions: Lie on your left side and prop up on your left forearm, elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet and lift your hips into a straight line.
Raise your top leg to hip height.
Lower and repeat, then switch sides if you like.

6209.name: 跪姿直腿後踢 v. 2(左)
instructions: Start on all fours.
Extend your left leg straight behind you.
Lift it to hip height.
Squeeze the glute at the top.
控制着慢慢放下。
髖部保持水平。

6210.name: 肘碰膝側平板撐捲腹(左)

6211.name: 單車捲腹
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands by your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Twist to bring one elbow to the opposite knee.
Extend the other leg.
Switch sides in a pedalling motion.
下背保持貼緊凳面。

6214.name: 仰臥剪刀交叉
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs lifted.
將下背壓向地面。
Open your legs wide.
Cross one leg over the other.
Open and cross the other leg on top.
Keep a steady rhythm.

6215.name: 啞鈴滾輪
instructions: Kneel holding a dumbbell in each hand on the floor.
收緊內核。
Roll the dumbbells forward.
Go as far as you can keep your back flat.
Pull back to the start.
Avoid sagging at the hips.

6219.name: 滑輪站姿單臂飛鳥
instructions: Stand sideways to a cable with the handle at chest height.
Step forward for balance.
Pull the handle across your body.
Squeeze your chest.
慢慢回到起始位置。
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

6220.name: 懸吊帶划船
instructions: Hold the straps and lean back.
身體保持一條直線。
Pull your chest toward your hands.
夾緊肩胛骨。
慢慢放下。
收緊內核。

6221.name: 啞鈴站姿法式推舉
instructions: Stand holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend your arms back up.
收緊內核。
Avoid arching your back.

6231.name: 跪姿伏地挺身胸部回拉
instructions: Start in a knee push-up position.
Lower your chest to the floor.
推回起始位置。
Push your hips back toward your heels.
Return to the start.
收緊內核。

6232.name: 懸吊帶二頭彎舉
instructions: Hold the straps and lean back.
Extend your arms.
Curl your hands toward your forehead.
Keep your elbows high.
慢慢放下。
Keep your body straight.

6234.name: 吊環手臂彎舉
instructions: Hold the rings and lean back.
Extend your arms.
Curl your hands toward your head.
Keep your elbows up.
慢慢放下。
身體保持一條直線。

6237.name: 吊環單臂二頭彎舉
instructions: Hold one ring and lean back.
Extend your arm.
Curl your hand toward your head.
Keep your elbow up.
慢慢放下。
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

6252.name: 吊環面拉
instructions: Hold the rings and lean back.
Extend your arms.
Pull the rings toward your face.
Flare your elbows out.
夾緊肩胛骨。
慢慢放下。

6259.name: 吊環單臂後三角划船
instructions: Hold one ring and lean back.
Extend your arm.
Pull your elbow out and back.
Squeeze the rear delt.
慢慢放下。
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

6262.name: 槓鈴站姿腕彎舉
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip.
Let your hands hang.
Curl your wrists up.
Squeeze the forearms.
慢慢放下。
Keep your arms still.

6263.name: 槓鈴站姿反握腕彎舉
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip.
Let your hands hang.
Extend your wrists up.
Squeeze the forearms.
慢慢放下。
Keep your arms still.

6264.name: 啞鈴俯臥交替錘式彎舉

6265.name: 啞鈴站姿交替反握彎舉
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with an overhand grip.
肘部貼近身體兩側。
Curl one dumbbell up.
慢慢放下。
Alternate arms.
Keep your wrists straight.

6266.name: 滑輪坐姿過頭彎舉(sz槓)
instructions: Sit facing the cable machine.
Grip the SZ bar and extend your arms.
Curl the bar toward your head.
Squeeze the biceps.
慢慢放下。
Keep your elbows high.

6268.name: EZ槓站姿單臂中立握腕彎舉
instructions: Stand holding one end of an EZ bar.
Keep your arm at your side.
Curl your wrist up.
Squeeze the forearm.
慢慢放下。
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

6270.name: 槓鈴拉森推舉
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip the bar.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Unrack the bar.
Lower it to your chest.
推回起始位置。
背部貼緊地面。

6288.name: 海豚式
instructions: Start on hands and knees, then lower to your forearms.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up high.
Press your forearms into the floor.
Let your head hang between your arms.

6291.name: 戰士二式
instructions: Stand with feet wide, turn your front foot out and back foot slightly in.
Bend your front knee over the ankle.
Extend both arms parallel to the floor.
Gaze over your front hand.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

6292.name: 蛙式
instructions: Start on hands and knees on a mat.
Slide your knees wide, with feet turned out and inline with knees.
Lower onto your forearms.
Push your hips back gently.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。

6294.name: 半蛙式
instructions: Lie on your belly, propped on your forearms.
Bend one knee and reach back to hold that foot.
Gently press the foot toward your hip.
Keep your hips grounded.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換腿。

6295.name: 聖者馬里奇一式
instructions: Sit with one leg straight and the other knee bent, foot flat beside the straight leg.
Wrap your opposite arm around the bent knee.
Sit tall, then twist toward the bent knee.
Keep your spine long.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

6318.name: 單腿交叉弓步
instructions: 站直，雙腳分開與髖同寬。
Step one leg diagonally behind the other.
Bend both knees and lower your hips.
Keep your chest up and front knee over your toes.
Push up and return, then switch sides.

6327.name: 徒手低位分腿蹲
instructions: Step one foot forward into a long split stance.
Keep your torso upright and your hands on your hips.
Lower your back knee toward the floor as far as you can control.
Drive through your front foot to stand back up.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

6328.name: 啞鈴低位分腿蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and step into a long split stance.
Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
Lower your back knee toward the floor in a controlled way.
Push through your front heel to rise.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

6329.name: 槓鈴低位分腿蹲
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back and step into a long split stance.
Brace your core and keep your torso tall.
Lower your back knee toward the floor under control.
Press through your front foot to stand up.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

6336.name: 徒手慢速到爆發式深蹲
instructions: 雙腳分開與肩同寬站立。
Lower into a squat over about three seconds.
Pause briefly at the bottom with your chest up.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly with bent knees and go straight into the next rep.

6341.name: 謙卑戰士式
instructions: Step into a wide lunge with the front knee bent.
Clasp your hands behind your back.
Fold your torso inside your front thigh.
Let your arms float overhead.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換邊。

6344.name: 深蹲停留
instructions: 雙腳分開與肩同寬站立。
Sit down into a squat until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Hold for 20-40 seconds, then stand up.

6355.name: 槓桿式戶外坐姿胸推
instructions: Sit with your back flat against the pad and grip the handles at chest height.
Keep your shoulders down and back.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
短暫停頓。
Let the handles come back slowly and repeat.

6356.name: 槓桿式戶外坐姿高位下拉

6358.name: EZ槓站姿腕彎舉
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip, arms hanging in front.
Keep your elbows still and close to your body.
Curl your wrists upward, lifting the bar a short distance.
在頂部收緊。
Lower the bar slowly and repeat.

6359.name: 啞鈴站姿腕彎舉
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your arms still at your sides.
Curl your wrists up, bringing the dumbbells toward your forearms.
在頂部收緊。
慢慢放下並重復。

6360.name: 滑輪站姿腕彎舉
instructions: Face a low cable pulley and grab the handle with an underhand grip.
Step back and let your arms hang with elbows tucked.
Curl your wrists upward against the cable.
在頂部收緊。
Lower with control and repeat.

6361.name: EZ槓站姿反握腕彎舉
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar with an overhand grip, arms hanging in front.
Keep your elbows still at your sides.
Extend your wrists to raise the bar upward.
Hold briefly at the top.
慢慢放下並重復。

6362.name: 啞鈴站姿反握腕彎舉
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down.
上臂保持靜止。
Lift the backs of your hands up by extending your wrists.
在頂部暫停。
慢慢放下並重復。

6364.name: EZ槓坐姿反握腕彎舉
instructions: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs, holding an EZ bar overhand.
Let your wrists hang past your knees.
Extend your wrists to lift the bar.
在頂部收緊。
慢慢放下並重復。

6365.name: EZ槓站姿背後腕彎舉
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar behind your back with an underhand grip.
Keep your elbows still and your chest up.
Curl your wrists to raise the bar slightly.
在頂部收緊。
Lower with control and repeat.

6366.name: 啞鈴站姿背後腕彎舉
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand behind your back, palms facing back.
Keep your arms still and your chest tall.
Curl your wrists upward.
在頂部收緊。
慢慢放下並重復。

6367.name: 滑輪站姿背後腕彎舉 v. 2
instructions: Stand with your back to a low cable and hold the handle behind you.
Keep your elbows tucked and your chest up.
Curl your wrists to pull the handle upward.
在頂部收緊。
Lower with control and repeat.

6392.name: 滑輪磁性握把側向下拉

6406.name: EZ槓牧師椅彎舉
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the pad.
Hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
在頂部夾緊二頭肌。
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight and repeat.

6418.name: 彈力帶反向捲腹
instructions: Lie on your back with a band anchored and held in your hands.
Bend your knees and bring them over your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor, drawing your knees toward your chest.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly without letting your lower back arch.

6423.name: 徒手平板姿勢三頭伸展
instructions: Start in a forearm-height plank with your hands under your shoulders.
身體保持一條直線。
Lean forward and bend your elbows to lower your head toward your hands.
Press back up by straightening your arms.
Keep your core tight and repeat.

6424.name: 啞鈴早安體前屈
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding one dumbbell against your chest.
Soften your knees slightly.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
髖部向前送，站直身體。

6428.name: 90度觸腳跟 v. 2
instructions: 仰臥，膝蓋彎曲，雙腳平放。
Lift your shoulders slightly off the floor.
Reach your right hand toward your right heel.
Switch and reach your left hand to your left heel.
Keep your core tight and continue alternating.

6435.name: 腳跟臀橋
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor, toes lifted.
Keep your arms by your sides.
Press through your heels and raise your hips.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
慢慢放下。

6439.name: 彈力帶站姿單臂肩部屈曲
instructions: Stand on the band with one foot and hold the handle at your thigh, palm down.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Raise the arm forward to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower slowly against the band tension.
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

6440.name: 彈力帶站姿單臂肩部側向伸展

6441.name: 彈力帶站姿外旋
instructions: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the far hand, elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Rotate the forearm outward, keeping the elbow pinned.
Pause when your hand points forward or slightly out.
Return slowly under control.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

6464.name: 徒手蛙式髖推
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out.
Keep your feet close to your hips.
Push through your feet to lift your hips.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
慢慢放下並重復。

6465.name: 史密斯蛙式髖推
instructions: Sit with your upper back on a bench and the Smith bar over your hips.
Put the soles of your feet together, knees open.
Drive your hips up until your body is level.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
Lower under control and repeat.

6466.name: 側平板屈腿抬腿
instructions: Lie on one side and prop yourself on your forearm.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line.
Bend your top knee and lift it upward.
Lower it without dropping your hips.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

6485.name: 槓片站姿側平舉
instructions: Stand tall holding a plate in each hand at your sides.
肘部保持微微彎曲。
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
短暫停頓。
慢慢放下並重復。

6486.name: 彈力帶俯身後側平舉 v. 2
instructions: Stand on a band and hinge forward with a flat back.
Hold the band ends in each hand.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
慢慢放下並重復。

6511.name: 滑輪單臂高位肩胛划船

6512.name: 滑輪單臂低位肩胛划船

6513.name: 槓桿式俯身划船(胸部支撐)
instructions: Lean your chest against the pad and grab the handles.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Pull the handles toward your body, driving your elbows back.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
慢慢放下並重復。

6514.name: 槓桿式俯身中立握划船(胸部支撐)

6515.name: 槓桿式俯身單臂中立握划船(胸部支撐)

6516.name: 槓桿式俯身寬握划船(胸部支撐)
instructions: Lean your chest on the pad and take the wide handles.
Start with your arms extended.
Pull the handles back with your elbows flared out.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Return slowly and repeat.

6517.name: 槓桿式俯身單臂寬握划船(胸部支撐)

6539.name: 無臂祈禱伸展
instructions: Kneel on the floor and sit your hips back toward your heels.
Reach your arms forward and lower your chest.
Let your forehead rest near the floor.
Relax your shoulders and breathe deeply.

6540.name: 大幅轉身背部伸展
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms out in front.
Slowly rotate your upper body to one side, leading with the arms.
Keep your hips facing forward as much as you can.
Turn until you feel a comfortable stretch through the back.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸平穩。
Return to center and repeat on the other side.

6541.name: 徒手長凳深蹲
instructions: Stand in front of a bench with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower.
Lightly touch the bench with your glutes without dropping onto it.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
在頂部夾緊臀部。

6542.name: 滑輪跪姿高到低飛鳥
instructions: Set the cables high and kneel between them, holding a handle in each hand.
肘部保持微微彎曲。
Sweep your arms down and together in front of your hips.
Squeeze your chest at the bottom.
Return slowly and repeat.

6543.name: 滑輪前平舉(繩索握把)
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and face away from the machine.
Hold the rope ends and let your arms hang with the cable between your legs.
Raise your arms forward to shoulder height with soft elbows.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower slowly without letting the stack rest.
Keep your torso still, no swinging.

6546.name: 地雷管單腿髖推
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench with a padded landmine bar across your hips.
Plant one foot on the floor and extend the other leg or hold it up.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glute at the top with your torso level.
控制着慢慢放下。
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

6548.name: 下斜抬膝
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and grip the top behind your head.
Extend your legs with a slight knee bend.
Pull your knees up toward your chest, curling the pelvis off the bench.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower your legs slowly without letting the hips drop hard.
Keep the movement smooth, not jerky.

6550.name: 史密斯槓上斜伏地挺身
instructions: Set the Smith bar at about waist height and rack it securely.
Place your hands on the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
身體保持一條直線。
Lower your chest to the bar.
Push back up to straight arms.

6551.name: 徒手後弓步過頭伸展
instructions: 站直，雙腳分開與髖同寬。
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge.
Reach both arms overhead as you lower.
Push through your front foot to stand.
Alternate legs.

6553.name: 地雷管單腿羅馬尼亞硬舉

6554.name: 臀腿機仰臥起坐
instructions: Set your feet under the pads of a glute ham bench, hips on the support.
Cross your arms over your chest and lean back to a comfortable depth.
Brace your abs and curl up until your torso is upright.
在頂部短暫停頓。
控制着慢慢放下。
Keep your lower back from over-arching at the bottom.

6555.name: 腹肌墊仰臥起坐
instructions: Lie back on an ab mat with knees bent and feet flat.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands by your ears.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting tall.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower back down slowly.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

6559.name: 槓片脛骨前肌彎舉
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest a plate on your forefoot.
Keep your heel on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shin.
在頂部暫停。
慢慢放下並重復。

6560.name: 90到90伸展
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front and the other bent out to the side, both at about 90 degrees.
Sit tall with your hands on the floor.
Hinge forward over the front shin until you feel a stretch in the hip.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸平穩。
Come back up slowly.
換邊。

6561.name: 槓桿式腹肌擺動
instructions: Sit in the machine and secure yourself with the pads.
Hold the handles and brace your core.
Swing your legs to one side using your abs.
Return to the centre with control.
在另一側重複。

6570.name: 臀橋行走
instructions: 仰臥，膝蓋彎曲，雙腳平放。
Lift your hips into a glute bridge.
Keep the hips high and walk your feet out a few small steps.
Then walk them back in toward your body.
Keep your hips level and avoid sagging.
Lower with control when finished.

6600.name: 徒手支撐深蹲
instructions: Hold on to a sturdy support at chest height.
雙腳分開與肩同寬站立。
Sit your hips back and down into a squat.
Keep your chest up and your heels down.
Stand back up by pushing through your feet.

6601.name: 槓桿式臀推
instructions: Position yourself on the machine and set your feet on the platform.
收緊內核。
Press the platform away by driving through your heels.
Squeeze your glutes at the end.
Return slowly and repeat.

6606.name: 史密斯交叉弓步
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and unrack it, feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg back and diagonally behind the other, like a curtsey.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel, chest tall.
Press through the front heel to return to standing.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

6618.name: 低弓步瑜伽體式(安傑耶式一式)
instructions: Start in a lunge with the front knee over the ankle.
Lower the back knee to the floor and untuck the toes.
Sink your hips forward and down.
Raise both arms overhead and lift your chest.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸平穩。
Step back and switch legs.

6698.name: 槓片站姿二頭彎舉
instructions: Stand tall holding a plate at its sides with both hands, arms down.
Keep your elbows tucked against your ribs.
Curl the plate up toward your chest.
在頂部夾緊二頭肌。
Lower the plate slowly to full arm extension.

6733.name: 槓桿式哈克深蹲機早安體前屈

6735.name: 啞鈴彈力帶髖推
instructions: Put a band around your thighs and rest your upper back on a bench.
Place a dumbbell across your hips and hold it steady.
Plant your feet and push your knees out against the band.
Drive your hips up until your torso is level.
Squeeze the glutes at the top.
慢慢放下。

6737.name: 彈力帶側平板臀部抬起
instructions: Put a band around your thighs or ankles and get into a side plank on your forearm.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Raise the top leg up against the band.
短暫停頓。
Lower the leg with control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

6738.name: 彈力帶健身球平板凳反向超伸
instructions: Lie face down with your hips over a stability ball on a flat bench.
Loop a band around your feet and anchor it low in front.
Hold the bench for stability.
Raise both legs until they are in line with your body.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
Lower slowly against the band.

6739.name: 滑輪跪姿髖外展
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and put it on one ankle.
Kneel on all fours with the cuffed leg on the outside.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Lift the knee out to the side against the cable.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower with control, then switch legs after your reps.

6741.name: 彈力帶長凳跪姿腿部半圓
instructions: Place a band around your thighs or ankles and kneel on a bench with hands on its edge.
Keep your back flat and hips level.
Lift one leg out behind you.
Sweep it in a half circle out to the side.
Return along the same path under control.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

6742.name: 滑輪驢式斜向後踢
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and put it on one ankle.
Get on all fours facing the machine.
Keep your core braced and back flat.
Kick the leg back and slightly out on a diagonal.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
Return slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

6747.name: 跪姿臀推
instructions: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
收緊內核，背部貼緊。
Press one foot back and up, leading with the heel.
Squeeze the glute at the top without arching your back.
控制着慢慢放下。
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

6748.name: 跪姿單腿腿後勾
instructions: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders.
Keep your back flat and core tight.
Bend one knee and curl your heel toward your glute.
Squeeze the hamstring at the top.
Lower the foot slowly.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

6749.name: 坐姿髖外旋
instructions: Sit tall on a bench or chair with feet flat.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Keep your knee still and rotate the lower leg inward so the thigh turns outward.
Pause when you feel the hip working.
慢慢回到起始位置。
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

6750.name: 站姿平衡髖旋轉
instructions: Stand tall on one leg with a soft knee, holding a wall if needed.
Lift the other knee to hip height.
Rotate the lifted knee out to the side, then back to the front.
Keep your torso steady.
Move slowly and smoothly.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

6751.name: 側臥斜向後抬腿
instructions: Lie on your side with legs stacked and your bottom arm supporting your head.
Brace your core and keep your hips stacked.
Lift the top leg up and slightly back on a diagonal.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
慢慢放下。
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

6752.name: 仰臥腹直肌活化捲腹
instructions: 仰臥，膝蓋彎曲，雙腳平放。
Place your hands lightly on your abs or behind your head.
Exhale and curl your shoulders off the floor.
Feel the abs tighten at the top.
Lower back slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed.

6754.name: 徒手側臥肩外旋
instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked at your waist.
Rest your forearm across your stomach.
Rotate your forearm upward, keeping the elbow in.
在頂部暫停。
慢慢放下。
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

6757.name: 啞鈴站姿單臂二頭彎舉
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at your side, palm facing forward.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulder.
在頂部夾緊二頭肌。
Lower slowly until the arm is straight.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

6758.name: 啞鈴長凳上旋後
instructions: Sit by a bench and rest your forearm on it with your hand past the edge.
Hold a dumbbell with a hammer grip.
Keep your forearm still.
Rotate your palm up as far as you can.
慢慢回到起始位置。
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

6759.name: 坐姿脛骨前肌推
instructions: Sit tall with your heels on the floor.
Lift the toes of one foot as high as you can.
Press them up against light resistance such as the other foot.
在頂部暫停。
慢慢放下。
Finish the reps, then switch feet.

6761.name: 半鴿式髖部伸展
instructions: Start on all fours and bring one knee forward behind your wrist.
Slide the other leg straight back.
Square your hips to the floor.
Fold forward gently over the front leg.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸平穩。
換邊。

6762.name: 斜向彎身停留
instructions: Stand with feet wider than your hips.
Reach one arm overhead and toward the opposite foot.
Bend diagonally, keeping your hips facing forward.
Reach only as far as is comfortable.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸平穩。
Return to standing and switch sides.

6763.name: 坐姿前臂伸展
instructions: Sit tall and extend one arm in front of you, palm up.
With the other hand, gently pull the fingers back toward you.
Keep the elbow straight and shoulders relaxed.
Turn the palm down to stretch the other side, then switch arms.

6764.name: 前彎背部伸展
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward at the hips with soft knees.
Let your arms and head hang down.
Relax your neck and shoulders.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸平穩。
Roll up slowly to stand.

6765.name: 手輔助頸部伸展
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Place one hand on the side of your head.
Gently tilt your head toward the shoulder, using light pressure.
Keep the opposite shoulder down.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸平穩。
Release slowly and switch sides.

6766.name: 滾球側臥地板脛後肌(單腿)

6768.name: 滾球側臥斜角肌活化(側面視角)

6769.name: 滾球仰臥頭半棘肌活化

6770.name: 跪姿縫匠肌伸展
instructions: Kneel on one knee in a half-kneeling position.
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift your hips forward slightly.
Lean slightly to the side of the back leg.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸平穩。
換腿。

6771.name: 跪姿髂腰肌伸展
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Tuck your pelvis and brace your abs.
Shift your weight forward until you feel the stretch at the front of the hip.
Raise the arm on the kneeling side overhead.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸平穩。
換腿。

6772.name: 站姿腓骨肌伸展
instructions: Stand near a wall for balance.
Cross one foot behind and turn the sole so the outer edge presses into the floor.
Gently shift your weight onto that foot.
Feel the stretch along the outside of the lower leg.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸平穩。
Switch feet.

6773.name: 站姿脛骨前肌伸展
instructions: Stand near a wall for balance.
Place the top of one foot on the floor behind you with toes curled under.
Gently bend the standing knee to press forward.
Feel the stretch along the shin.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸平穩。
Switch feet.

6774.name: 坐姿菱形肌伸展
instructions: Sit tall and clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Push your arms forward and round your upper back.
Tuck your chin slightly and spread the shoulder blades apart.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸均勻。
Release slowly and repeat.

6775.name: 站姿足部肌肉活化
instructions: 站直，雙腳分開與髖同寬。
Spread your toes wide and press all of them into the floor.
Lift your toes while keeping the ball of the foot down.
Lower them one by one.
Keep your arch lifted.
Repeat for 10-15 slow reps.

6776.name: 滑輪站姿單側三角肌划船

6785.name: 彈力帶坐姿髖外展 v. 2

6786.name: faber測試
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight.
Place one foot on the opposite knee.
Let the bent knee drop out to the side.
Relax and notice how far it goes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without forcing it.
換腿。

6791.name: 肩內旋測試
instructions: 站直，雙腳分開與髖同寬。
Reach one arm behind your back with the palm facing out.
Slide your hand slowly up your spine as far as is comfortable.
Note how high your thumb reaches, keeping your chest open.
Lower the arm, then repeat with the other side to compare.

6793.name: 後側鏈柔軟度測試
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your knees straight.
Hinge at the hips and slowly reach down toward your toes.
Let your head and arms hang relaxed without bouncing.
Note how far your fingertips reach.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸平穩。
Rise slowly, rolling up one vertebra at a time.

6794.name: 托馬斯測試
instructions: Sit at the end of a bench, then lie back and hug one knee to your chest.
Let the other leg hang off the edge with the thigh relaxed.
Keep your lower back flat on the bench.
Notice whether the hanging thigh rises above the bench or the knee straightens.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸平穩。
Switch legs and compare.

6795.name: 托馬斯正面測試
instructions: Sit at the end of a bench and lie back, pulling one knee to your chest.
Let the other leg hang down off the edge, fully relaxed.
Keep your lower back pressed down and your pelvis still.
Watch whether the hanging leg drifts outward or the thigh lifts.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸平穩。
Switch legs and compare.

6796.name: 史密斯相撲椅子深蹲
instructions: Place a chair behind you and set the bar on your upper back.
Take a wide stance with toes turned out.
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the chair.
膝蓋方向與腳尖一致。
Drive through your heels to stand up.

6797.name: 槓鈴長凳側向登階
instructions: Place the bar on your upper back and stand beside a bench.
Put the inside foot flat on the bench.
Press through that heel and stand up on the bench.
Lower the other foot back down under control.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

6798.name: 彈力帶站姿平衡臀部後踢
instructions: Loop the band around your ankles or hold it under your standing foot.
Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee and brace your abs.
Kick the other leg straight back against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Return slowly with control.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

6799.name: 啞鈴側臥腹斜肌V字起
instructions: Lie on your back holding a dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Lift your legs and torso together, angling toward one side.
Reach the dumbbell toward your feet.
Lower back down slowly.
每次都換邊。

6800.name: 啞鈴軍事推舉俄羅斯轉體(雙腿離地)

6801.name: 啞鈴坐姿軍事推舉開合抬腿(腳離地)

6802.name: 啞鈴坐姿軍事推舉停留交替抬腿(腳離地)

6804.name: 平板交替反重力引體
instructions: Start in a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
收緊內核，夾緊臀部。
Pull one arm up and back toward your ribs.
Return it to the floor under control.
Alternate arms without rocking your hips.

6806.name: 啞鈴軍事推舉俄羅斯轉體(雙腿離地)v. 2

6809.name: 啞鈴過頭仰臥起坐(雙腿放長凳)

6810.name: 彈力帶仰臥屈膝抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with a band looped around your feet or anchored.
Place your hands by your sides and brace your core.
Bring your knees toward your chest against the band.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower your feet slowly without arching your back.

6811.name: 木棍肩胛下肌放鬆
instructions: Hold a stick in one hand and bend your elbow to 90 degrees.
Place the other hand on the stick and rotate the arm outward.
Gently push into a comfortable stretch.
Release and repeat on the other arm.

6833.name: 壺鈴坐姿側平舉
instructions: Sit upright on a bench holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
肘部保持微微彎曲。
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
在頂部暫停。
慢慢放下，不要借擺動。

6902.name: 牛面式瑜伽體式
instructions: Sit with one knee stacked over the other and your feet beside your hips.
Reach one arm up and bend the elbow, hand down your back.
Sweep the other arm behind you and try to clasp your fingers.
Keep your spine tall and your chest open.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸平穩。
換邊並重復。

6910.name: 雙槓深撐體
instructions: Grip two parallel bars and hold a straight plank position.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Lower your chest below the level of your hands.
推回到手臂伸直。
Keep your body in one line throughout.

6959.name: 彈力帶輔助伏地挺身
instructions: Anchor a band across a rack or set of bars at chest height.
Rest your torso on the band in a plank position.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at 45 degrees.
Press up using the bounce of the band as help.
身體保持一條直線。

6964.name: 啞鈴站姿胸椎推舉
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and the dumbbells at shoulder height.
Brace your abs and lift your chest tall.
Press the dumbbells overhead while gently extending your upper back.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your lower back.
Lower to your shoulders with control.
按計劃的次數重複。

7056.name: 啞鈴站姿反握彎舉旋轉

7107.name: 槓桿式坐姿單腿腿推 v. 2
instructions: Sit in the machine and put one foot on the platform.
Keep your back against the pad.
Press the platform away until your leg is almost straight.
Lower slowly until your knee bends to about 90 degrees.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

7108.name: 槓桿式坐姿腿伸展 v. 3
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and shins behind the roller.
Align your knees with the machine pivot.
Extend your legs until they are nearly straight.
Squeeze your quads at the top.
控制着慢慢放下。

7113.name: 啞鈴直臂仰臥拉舉 v. 2

7176.name: 槓桿式坐姿小腿推 v. 2
instructions: Sit in the machine and place the balls of your feet on the platform.
Extend your knees almost fully.
Press up as high as you can onto your toes.
在頂部暫停。
Lower your heels slowly for a good stretch.

7177.name: 槓桿式坐姿單腿小腿推
instructions: Sit in the machine and place the ball of one foot on the platform.
Rest the other foot on the floor or the support.
Press up through your toes as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze your calf.
Lower your heel slowly for a full stretch.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

7198.name: 彈力帶臀橋外展
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and the band just above your knees.
Press through your heels to lift your hips.
At the top, push your knees apart against the band.
Bring the knees back together.
Lower your hips slowly.
按計劃的次數重複。

7199.name: 彈力帶仰臥屈膝髖外展
instructions: Lie on your side with the band above your knees and your knees bent.
Stack your hips and rest your head on your arm.
Lift your top knee up against the band without rolling back.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your feet together like a clamshell.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

7201.name: 彈力帶仰臥抬腿 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with the band around your feet or anchored behind your head.
將下背壓向地面。
Raise your legs together toward the ceiling.
Lower them slowly without arching your back.
Stop just above the floor.
按計劃的次數重複。

7202.name: 彈力帶側弓步
instructions: Stand with the band under your feet or around your thighs, feet together.
Step wide to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee, keeping the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up and your heel down.
Push back to the start.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

7204.name: 彈力帶站姿平衡臀部後踢 v. 2
instructions: Place the band around your ankles and stand tall on one leg.
Hold a wall or rail for balance if needed.
Keep a slight bend in your standing knee.
Kick the other leg back, squeezing the glute.
Return slowly without leaning forward.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

7205.name: 彈力帶深蹲跳
instructions: Place the band above your knees and stand with feet shoulder-width.
Squat down with your chest up.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly, absorbing into the next squat.
Keep your knees pressing out against the band.
按計劃的次數重複。

7206.name: 彈力帶側向跨步深蹲
instructions: Put the band around your thighs and stand tall.
Step one foot out to the side.
Sit down into a squat.
Stand up and bring your feet together.
Keep the knees from caving in.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

7207.name: 彈力帶保加利亞深蹲
instructions: Stand in front of a bench, band under your front foot and held at your shoulders.
Rest the top of your back foot on the bench.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is parallel.
Keep your torso tall.
Press through your front heel to rise.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

7208.name: 彈力帶跪姿後踢
instructions: Start on hands and knees with the band around your foot and hands.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Kick one leg straight back and up.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
慢慢放下。
完成所有次數，然後換邊。
