7209.name: 彈力帶跪姿腿部半圓
instructions: Start on hands and knees with the band around your thighs or foot.
Lift one leg out to the side with a bent knee.
Sweep it in a half circle, back and up.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.
Reverse the circle to return.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

7212.name: 彈力帶空中腳踏車 v. 2

7213.name: 側臥內旋
instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked to your ribs.
Rest the forearm on the floor in front of you.
Rotate your forearm up toward your belly.
Lower it slowly back to the floor.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

7216.name: 靠牆對側手腳抬起
instructions: Stand facing a wall in a bent over position with your hands on it.
收緊內核。
Lift one arm and the opposite leg at the same time.
Hold for a second without twisting.
Lower and repeat on the other side.

7217.name: 地板T字舉 v. 2
instructions: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides in a T.
Keep your forehead near the floor and neck neutral.
Lift your arms off the floor by pinching your shoulder blades.
Hold for a second at the top.
控制着慢慢放下。

7228.name: 吊環寬握引體向上
instructions: Grab the rings with a wide overhand grip and hang with arms straight.
收緊內核。
Pull your chest toward the rings, driving elbows down and out.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly to a full hang.

7231.name: 啞鈴上斜單臂Y字舉
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in one hand.
Let the arm hang straight down.
Raise your arm forward and up in a Y shape, thumb up.
在頂部收緊。
Lower slowly and switch arms after your reps.

7233.name: 站姿肩胛旋轉(正面視角)
instructions: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Lift your shoulders gently up.
Roll them back and down in a smooth circle.
Reverse the direction.
Keep your neck relaxed.
按計劃的次數重複。

7235.name: 啞鈴站姿肩胛外旋(正面視角)
instructions: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell with your elbow tucked and bent to 90 degrees.
Keep your upper arm against your side.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back.
慢慢回到起始位置。
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

7251.name: 懸垂前水平抬起
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip.
Pull your shoulders down and tighten your core.
Raise your straight body up toward horizontal, keeping your arms straight.
Hold the top position for a moment.
慢慢放下，不要借擺動。

7255.name: 坐姿蛙式半起到全起仰臥起坐

7263.name: 椅子上坐姿上勾拳
instructions: Sit tall on the edge of a chair with your fists up by your chin.
收緊內核。
Rotate your torso and punch one fist upward in an uppercut.
Snap it back and punch with the other hand.
Keep a quick, steady rhythm for the set.

7278.name: 懸吊訓練帶背闊肌伸展
instructions: Hold the straps and lean back with straight arms.
Sit your hips back and drop your chest between your arms.
Feel the stretch along the sides of your back.
Return slowly to standing.

7279.name: 懸吊訓練帶深蹲爆發拉

7287.name: 六角槓過頭推舉
instructions: Stand inside the trap bar and hold it at shoulder height with a neutral grip.
收緊內核，夾緊臀部。
Press the bar overhead until your arms lock out.
Pause, then lower to your shoulders.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

7306.name: 站姿頸部側向伸展
instructions: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head toward one shoulder.
Rest a hand lightly on your head for slight pressure.
Keep the opposite shoulder low.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸平穩。
換邊。

7310.name: 椅子坐姿腿後肌伸展
instructions: Sit on the front edge of a chair.
Straighten one leg with the heel on the floor and toes up.
Keep the other foot flat and your back long.
Hinge forward at the hips until you feel a stretch.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸平穩。
換腿。

7327.name: 槓桿式腿伸展(腳尖內收)

7341.name: 單腳跳鐘擺
instructions: 單腿站立，膝蓋微屈。
Hop sideways to land on the other foot.
Swing the free leg across behind you for balance.
Land softly and stay controlled.
Keep alternating at a steady pace.

7374.name: 史密斯相撲硬舉
instructions: Stand with feet wide, toes turned out, and grip the bar inside your knees.
收緊內核，抬起胸口。
Push your feet into the floor and stand tall.
Lock out your hips at the top.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back.

7384.name: 槓桿式髖推(掛片式)
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and belt secured over your hips.
Plant your feet flat, shoulder width apart.
Drive your hips up until your body is level.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
控制着慢慢放下。

7411.name: 負重墊高全深蹲
instructions: Stand with your heels on a low plate or platform, holding a weight at your chest.
收緊內核，抬起胸口。
Squat as deep as comfortable.
膝蓋方向與腳尖一致。
Drive up to standing.

7412.name: 後弓步高抬膝接前弓步

7413.name: 墊高雙腿髖推
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and knees bent.
Plant your feet hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
慢慢放下。
按計劃的次數重複。

7414.name: 靠牆捲腹
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet and calves resting on a wall, knees bent about 90 degrees.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
在頂部暫停。
控制着慢慢放下。
按計劃的次數重複。

7415.name: 雙槓平板撐體
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms.
Lean forward and shift your weight over your hands.
Bend your elbows to lower your body under control.
Keep your core tight and elbows close.
推回到手臂伸直。

7417.name: 過頭仰臥起坐(雙腿放長凳)
instructions: Lie on your back with your calves resting on a bench, knees bent.
Extend your arms overhead.
Curl your torso up, keeping your arms by your ears.
Reach toward your knees.
慢慢放下。

7418.name: 交錯腿臀橋
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, one foot forward of the other.
Press through both heels to lift your hips.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
髖部保持水平。
慢慢放下。
Switch the foot position halfway through.

7419.name: 直腿臀橋
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your heels on the floor.
Press your heels down and lift your hips.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
Keep your ribs down.
慢慢放下。
按計劃的次數重複。

7449.name: 啞鈴站姿前平舉與側平舉

7455.name: 單腿側向跳
instructions: 單腿站立，膝蓋微屈。
向側面跳一小段距離。
用同一只腳輕柔落地並保持平衡。
朝相反方向跳回。
完成所有次數，然後換腿。
7455.description: 單腿側向跳躍，鍛鍊爆發力與踝關節穩定性。

7469.name: 啞鈴高腳杯深蹲接提踵

7499.name: 雙平板開合跳接四次登山者
instructions: 從高位平板支撐開始。
Jump your feet wide and together twice.
Do four mountain climbers, driving your knees alternately.
髖部保持水平。
Flow through the sequence at a steady pace.

7512.name: 吊環射箭式引體向上
instructions: Hang from rings with a wide grip.
Pull up toward one hand, leaving the other arm straight.
Reach the top with your chin by that hand.
控制着慢慢放下。
每次都換邊。

7538.name: 仰臥地板滑行
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms in a goalpost position.
Keep your back and wrists on the floor.
Slide your arms up overhead.
慢慢回到起始位置。
Move within your comfortable range.

7547.name: 啞鈴高腳杯相撲深蹲
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes out, holding a dumbbell at your chest.
抬起胸口。
Squat down between your legs.
Keep your knees pointing over your toes.
Drive up and squeeze your glutes.

7548.name: 壺鈴擺盪接高腳杯深蹲

7549.name: 啞鈴高腳杯保加利亞分腿蹲
instructions: Place your rear foot on a bench and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Step the front foot forward.
將後側膝蓋向地面靠近。
Keep your torso tall.
Push through the front heel and switch legs after your reps.

7550.name: 啞鈴墊高保加利亞分腿蹲

7551.name: 徒手墊高腳跟保加利亞分腿蹲

7552.name: 槓鈴澤徹保加利亞分腿蹲
instructions: Rest the barbell in the crooks of your elbows.
Put your rear foot on a bench.
將後側膝蓋向地面靠近。
抬起胸口。
Drive up and switch legs.

7553.name: 門框胸部伸展
instructions: Stand in a doorway with forearms on the frame, elbows at 90 degrees.
Step one foot forward.
Lean gently through the door until you feel a stretch.
Breathe slowly and step back.

7554.name: 平行槓屈膝反向划船
instructions: Lie under parallel bars and grab them.
Bend your knees with feet on the floor.
Keep your body straight from shoulders to knees.
Pull your chest to the bars.
慢慢放下。

7558.name: 墊高靠牆靜蹲
instructions: Stand with your heels on a low platform and your back on a wall.
Slide down until thighs are parallel.
背部貼緊地面。
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Slide up carefully.

7562.name: 坐姿股四頭肌伸展 v. 2
instructions: Sit sideways on a bench or chair edge.
Bend one knee, tucking your foot behind you.
Hold your ankle and gently pull it toward your glutes.
換邊。

7563.name: 壺鈴擺盪高拉握法前蹲

7564.name: 滑輪前後腳站姿單臂划船

7565.name: 槓鈴屈臂仰臥拉舉 v. 2

7566.name: 啞鈴哈克深蹲
instructions: Hold dumbbells behind you with your heels slightly raised.
抬起胸口。
Squat down.
Stay tall.
Drive up through your feet.

7577.name: 徒手墊高腳跟深蹲
instructions: Stand with your heels on a small plate.
Extend your arms in front.
Squat deep with your chest up.
膝蓋方向與腳尖一致。
Stand back up.

7582.name: 壺鈴同側後弓步
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand.
Step back with the leg on the same side.
控制着慢慢放下。
上身保持挺直。
Push back up and switch sides.

7584.name: 滑輪跪姿高低抗旋轉劈砍

7586.name: 滑輪同側臀部主導登階
instructions: Stand in front of a box with a cable handle in the hand on your working side.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Drive through the heel to stand up.
慢慢放下。
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

7587.name: 滑輪單臂高位划船(胸部支撐)

7589.name: 滑輪跪姿臀部後踢
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and kneel on hands and knees facing it.
收緊內核，背部貼緊。
Kick the cuffed leg back and up.
在頂部收緊。
慢慢回到起始位置。
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

7590.name: 啞鈴臀部主導保加利亞分腿蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with your back foot on a bench.
Step the front foot out far enough for your shin to stay near vertical.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Lower until the thigh is parallel.
Drive through your front heel to rise.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

7591.name: 滑輪仰臥面拉
instructions: Lie on your back with the cable set low behind your head and hold the rope ends.
Start with your arms extended.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows flaring out and wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
慢慢回到起始位置。

7592.name: 滑輪上斜後三角飛鳥(背部支撐)
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench between two cable stations.
Grab the opposite handles, arms hanging with a slight bend.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder level.
Pause and squeeze your rear delts.
慢慢放下，不要借擺動。

7597.name: 滑輪高位划船(胸部支撐)

7598.name: 啞鈴對側臀部主導保加利亞分腿蹲
instructions: Hold one dumbbell in the hand opposite your front leg.
Put your back foot on a bench and step the front foot forward.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Lower until the front thigh is parallel.
Drive up through the front heel.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

7619.name: 開合波比跳 v. 2
instructions: 雙腳分開與肩同寬站立。
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Lower your chest to the floor and push up, or skip the push-up if you prefer.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Jump up, spreading your arms and legs like a jumping jack, then repeat.

7621.name: 槓鈴安全桿臥推(標準握法)

7622.name: 靠牆仰臥單腿腿後肌伸展
instructions: Lie on your back with your hips close to a wall.
Rest one heel on the wall with your leg as straight as feels comfortable.
Keep the other leg flat on the floor.
Relax and breathe, letting the hamstring lengthen.
保持 20-30 秒，然後換腿。

7624.name: 飛蜥式瑜伽體式
instructions: Start in a low lunge with your front foot between your hands.
Lower your forearms to the floor or blocks.
Drop your back knee or keep it lifted.
Let your hips sink.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。
Step back and switch sides.

7625.name: 啞鈴俯身彎舉
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders, elbows fixed.
在頂部收緊。
慢慢放下直到手臂伸直。

7626.name: 地雷管深蹲
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar against your chest with both hands.
雙腳分開與肩同寬站立。
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest tall.
Squat until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.

7648.name: 啞鈴同側單腿直腿硬舉
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in the hand on the same side as your standing leg.
Shift your weight to that leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and reach the weight toward the floor.
Extend the other leg straight behind you.
Return to standing by squeezing your glute.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

7743.name: 滑輪半跪姿面拉
instructions: Set a rope at head height and half kneel facing the stack.
Hold the rope ends with your palms facing in.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows high and wide.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Return slowly. Switch the leading knee after your set.

7744.name: 滑輪站姿旋後面拉(繩索)
instructions: Set the rope at face height and grip it with your palms facing up.
Step back and stand tall.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows leading.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end.
慢慢回到起始位置。

7745.name: 站姿旋後面拉(毛巾)
instructions: Loop a towel around a sturdy anchor and hold both ends, palms up.
Lean back with your arms extended.
Pull your hands toward your face, elbows wide.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Lower yourself slowly. Walk your feet in to make it harder.

7747.name: 啞鈴俯臥W字舉
instructions: Lie face down on a bench or the floor with a light dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Lift your arms out and up into a W shape.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
慢慢放下並重復。

7751.name: 壺鈴擺盪高拉握法前蹲 v. 2

7839.name: 死蟲式 v. 3
instructions: Lie on your back with arms straight above you and knees bent at 90 degrees.
將下背壓向地面。
Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Return to the start.
Alternate sides with a slow tempo.
Keep your ribs down.

7850.name: 反向空中腳踏車
instructions: Lie on your back and lift your hips slightly with hands under your glutes.
Raise your legs.
Pedal backward in a smooth circle.
下背保持貼緊凳面。
Continue for a set time or reps.

7854.name: 側平板扭轉手臂三角肌舉
instructions: Set up in a side plank on your forearm.
Raise your top arm up toward the ceiling.
Rotate and thread your arm under your torso.
Open back up and raise the arm again.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

7859.name: 爆發式動態平板撐
instructions: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
收緊內核，夾緊臀部。
Move quickly, hopping or shifting your hands and feet.
Keep your hips level and avoid sagging.
Rest when your form slips.

7879.name: 啞鈴上斜三頭後踢
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Pin your upper arms to your sides.
Straighten your elbows to kick the weights back.
Squeeze your triceps.
慢慢回到起始位置。
上臂保持靜止。

7880.name: 啞鈴跪姿三頭後踢
instructions: Kneel beside a bench with one hand and the same-side knee on it.
Hold a dumbbell in the free hand with your upper arm against your side.
Extend your elbow to kick the weight back.
Squeeze your triceps.
慢慢放下。
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

7882.name: 槓片推
instructions: Stand with a weight plate held at your chest, elbows bent.
Brace your abs and bend your knees slightly.
Push the plate out explosively with both arms.
Fully extend your arms.
Pull the plate back to your chest with control.
按計劃的次數重複。

7883.name: 地雷管硬舉
instructions: Load one end of the barbell in a landmine and stand facing it, feet hip-width.
Hinge back and grip the bar end with both hands.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Lower the bar under control.
按計劃的次數重複。

7884.name: 槓桿式毛巾伏地挺身
instructions: Place your hands on towels on the floor in a plank.
身體保持一條直線。
將胸口向地面靠近。
推回起始位置。
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
按計劃的次數重複。

7892.name: 啞鈴坐姿三頭伸展 v. 2
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support, holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms close to your head.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms back up.
收緊內核。
按計劃的次數重複。

7895.name: 跪姿軀幹旋轉後飛鳥穿線
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Place one hand behind your head and rotate your torso open, elbow to the ceiling.
Return and thread that arm under your chest.
Let your shoulder reach toward the floor.
Keep your hips still.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

7921.name: 滑輪坐姿單側二頭彎舉
instructions: Sit facing a low cable and hold the handle with one hand.
Rest your elbow near your side.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
在頂部收緊。
Lower slowly and switch arms after your set.

7922.name: 滑輪坐姿單臂單側二頭彎舉

7994.name: 啞鈴臀橋胸推
instructions: Lie on your back holding dumbbells at chest level, knees bent.
抬起髖部形成橋式。
Press the dumbbells up over your chest.
Lower with control while holding your hips high.
Finish your reps, then lower your hips.

7999.name: 彈力帶45度髖伸展(臀部主導)

8002.name: 彈力帶寬站距抗旋轉劈砍
instructions: Anchor the band at one side and stand sideways with your feet wide.
Hold the handle with both hands.
收緊內核。
Press or chop diagonally while keeping your torso square.
Return slowly. Switch sides after your set.

8075.name: 啞鈴單腿髖推 v. 2
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell on your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg.
Drive your hips up until your body is straight.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

8076.name: 槓片伏地挺身
instructions: Have a partner place a plate on your upper back, or set it carefully yourself.
Get into a high plank.
Lower your chest to the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
推回到手臂伸直。
身體保持一條直線。

8083.name: 滑輪直腿斜向後踢
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable pulley and strap it to one ankle.
Face the machine and hold the frame for balance.
Keep your leg straight and kick it back and slightly out to the side.
Squeeze your glute at the top without leaning forward.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

8084.name: 負重二頭腿部集中彎舉(離心)

8085.name: 彈力帶站姿平衡髖外展
instructions: Put a band around your ankles and stand on one leg.
Hold something for balance if needed.
Lift the free leg out to the side.
上身保持挺直。
Lower slowly and switch legs after your set.

8143.name: 高雙槓三頭撐體
instructions: Grip the bars and lift yourself with straight arms.
Keep your body upright and elbows close.
Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
推回到手臂伸直。
Avoid shrugging your shoulders.

8146.name: 仰臥骨盆底放鬆與深呼吸

8189.name: 寬握反手引體向上
instructions: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip wider than shoulders.
收緊內核。
Pull until your chin is over the bar.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

8191.name: 滑輪站姿屈髖
instructions: Attach an ankle strap and face away from a low cable.
Hold a support for balance.
Lift your knee in front of you.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly. Switch legs after your set.

8194.name: 仰臥抬膝
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
將下背壓向地面。
Draw your knees up toward your chest.
短暫停頓。
Lower slowly without arching.

8195.name: 椅子上坐姿側彎
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with feet flat.
Place one hand behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the floor.
Return to upright using your side muscles.
在另一側重複。

8197.name: 椅子上坐姿游泳
instructions: Sit upright near the edge of a chair.
Lean forward slightly with a flat back.
Reach one arm forward and the other back, then alternate.
Move in a steady rhythm.
收緊內核。

8200.name: 椅子上坐姿祈禱式夾胸

8202.name: 椅子上坐姿交替外展扭轉
instructions: Sit tall near the edge of a chair.
Lift one leg and open it out to the side.
Twist your torso toward that leg.
Return to centre.
交替進行。

8203.name: 椅子上坐姿俄羅斯轉體

8220.name: 深屈膝
instructions: 雙腳分開與肩同寬站立。
Sit your hips back and down as deep as you can.
Keep your heels down and chest up.
Pause at the bottom.
Drive up to standing.

8222.name: 啞鈴反握負重平板划船
instructions: Set up in a plank with your hands on dumbbells, palms facing forward.
Widen your feet for balance.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs.
髖部保持水平。
Lower and alternate arms.

8223.name: 啞鈴健身球負重平板划船
instructions: Place your feet on a stability ball and your hands on dumbbells.
Brace into a strong plank.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs.
髖部保持水平。
Lower and alternate arms.

8224.name: 彈力帶負重平板划船
instructions: Anchor a band and get into a plank facing it.
Hold the band in one hand.
Row your elbow back to your ribs.
髖部保持水平。
Return slowly and alternate arms.

8225.name: 啞鈴負重平板划船行走
instructions: Start in a plank with a dumbbell in each hand.
Row one dumbbell up.
Place it down and step the hands forward.
換另一隻手臂重複。
髖部保持水平。

8274.name: 桌下二頭彎舉
instructions: Lie under a strong table and grip its edge with an underhand grip.
Keep your body straight with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the table by bending the elbows.
Squeeze your biceps.
慢慢放下。

8289.name: 側臥胸部伸展
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent and arms in front of you.
Lift your top arm and open it back like a book.
Let your chest rotate open.
Return and switch sides.

8297.name: 滑輪直臂下拉(繩索握把)
instructions: Set a rope on a high pulley and stand facing it.
Hinge forward slightly with arms extended.
Pull the rope down to your thighs.
Spread the rope at the bottom.
慢慢回到起始位置。

8299.name: 滑輪半跪姿單臂划船 v. 2

8303.name: 椅子上坐姿直立扭轉
instructions: Sit tall with feet flat and arms crossed over your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side.
短暫停頓。
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your hips still.

8311.name: 椅子上坐姿側彎
instructions: 坐在穩固椅子的前緣，坐直，雙腳平放在地上。
收緊內核，肩膀放鬆。
Reach one arm overhead and lean slowly to the opposite side without twisting.
Pause briefly, then return to upright.
Repeat on the other side and keep alternating.

8342.name: 徒手站姿肩胛外旋
instructions: Stand tall with your elbows bent at your sides.
Keep your palms facing forward.
Rotate your forearms outward and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold for a second.
慢慢回到起始位置。
Keep your ribs down and your shoulders away from your ears.

8358.name: 腿後肌臀橋
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels placed a bit farther from your hips.
Press your heels into the floor.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
慢慢放下並重復。

8360.name: 彈力帶站姿肩內旋
instructions: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Tuck your elbow against your side with the forearm pointing forward.
Rotate your forearm across your belly, keeping the elbow fixed.
慢慢回到起始位置。
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

8362.name: 彈力帶站姿單臂側平舉

8363.name: 彈力帶站姿90度肩外旋
instructions: Anchor the band at shoulder height and hold the handle with your elbow raised to shoulder level, bent 90 degrees.
Keep the upper arm still.
Rotate your hand up and back until the forearm points to the ceiling.
慢慢回到起始位置。
Do all reps, then switch arms.

8369.name: 坐姿過頭直臂伸展
instructions: Sit tall on a chair or bench.
Interlace your fingers and straighten your arms.
Raise them overhead with palms facing up.
Lift your chest and reach slightly back.
Breathe normally and hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
慢慢放鬆。

8374.name: 深蹲跨步
instructions: Stand with your feet together.
Squat down by pushing your hips back.
Stand up while stepping one foot out to the side.
Bring that foot back in and squat again.
每次都換邊。
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

8399.name: 平板撐側向觸地
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders and feet wide.
身體保持一條直線。
Reach one hand out to tap the floor at the side without twisting your hips.
Return it and tap with the other hand.
Keep the pace steady and controlled.

8423.name: 椅子上坐姿後仰
instructions: 坐在穩固椅子的前緣，坐直，雙腳平放在地上。
收緊內核，肩膀放鬆。
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lean back slowly while keeping your back straight.
Stop where you can still hold your form, then return to upright using your abs.

8424.name: 椅子上坐姿交叉出拳
instructions: 坐在穩固椅子的前緣，坐直，雙腳平放在地上。
收緊內核，肩膀放鬆。
Raise your fists to guard position.
Punch one arm across your body, rotating the trunk slightly.
Pull it back and punch with the other arm.
Keep a quick, smooth rhythm.

8431.name: 椅子上坐姿過頭伸展
instructions: 坐在穩固椅子的前緣，坐直，雙腳平放在地上。
收緊內核，肩膀放鬆。
Interlace your fingers and raise your arms overhead.
Turn your palms to the ceiling and reach up tall.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸均勻。

8433.name: 椅子上坐姿前彎伸展
instructions: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair and extend one leg with the heel on the floor.
Keep your back long.
Hinge forward from the hips and reach toward your toes.
換腿並重復。

8479.name: bosu球平衡反向平衡滑冰式深蹲
instructions: Stand on one foot on the bosu ball and hold your arms in front for balance.
Reach the free leg back behind you.
Sit your hips back and lower into a single-leg squat.
Drive through the standing foot to rise.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

8536.name: 徒手靠牆脛骨前肌提升

8546.name: 俯臥Y到T到W
instructions: Lie face down with your forehead near the floor and arms extended overhead in a Y.
Lift your arms slightly and hold.
Move them out to a T, then bend the elbows into a W.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Reverse the order and repeat.

8585.name: 中背肘部夾緊
instructions: Stand or sit tall with your hands by your head or elbows bent in front.
Pull your elbows back and down.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Hold for a second at the end.
慢慢回到起始位置。
Keep your neck relaxed.

8604.name: 槓桿式坐姿腿彎舉(掛片式)

8611.name: 彈力帶坐姿足外翻
instructions: Sit with one leg extended and loop the band around the forefoot, anchored on the inside.
Keep your leg still.
Turn your foot outward against the band.
慢慢回到起始位置。
Finish the reps, then switch feet.

8612.name: 彈力帶坐姿足內翻
instructions: Sit with one leg extended and loop the band around the forefoot, anchored on the outside.
Keep your leg still.
Turn your foot inward against the band.
慢慢回到起始位置。
Finish the reps, then switch feet.

8613.name: 啞鈴牧師椅擺盪彎舉
instructions: Rest your upper arms on a preacher pad and hold dumbbells with an underhand grip.
Keep your shoulders down.
Curl the weights up with a small drive from the bottom.
在頂部收緊。
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

8614.name: 滑輪站姿單臂水平三頭伸展

8615.name: 椅子上坐姿交替動態胸部伸展
instructions: 坐在穩固椅子的前緣，坐直，雙腳平放在地上。
收緊內核，肩膀放鬆。
Open one arm out to the side and rotate the trunk slightly.
Feel the stretch across your chest.
Return and switch arms in a smooth rhythm.

8616.name: 椅子上坐姿肘部飛鳥
instructions: 坐在穩固椅子的前緣，坐直，雙腳平放在地上。
收緊內核，肩膀放鬆。
Raise your elbows to chest height with forearms up.
Squeeze your elbows together in front of you.
Open them out again under control.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

8617.name: 椅子上坐姿外旋
instructions: 坐在穩固椅子的前緣，坐直，雙腳平放在地上。
收緊內核，肩膀放鬆。
Tuck your elbows at your sides bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearms outward, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly and repeat.

8618.name: 椅子上坐姿胸推
instructions: 坐在穩固椅子的前緣，坐直，雙腳平放在地上。
收緊內核，肩膀放鬆。
Bring your hands to chest height and press your palms together.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Draw them back to your chest slowly.

8619.name: 椅子上坐姿手臂交叉
instructions: 坐在穩固椅子的前緣，坐直，雙腳平放在地上。
收緊內核，肩膀放鬆。
Open your arms wide to the sides at shoulder height.
Sweep them together so they cross in front of your chest.
Open back out and alternate which arm is on top.

8620.name: 椅子上坐姿下斜胸推
instructions: 坐在穩固椅子的前緣，坐直，雙腳平放在地上。
收緊內核，肩膀放鬆。
Start with your hands at chest height.
Press them diagonally down and forward until your arms are straight.
Return slowly to the chest and repeat.

8621.name: 椅子上坐姿蝴蝶機夾胸
instructions: 坐在穩固椅子的前緣，坐直，雙腳平放在地上。
收緊內核，肩膀放鬆。
Raise your forearms in front of you with elbows bent at shoulder height.
Squeeze your forearms together.
Open them back to the sides under control.

8622.name: 椅子上坐姿上斜胸推
instructions: 坐在穩固椅子的前緣，坐直，雙腳平放在地上。
收緊內核，肩膀放鬆。
Start with your hands near your chest.
Press them diagonally up and forward until your arms are straight.
Lower back to the chest slowly.

8633.name: 椅子上坐姿肩推
instructions: 坐在穩固椅子的前緣，坐直，雙腳平放在地上。
收緊內核，肩膀放鬆。
Raise your hands to shoulder height with elbows bent.
Press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower back to your shoulders under control.

8634.name: 椅子上坐姿旋轉拳擊滾動
instructions: 坐在穩固椅子的前緣，坐直，雙腳平放在地上。
收緊內核，肩膀放鬆。
Raise your fists in a boxing guard.
Roll your arms in circles while rotating your trunk side to side.
Keep a quick, rhythmic pace.

8652.name: 椅子上坐姿拍肩
instructions: 坐在穩固椅子的前緣，坐直，雙腳平放在地上。
收緊內核，肩膀放鬆。
Reach one hand across to tap the opposite shoulder.
Return and tap with the other hand.
Keep the pace steady.

8653.name: 椅子上坐姿展開與下擺
instructions: 坐在穩固椅子的前緣，坐直，雙腳平放在地上。
收緊內核，肩膀放鬆。
Swing both arms open to the sides.
Rotate and sweep them under and across your body.
Open back out and alternate directions with a smooth rhythm.

8654.name: 椅子上坐姿過頭三頭伸展
instructions: 坐在穩固椅子的前緣，坐直，雙腳平放在地上。
收緊內核，肩膀放鬆。
Raise your arms overhead and bend your elbows so your hands drop behind your head.
Extend your arms back up until straight.
Lower slowly and keep your elbows pointing forward.

8655.name: 椅子上坐姿反握手臂繞圈
instructions: 坐在穩固椅子的前緣，坐直，雙腳平放在地上。
收緊內核，肩膀放鬆。
Extend your arms out to the sides with palms facing up.
Draw small circles, then gradually bigger.
Reverse the direction after a set.

8661.name: 滑輪上斜Y字舉(背部支撐)
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with a cable handle in each hand.
頸部保持中立。
Raise your arms forward and up in a Y shape.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly with straight arms.

8662.name: 滑輪上斜窄握肩推(V形握把)

8663.name: 滑輪上斜Y字舉助握帶(背部支撐)
instructions: Fasten the wrist straps to the cables and lie chest-down on an incline bench.
頸部保持中立。
Raise your arms forward and up into a Y shape.
Squeeze your shoulders at the top.
慢慢放下。

8712.name: 槓桿式羅馬尼亞硬舉(掛片式)

8744.name: 椅子上坐姿交替膝伸展
instructions: 坐在穩固椅子的前緣，坐直，雙腳平放在地上。
收緊內核，肩膀放鬆。
Straighten one knee by lifting the foot until the leg is level.
Squeeze your thigh, then lower slowly.
Switch legs and keep alternating.

8750.name: 吊環仰臥拉舉
instructions: Hang from the rings with an overhand grip.
Pull your hips up and bring your knees to your chest.
Rotate backward, pulling the body over the rings.
控制着慢慢放下。
Keep the movement smooth.

8755.name: 分腿蹲提踵
instructions: Stand in a split stance with one foot well forward.
Lower into a split squat with an upright torso.
Push up through your front foot to stand.
Rise onto the toes of your back foot or both feet.
Lower your heel and repeat.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

8798.name: 槓鈴架上俯臥海豹划船
instructions: Lie face down on a raised bench so the bar hangs below you.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Row the bar up toward your chest by pulling elbows back.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
慢慢放下。

8799.name: 槓桿式哈克深蹲機單腿硬舉
instructions: Step onto the machine platform and set your back against the pad.
Place one foot on the platform and lift the other slightly.
Hinge at the hip and lower with control.
Drive through the standing foot to come back up.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
Do your reps, then switch legs.

8800.name: 史密斯前後腳站姿羅馬尼亞硬舉
instructions: Stand under the smith bar with one foot slightly behind the other.
Grip the bar and unrack it.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and the bar close to your legs.
Lower until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
髖部向前送，站直身體。
Switch which foot is forward after your set.

8847.name: 槓桿式站姿側平舉
instructions: Stand in the machine with pads against your arms.
上身保持挺直。
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
在頂部暫停。
慢慢放下。

8873.name: 負重啞鈴仰臥抬膝
instructions: Lie on your back with a dumbbell secured between your feet.
下背保持貼緊凳面。
Bring your knees toward your chest.
Lower your feet slowly without touching the floor.
Repeat for controlled reps.

8875.name: 滑輪仰臥單腿屈髖
instructions: Lie on your back with the ankle strap attached to the low cable and one foot in it.
Brace your core and press your lower back into the floor.
Pull the knee up toward your chest with control.
Pause briefly, then lower the leg slowly against the cable.
Keep the other leg relaxed and your hips still.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

8876.name: 滑輪仰臥屈髖(反向深蹲)

8878.name: 滑輪45度反向飛鳥
instructions: Set two cable handles at a low or mid height and grab them crossed over.
Hinge forward at the hips to about 45 degrees with a flat back.
肘部保持微微彎曲。
Pull the handles out and back in a wide arc until your arms are in line with your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades gently at the end.
Return slowly and keep your torso still.

8892.name: 壺鈴前後腳站姿硬舉
instructions: Stand with one foot slightly behind the other.
Hold a kettlebell in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bell toward the floor.
Keep your back flat and weight mostly on the front foot.
髖部向前送，站直身體。
Switch stances after your set.

8894.name: 屈膝收腿伏地挺身
instructions: Start in a push-up position with a straight body.
將胸口向地面靠近。
推回起始位置。
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Return the leg and repeat on the other side.
髖部保持水平。

8896.name: 俯身背部伸展肩胛內收

8901.name: 滑輪單臂側平舉 v. 2
instructions: Stand side-on to the low cable and hold the handle with the far hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm out to the side up to shoulder height.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower slowly against the cable.
Avoid leaning or swinging, then switch arms.

8946.name: 坐姿單腿抬起
instructions: Sit tall on the edge of a bench with your hands beside you.
Extend one leg straight out in front.
Lift the leg a few inches higher while keeping the knee straight.
Pause and lower it slowly.
Keep your back straight and your core tight.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

8956.name: 腳跟深蹲靠牆滑行
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet a little forward.
Press your heels into the floor.
Slide down the wall until your thighs are near parallel.
膝蓋方向與腳尖一致。
Press through your heels to slide back up.
Keep your back in contact with the wall.

8971.name: 側弓步伸展 v. 2
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart and toes pointing forward.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat or toes up.
Sit your hips back and feel the stretch on the inner thigh.
換邊並重復。

8990.name: 槓桿式側坐單臂後三角飛鳥

9002.name: 鳥狗式平板撐
instructions: Get into a plank on your hands or forearms with your body in a line.
收緊內核，夾緊臀部。
Lift one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Keep your hips level and do not twist.
Hold for a few seconds.
Return and switch sides.

9009.name: 健身球反向超伸
instructions: Lie face down over the ball with your hands on the floor.
Let your legs hang down with your toes light on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and raise both legs until they are in line with your body.
在頂部暫停。
慢慢放下，不要借擺動。
Keep your hands planted and your core tight.

9010.name: 健身球藥球捲腹
instructions: Sit on the ball and roll down until your lower back is supported.
Hold the medicine ball against your chest or overhead.
Brace your core and crunch your ribs toward your hips.
在頂部暫停。
Lower back over the ball with control.
Keep your feet firmly on the floor.

9024.name: 仰臥腹部剪刀捲腹
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and your legs slightly off the floor.
Scissor your legs up and down in alternating motion.
Crunch your ribs toward your hips.
下背保持貼緊凳面。
Continue for a set count of reps.

9025.name: 健身球坐姿劈柴
instructions: Sit tall on the ball with your feet wide.
Hold the weight or handle high on one side.
Rotate and chop diagonally down to the opposite hip.
Keep your arms mostly straight and your hips steady.
Return along the same path.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

9040.name: 靠牆衝刺
instructions: Place your hands on a wall and lean forward with a straight body line.
收緊內核。
Drive one knee up while the other leg stays extended.
Switch legs quickly in a running rhythm.
髖部保持水平。
Go hard for 10-20 seconds, then rest.

9041.name: 史密斯前腳墊高分腿蹲
instructions: Set a low platform under the smith bar and put your front foot on it.
Place the bar across your upper back and unrack it.
Step the back foot behind you.
將後側膝蓋向地面靠近。
Press through the front heel to stand.
Do all reps, then switch legs.

9044.name: 懸垂進階收腿前水平停留

9047.name: 健身球直髖單腿腿彎舉

9048.name: 登山者交叉踢
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
收緊內核。
Drive one knee across your body toward the opposite elbow.
Return the foot and switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips low and level.
Keep up a steady pace for a set time.

9049.name: 上斜抬髖
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and hold the top edge behind your head.
Bring your legs up so your knees are over your hips.
Curl your pelvis up to lift your hips off the bench.
在頂部暫停。
慢慢放下，不要借擺動。
Keep the movement small and controlled.

9066.name: 四向單腿跳
instructions: 單腿站立，膝蓋微屈。
向前跳，落地輕柔。
跳回起始位置，再分別向兩側跳。
每次落地後停留片刻。
抬起胸口，膝蓋保持在腳的上方。
重複這個組合，然後換腿。
9066.description: 單腿向前、向後、向兩側跳躍，訓練平衡、踝關節穩定性與爆發力。

9180.name: 木棍站姿肩部伸展活動
instructions: Stand tall holding a stick behind your back with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight.
Lift the stick back and away from your body.
Stay tall and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for a moment.
慢慢放下並重復。

9181.name: 木棍站姿肩部外旋活動
instructions: Stand holding a stick with both hands, elbows tucked at your sides and bent.
Push the stick with the stronger hand to rotate the other arm outward.
Keep your elbow glued to your side.
Move only as far as is comfortable.
Return to the start slowly.
換邊並重復。

9184.name: 木棍肩部外展活動
instructions: Hold a stick with both hands in front of you.
Keep one arm relaxed and guide it with the other.
Raise the stick sideways and up.
上身保持挺直。
在頂部暫停。
Lower and switch sides.

9272.name: 坐姿地板脛骨前肌提升

9304.name: 滑輪中立握寬握下拉 v. 3

9310.name: 站姿等長收縮停留提踵

9311.name: 等長收縮停留寬距伏地挺身
instructions: Start in a push-up position with hands wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest until your elbows are bent.
Hold this position for 10 to 20 seconds.
身體保持一條直線。
Press back up to the start.
Rest and repeat.

9312.name: 高槓上斜伏地挺身
instructions: Set a bar at about waist or chest height.
Place your hands on it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Walk your feet back so your body is in a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bar.
推回到手臂伸直。
Keep your core and glutes tight.

9313.name: 吊環等長收縮停留反向腹輪
instructions: Hang or set yourself up with the rings under your forearms.
Brace your core and tuck your pelvis.
Move into the rollout position and stop.
身體保持一條直線。
Hold for 10-20 seconds.
慢慢回到起始位置。

9315.name: 墊高分腿蹲
instructions: Stand a stride length in front of a bench and rest your back foot on it.
上身保持挺直。
將後側膝蓋向地面靠近。
Keep your front knee over your foot.
Drive through the front heel to stand.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

9316.name: 吊環墊高屈體伏地挺身(低位起始)
instructions: Set the rings low and put your hands on them with your feet on a box.
Raise your hips into a pike shape.
Lower your head between the rings.
Keep the rings steady and close to your body.
推回到手臂伸直。
收緊內核。

9317.name: 坐姿等長收縮停留引體向上

9318.name: 仰臥地板離心龍旗
instructions: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Raise your body into a straight line on your upper back.
收緊內核。
Lower your body slowly keeping it straight.
Stop just above the floor.
Bring your legs back up and reset.

9319.name: 仰臥地板離心半龍旗
instructions: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Lift your hips and tuck your knees.
收緊內核。
Lower your body slowly with bent knees.
Stop just above the floor.
Reset and repeat.

9320.name: 等長收縮停留窄握反手引體向上
instructions: Grip the bar with palms facing you and hands close together.
Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar.
Hold for 5 to 15 seconds.
Keep your shoulders down and core tight.
控制着慢慢放下。
Rest and repeat.

9321.name: 仰臥地板水平打水
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and hands under your hips.
Lift your feet a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small alternating motions.
下背保持貼緊凳面。
Breathe steadily.
Continue for 20 to 40 seconds.

9322.name: 仰臥地板單腿離心龍旗

9323.name: 寬長凳徒手深蹲
instructions: Stand in front of a bench with your feet wide and toes turned out.
Push your hips back and lower down.
Lightly touch the bench.
膝蓋方向與腳尖一致。
Press through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest tall.

9324.name: 長槓桿站姿髖伸展
instructions: Stand tall holding a support if needed.
Keep your leg straight.
Lift it back behind you.
Stop when your hips begin to tilt.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
Lower it slowly and switch legs.

9325.name: 等長收縮停留伏地挺身
instructions: Start in a straight-arm plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower halfway down until your elbows are bent.
Hold the position for 10 to 20 seconds.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
推回起始位置。
Rest and repeat.

9359.name: 單腿腿後肌臀橋
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot flat and the other leg raised.
Press your heel into the floor.
Lift your hips until your body forms a line.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
慢慢放下。
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

9387.name: 槓桿式傾斜單腿腿推
instructions: Sit on the machine and place one foot on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the platform until your knee is bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your heel to push it back.
Do not lock your knee at the top.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

9398.name: 槓桿式站姿蝴蝶機夾胸

9409.name: 椅子支撐站姿屈膝提踵
instructions: Stand behind a chair and hold it for balance.
Bend your knees slightly.
Raise your heels as high as you can.
在頂部暫停。
Lower your heels slowly.
Keep your knees bent throughout.

9410.name: 槓鈴站姿屈膝墊高提踵

9411.name: 椅子支撐站姿屈膝交替提踵

9484.name: 啞鈴羅馬尼亞硬舉接深蹲

9485.name: 壺鈴羅馬尼亞硬舉接深蹲

9487.name: 地板坐姿抬腿
instructions: Sit on the floor with your hands planted behind your hips and legs extended.
Lean back slightly and brace your abs.
Raise both legs together a short way off the floor.
Lower them slowly without letting your heels drop to the ground.
按計劃的次數重複。

9488.name: 屈體站立
instructions: Start on all fours and walk your feet in while lifting your hips high.
Form an upside-down V with straight arms and legs.
Press the floor away and let your head hang between your arms.
Keep your heels reaching toward the floor.
保持 20-30 秒，慢慢呼吸。

9490.name: 登箱
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench at a comfortable height.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Press through that heel and stand up on the box.
Step back down with control.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

9491.name: 滑輪側臥單臂側平舉
instructions: Set a low pulley and lie on your side with the handle in your top hand.
Keep your arm straight or slightly bent.
Raise the handle in an arc up to about shoulder height or a bit higher.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

9494.name: 槓桿式腰帶羅馬尼亞硬舉

9503.name: 懸吊帶後三角划船
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms straight and body in a line.
Brace your core and glutes.
Pull your hands toward your chest with elbows flared out wide.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.

9509.name: 槓桿式坐姿腳尖提升
instructions: Sit at the machine with the pads over your thighs and balls of your feet on the platform.
Lower your heels for a calf stretch.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
在頂部短暫停頓。
慢慢放下並重復。

9510.name: 夥伴輔助引體向上
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Have your partner hold your legs or hips.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
在頂部暫停。
Lower yourself slowly.
Ask your partner to give just enough help.

9511.name: 箱子輔助引體向上
instructions: Place a box under a pull-up bar.
Grip the bar and rest one or both feet on the box.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar.
Use your legs as little as possible.
慢慢放下。
收緊內核。

9512.name: 箱子單腿輔助引體向上
instructions: Place a box under a pull-up bar.
Grip the bar and rest one foot on the box.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar.
Push lightly with the foot on the box.
慢慢放下。
Switch the assisting leg on the next set.

9516.name: 槓鈴墊高腳跟高拉握法深蹲
instructions: Place your heels on small plates and hold a bar across your upper back with a clean-width grip.
收緊內核，抬起胸口。
Sit down into a deep squat with knees tracking over toes.
Pause at the bottom.
Drive up through your feet to stand.

9517.name: 負重壺鈴死蟲式
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell above your chest with straight arms.
Raise your knees to a tabletop position.
將下背壓向地面。
Extend one leg out while keeping your back flat.
Return it and alternate sides.

9518.name: 壺鈴仰臥拉舉死蟲式
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell above your chest and knees at tabletop.
Brace your core and keep your lower back down.
Lower the kettlebell overhead while extending the opposite leg.
Return to the start under control.
換邊並重復。

9602.name: 徒手派翠克登階(從踏箱)

9604.name: 徒手波利金登階(從踏箱)
instructions: Stand on a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot toward the floor with control.
上身保持挺直。
Lightly tap the floor.
Press up through your working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

9605.name: 徒手彼得森登階(從踏箱)

9610.name: 槓片過頭前弓步
instructions: Hold a weight plate overhead with straight arms.
Step forward into a long stride.
將後側膝蓋向地面靠近。
Keep your torso upright and the plate steady.
Push back to the start and alternate legs.

9611.name: 徒手過頭前弓步
instructions: Stand tall with your arms extended overhead.
Step forward into a long stride.
將後側膝蓋向地面靠近。
Keep your ribs down and arms in line with your ears.
Push back to the start and alternate legs.

9653.name: 站姿軀幹扭轉手臂擺動

9676.name: 槓桿式俯臥屈膝
instructions: Lie face down on the machine with the pad above your heels.
Grip the handles and keep your hips down.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
在頂部收緊。
Lower slowly back to the start.

9691.name: 徒手墊高腳跟前蹲
instructions: Place your heels on a low plate or wedge.
Hold your hands in front of your chest.
Sit down into a deep squat with your chest tall.
膝蓋方向與腳尖一致。
Press up to stand and repeat.

9692.name: 壺鈴交替單臂推舉深蹲

9693.name: 啞鈴交替單臂推舉深蹲

9694.name: 槓鈴半跪姿肩推
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and a barbell at your shoulder.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your core.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower under control to your shoulder.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

9695.name: 地雷管半跪姿肩推
instructions: Kneel on one knee and hold the end of the landmine at your shoulder.
收緊內核，夾緊臀部。
Press the end up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower slowly to your shoulder.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

9696.name: 槓鈴蛙式站姿硬舉
instructions: Stand with feet wide, toes turned out, and a bar over mid-foot.
Hinge and bend your knees to grip the bar.
收緊內核，背部貼緊。
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
Lower the bar with control.

9697.name: 壺鈴倒握單臂過頭負重行走

9698.name: 啞鈴胸部支撐划船
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the weights toward your ribs.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
慢慢放下。

9699.name: 啞鈴單臂胸部支撐划船

9703.name: 壺鈴z推舉
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended and hold a kettlebell at your shoulder.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Press the kettlebell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to your shoulder.
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

9705.name: 滑輪地板仰臥前平舉
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet toward a low pulley and hold the handle.
Start with your arm by your thigh.
Raise your arm up over your chest with a slight elbow bend.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch arms.

9803.name: 站姿脛骨前肌提升(靠牆支撐)
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and feet a little forward.
Keep your legs straight.
Lift your toes as high as you can, keeping your heels down.
在頂部暫停。
慢慢放下並重復。

9819.name: 懸垂抬膝
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms straight.
Brace your abs and avoid swinging.
Raise your knees toward your chest.
Tilt your pelvis up at the top.
慢慢放下並重復。

9848.name: 槓桿式站姿髖推
instructions: Adjust the machine so the pad sits across your hips.
Stand with your feet hip width apart.
Lower your hips back slightly.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes.
慢慢回到起始位置。
Keep your ribs down.

9849.name: 側平板蚌式開合
instructions: Lie on your side in a side plank, supported on your forearm with knees bent.
Lift your hips so your body is in a line.
Keep your feet together and open your top knee upward.
Close it under control.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

9862.name: 槓桿式單臂牧師椅彎舉(掛片式)
instructions: Sit at the machine with your upper arm resting on the pad and grip the handle.
Start with your arm almost straight.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
在頂部收緊。
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

9863.name: 滑輪側臥地板單腿後踢
instructions: Lie on your side with a cuff on your top ankle.
Position the cable behind you.
Kick your top leg back and slightly up.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
慢慢回到起始位置。
Do your reps, then switch sides.

9865.name: 槓桿式腰帶硬舉(V形握把)
instructions: Stand on the platform with the belt around your hips and grip the V bar.
Bend your knees and hinge with a flat back.
收緊內核。
Drive your feet down and stand tall.
控制着慢慢放下。

9866.name: 槓桿式腰帶硬舉(直槓)
instructions: Stand on the platform with the belt around your hips and grip the straight bar.
Bend your knees and hinge with a flat back.
收緊內核。
Drive your feet down and stand tall.
控制着慢慢放下。

9867.name: 滑輪45度反握反向飛鳥
instructions: Stand at a cable station and grab the handles with palms up.
Hinge forward about 45 degrees.
Pull your arms out and back in a wide arc.
夾緊肩胛骨。
慢慢回到起始位置。

9869.name: 滑輪45度單臂反握反向飛鳥

9870.name: 滑輪斜板單臂Y字上舉(背部支撐)

9871.name: 滑輪斜板單臂Y字上舉(腕帶,背部支撐)
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with the strap on one wrist.
Let your arm hang down.
Raise it up and out in a Y shape.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

9873.name: 滑輪臥椅單臂交叉側平舉
instructions: Lie on a flat bench next to a low pulley and take the handle with the far hand.
Start with your arm across your body and a soft bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out and up in an arc until it reaches about shoulder height.
Hold for a moment, then lower with control.
Keep your torso still and your shoulder away from your ear.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

9874.name: 滑輪臥姿單臂交叉側平舉
instructions: Lie on the floor next to a low pulley and grip the handle with the far hand.
Begin with your arm across your body and the elbow slightly bent.
Raise your arm out and up in a smooth arc to about shoulder height.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower slowly back across your body without letting the weight stack rest.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

9875.name: 滑輪坐椅單臂扭轉划船

9876.name: 槓桿腰帶羅馬尼亞硬舉(直桿)

9877.name: 槓桿腰帶羅馬尼亞硬舉(V型桿)
instructions: Step into the machine, secure the belt and take the V bar with both hands.
Stand tall with soft knees and your shoulders back.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back as the bar slides down your thighs.
Lower until your hamstrings are well stretched, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward and stand up straight.
在頂部夾緊臀部。

9927.name: 滑輪臥姿斜板側抬腿
instructions: Lie on your side on an incline surface.
Attach the cuff to your top ankle.
Raise your top leg out to the side.
在頂部暫停。
控制着慢慢放下。
Do your reps, then switch sides.

9928.name: 滑輪臥姿斜板單腿後踢
instructions: Lie on an incline surface with the cuff on one ankle.
Hold the support for stability.
Kick your leg back and up.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
慢慢放下。
Do your reps, then switch legs.

9929.name: 槓桿單腿深蹲(哈克深蹲機)

9931.name: 啞鈴蜘蛛彎舉
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your arms hanging straight down.
Keep your upper arms vertical and your palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
在頂部夾緊二頭肌。
Lower slowly until your arms are fully extended.
Keep your chest on the pad and avoid swinging.

9932.name: 槓鈴彈力帶負重槓片臥推

9933.name: 啞鈴坐姿交替側平舉
instructions: Sit upright on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
肘部保持微微彎曲。
Raise one arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Lower it slowly, then raise the other arm.
Keep your torso still and avoid shrugging.
Alternate sides for your reps.

9942.name: 站姿交叉腿核心伸展
instructions: Stand tall and cross one leg in front of the other.
Raise the arm on the same side as the back leg overhead.
Reach and lean gently toward the opposite side.
Feel the stretch along your side and abs.
保持 20-30 秒，呼吸均勻。
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.

9971.name: 仰臥直膝抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight.
Tighten the thigh of the straight leg so the knee is locked.
Lift the leg to the height of your bent knee.
Hold for a moment.
Lower slowly to the floor.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

9980.name: 棍輔助站姿肩屈曲
instructions: Stand tall holding a stick with both hands at hip level, palms down.
Keep the working arm relaxed and let the other hand lead.
Raise the stick forward and overhead as far as is comfortable.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly back to the start.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back.

9994.name: 球輔助仰臥屈膝等長髖內收
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Place a ball between your knees.
Squeeze the ball with your inner thighs.
Hold for 5 to 10 seconds.
慢慢放鬆。
Repeat for several reps.

9996.name: 彈力帶等長拇指伸展
instructions: Loop a light resistance band around your thumb and the base of your fingers.
Rest your hand on a table or your thigh.
Push your thumb out against the band.
Hold the tension for 5-10 seconds without moving.
慢慢放鬆。
Repeat, then switch hands.

9999.name: 平板支撐點膝
instructions: Start in a forearm or high plank.
收緊內核。
Lower one knee gently toward the floor.
Return it and switch sides.
髖部保持水平。
Breathe steadily.

10003.name: 彈力帶坐姿地面踝背屈

10032.name: 拇指外展
instructions: Rest your hand on a table with the palm facing up.
Keep your fingers relaxed and straight.
Slowly move your thumb away from your palm.
Pause at the end of the range.
慢慢回到起始位置。
Do 10-15 reps, then switch hands.

10038.name: 啞鈴腕旋後
instructions: Sit and rest your forearm on your thigh or a bench with the hand hanging free.
Hold a light dumbbell with your palm facing down.
Rotate your forearm so the palm turns up.
在頂部暫停。
Rotate back slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms. Keep your elbow still.

10040.name: 啞鈴站姿交替交叉上舉
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise one arm up and across your body toward the opposite shoulder, elbow slightly bent.
在頂部暫停。
控制着慢慢放下。
Repeat with the other arm, alternating.
Keep your torso steady and avoid swinging.

10047.name: 槓鈴分腿站姿羅馬尼亞硬舉
instructions: Hold a barbell at your thighs and stand with one foot a step ahead of the other.
Put most of your weight on the front leg.
Hinge at the hips and slide the bar down your front leg.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstring.
髖部向前送，站直身體。
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

10048.name: 滑輪登階
instructions: Stand facing a box or bench with a cable handle in your hands.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Push through that heel to step up.
Stand tall on top of the box.
Step back down with control.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

10051.name: 徒手窄站距深蹲弓步
instructions: Stand with feet close together and hands on your hips or in front of you.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge, keeping your feet in a narrow line.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and chest up.
Push through the front heel to stand back up.
換腿並重復。

10054.name: 槓鈴靜態弓步
instructions: Place a barbell across your upper back.
Step into a split stance with one foot forward.
Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your chest tall and torso upright.
Press through the front heel to rise.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

10055.name: 啞鈴窄站距深蹲弓步
instructions: Stand with feet close together, a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge, keeping your feet in a narrow line.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and chest up.
Push through the front heel to stand back up.
換腿並重復。

10056.name: 地雷管彈力帶推舉
instructions: Set up a landmine with a band attached and hold the end of the bar at your shoulder.
Stand with feet staggered and core braced.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it to your shoulder under control.
完成所有次數，然後換臂。
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

10095.name: 滑輪單臂熊式飛鳥
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and stand with a staggered stance.
Grab the handle with one hand and brace your core.
Keep your elbow slightly bent and sweep your arm across your body.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
慢慢回到起始位置。
Finish reps and switch arms.

10096.name: 啞鈴後弓步轉單臂肩推

10097.name: 負重槓片側向起身深蹲

10110.name: 槓鈴粗槓反握彎舉
instructions: Hold a fat barbell with an overhand grip.
Stand with elbows by your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
在頂部收緊。
慢慢放下。
Keep your wrists straight.

10112.name: 滑輪坐姿單臂背闊肌划船

10113.name: 槓桿式等長深蹲髖外展

10116.name: 史密斯機上斜窄握臥推

10117.name: 啞鈴半跪姿單臂高拉推舉

10139.name: 坐姿等長腿彎舉持握(健身球)

10184.name: 彈力帶交替分腿站姿帕洛夫推

10185.name: 啞鈴熊爬棒式交替划船
instructions: Start on all fours with a dumbbell in each hand and knees hovering just off the floor.
收緊內核，背部貼緊。
Row one dumbbell to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it back to the floor with control.
Row with the other arm and keep alternating at a steady pace.

10186.name: 啞鈴仰臥拉舉轉推舉橋式

10189.name: 負重槓片硬舉後弓步過頭推舉

10199.name: 啞鈴交叉羅馬尼亞硬舉
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with a soft bend in the knees.
Push your hips back and lower the weights down your legs.
Reach one dumbbell across toward the opposite foot, keeping your back flat.
髖部向前送，站直身體。
Alternate the crossing side each rep.

10328.name: 槓桿式腰帶保加利亞分腿蹲

10331.name: 彈力帶負重站姿旋前扭轉彎舉(腕力賽)

10345.name: 超人式脈衝
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few inches.
Pulse them up and down in small movements.
頸部保持中立。
Lower and rest after your set.

10366.name: 彈力帶坐姿地面脛前肌推

10386.name: 負重沙袋負重行走(肩扛)

10387.name: 負重沙袋負重行走(熊抱)

10389.name: 負重沙袋划船
instructions: Stand over a sandbag, hinge forward and grab it with both hands.
Keep your back flat and knees slightly bent.
Row the bag toward your lower ribs.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
Lower slowly back to full arm extension.

10437.name: 滑輪單臂低位划船(繩索)
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and sit facing the stack with your feet braced.
Hold the rope in one hand with your arm extended.
Pull your elbow back along your side, squeezing your shoulder blade.
Pause, then let the arm extend slowly.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

10462.name: 椅上坐姿腿後側伸展
instructions: Sit near the front edge of a chair.
Extend one leg straight with your heel on the floor and toes up.
Hinge forward from your hips with a flat back until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
換腿並重復。

10463.name: 椅上坐姿夾肩胛擴胸伸展

10517.name: 站姿單腿髖部畫圈(椅子支撐)
instructions: Stand beside a chair and hold it for balance.
Lift one leg slightly off the floor.
Draw slow, controlled circles with your leg.
Do half of the reps one way, then reverse the direction.
換腿並重復。

10534.name: 坐姿單腿膝屈曲
instructions: Sit on a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Slide one foot back under the chair, bending the knee.
Pause briefly at the end of the range.
Return the foot slowly to the start.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

10537.name: 坐姿單腿伸膝
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat.
Slowly straighten one knee to lift your foot.
Squeeze your thigh at the top for a second.
Lower the foot back to the floor with control.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

10538.name: 坐姿單腿伸膝 v. 2
instructions: Sit tall on a chair, holding the seat edge for support.
Straighten one knee until the leg is level.
Hold for a second, tightening your thigh.
Lower slowly to the start.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

10539.name: 負重坐姿單腿伸膝 v. 2

10541.name: 坐姿單腿抱膝屈曲
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with feet flat.
Lift one knee and clasp your hands around the shin.
Gently pull the knee toward your chest and flex it.
Hold for a moment, then release.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

10542.name: 坐姿單腿抱膝屈曲(毛巾)
instructions: Sit tall on a chair and loop a towel around one shin.
Hold the towel ends with both hands.
Pull the knee gently toward your chest, bending it.
Hold for a moment, then release.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

10543.name: 跪姿屈膝(椅子支撐)
instructions: Hold the back of a chair and kneel on one knee on a soft surface.
上身保持挺直。
Slowly sit back toward your heel to bend the knee.
Stay within a comfortable range.
Return to the start and switch sides after your reps.

10547.name: 站姿單腿小腿搖擺
instructions: Stand on one leg next to a wall for balance.
Rock your weight back onto your heel, lifting the toes.
Roll forward onto the ball of your foot.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

10552.name: 藥球分腿站姿軀幹扭轉
instructions: Stand in a split stance and hold a medicine ball at chest height.
收緊內核。
Rotate your torso to one side, keeping your hips steady.
Return to the centre and rotate the other way.
Complete all reps, then switch the front foot.

10555.name: 椅上坐姿頸部屈曲至伸展

10556.name: 椅上坐姿頸部左右轉動

10557.name: 椅上坐姿頸部左右側彎

10561.name: 壺鈴單腿硬舉傳遞
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Hinge at the hips and reach the bell toward the floor.
Pass the bell to the other hand below your knee.
Stand back up using your glute and hamstring.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

10562.name: 壺鈴同側後弓步抬膝
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand tall.
Step back with the leg on the same side as the bell.
Lower into a lunge.
Drive up and lift that knee high as you stand.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

10563.name: 膝碰箱小腿伸展
instructions: Place a foot flat a short distance from a box or step.
Keep your heel down.
Push your knee forward to touch the box.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a calf stretch.
換腿並重復。

10565.name: 90度對90度推伸展
instructions: Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one leg in front, one to the side.
Sit tall.
Hinge forward over the front shin with a flat back.
換邊並重復。

10566.name: 半跪姿軀幹扭轉
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Hold your arms crossed in front of your chest.
Rotate your upper body toward the front leg.
Return to the centre and keep your hips square.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

10590.name: 手走式背闊肌伸展
instructions: Stand and hinge forward to place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands out in front of you.
Sit your hips back and press your chest down.
Walk your hands back in and stand up.

10591.name: 彈力帶坐姿單腿抱膝屈曲
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with a band around one foot.
Hold the band ends in your hands.
Pull the knee up and bend it toward your chest.
Hold for a moment, then release slowly.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

10592.name: 半跪姿腿後側伸展
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other leg extended, heel on the floor.
Keep your toes pointing up.
Hinge forward from your hips with a flat back.
換腿並重復。

10594.name: 彈力帶側向擊打
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height beside you and hold the handle at your chest.
Stand tall in a stable stance with your core braced.
Press the handle forward and across your body in a quick controlled motion.
Return slowly to your chest without letting the band pull you around.
Keep your hips square throughout.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

10598.name: 藥球仰臥窄距推舉接住

10639.name: 臀腿訓練椅完整仰臥起坐

10646.name: 槓桿式上斜俯臥划船
instructions: Lie chest-down on the incline pad and grab the handles.
Let your arms extend fully.
Pull the handles back, driving your elbows toward your hips.
將肩胛骨擠壓在一起。
慢慢放下直到手臂伸直。
Keep your head neutral.

10650.name: 彈力帶爆發式伏地挺身

10651.name: 彈力帶站在波速球單腿外展
instructions: Place a band around your ankles and stand on the bosu with one foot.
Hold your core tight and stay tall.
Lift your free leg out to the side against the band.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Return slowly without leaning.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

10654.name: 皮拉提斯器械仰臥伸膝(腳尖)

10655.name: 皮拉提斯器械仰臥伸膝
instructions: Lie on the carriage with feet on the bar.
Bend your knees.
Press out until legs are straight.
慢慢回到起始位置。
Keep your lower back stable.

10656.name: 皮拉提斯器械仰臥伸膝(腳跟)
instructions: Lie on the carriage with heels on the bar.
Bend your knees.
Press out through the heels until straight.
慢慢回到起始位置。
髖部保持水平。

10657.name: 皮拉提斯器械仰臥提踵
instructions: Lie on the carriage with legs straight, balls of feet on the bar.
Press your heels down.
Rise up onto your toes.
慢慢回到起始位置。
Keep your knees locked softly.

10658.name: 皮拉提斯器械百次拍擊

10660.name: 彈力帶輔助單臂引體向上
instructions: Loop a band over the bar and place your foot or knee in it.
Hang with one hand on the bar and the other holding your wrist or the band.
Pull your chin toward the bar, driving the elbow down.
在頂部暫停。
Lower with control to a full hang.
Switch arms after each set.

10661.name: 吊環彈力帶輔助單臂引體向上

10662.name: 吊環洛基引體下拉
instructions: Hang from the rings with arms straight and shoulders engaged.
Pull your chest up toward the rings.
At the top, drive the rings down toward your hips.
Pause with your arms close to your sides.
Return to the top, then lower slowly.
收緊內核。

10664.name: 平板支撐推舉
instructions: Start in a deep planche lean with hands under your shoulders.
Protract your shoulders and squeeze your glutes.
Lean forward and lift your feet from the floor.
Press into the ground and hold the position.
控制着慢慢放下。
Warm up your wrists first.

10667.name: 滑輪跪姿單臂水平划船

10668.name: 彈力帶跪姿單臂水平划船

10669.name: 槓桿式配重片坐姿上斜胸推
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at upper-chest height.
Sit back with your feet flat and shoulder blades pinched.
Press the handles forward and up until your arms are almost straight.
短暫停頓。
Return slowly to a stretch across your chest.
Keep your back against the pad.

10670.name: 槓桿式配重片坐姿上斜單臂胸推

10671.name: 槓桿式配重片坐姿胸推

10672.name: 槓桿式配重片坐姿單臂胸推

10673.name: 壺鈴深蹲
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest.
雙腳分開與肩同寬站立。
Sit your hips down and back while keeping your chest tall.
Lower until your thighs are parallel or lower.
Push through your heels to stand.
Keep your elbows close to your body.

10674.name: 壺鈴背蹲
instructions: Hold the kettlebell behind your neck on your upper back with both hands.
雙腳分開與肩同寬站立。
Brace your core and sit down and back.
Lower to parallel while keeping your chest up.
腳後跟發力站起。
Keep your elbows pointing down.

10675.name: 地雷管深蹲跳
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
雙腳分開與肩同寬站立。
Squat down with a tall chest.
Jump up explosively through your feet.
屈膝輕輕落地。
Reset and repeat.

10710.name: 槓片仰臥捲腹
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Hold the plate on your chest.
Curl your shoulders up.
Pause and squeeze.
慢慢放下。

10729.name: 水中飛輪車
instructions: Stand in chest-deep water, holding the pool edge.
Lift your knees alternately.
Pedal at a steady rhythm.
收緊內核。
Continue for several minutes.

10730.name: 負重沙袋羅馬尼亞硬舉
instructions: Hold a sandbag in front of your thighs with a firm grip.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and slide the bag down your legs.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
髖部向前送，站直身體。
背部貼緊地面。

10731.name: L型坐姿爬繩
instructions: Grip the rope and hang with your legs raised in front of you.
Keep your legs straight and together.
Pull with one hand over the other while staying in the L position.
Reach up and repeat.
控制着慢慢放下。
Stop if your legs drop.

10733.name: 平衡板單腿平衡
instructions: Place a balance board on a flat floor next to a wall for safety.
Step on with one foot and find your centre.
Lift the other foot off the floor.
Hold steady for 20-30 seconds.
髖部保持水平。
換腿。

10734.name: 平衡墊單腿平衡
instructions: Place the pad on a flat floor.
Step on with one foot and stand tall.
Lift the other foot off the floor.
Keep your eyes on a fixed point.
換腿。

10739.name: 仰臥單臂三頭肌伸展
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Raise one arm and bend the elbow, hand reaching behind your head.
Use your other hand to press the elbow gently toward the floor.
Keep your ribs down.
換臂。

10740.name: 棍棒仰臥單臂三頭肌伸展
instructions: Lie on your back holding a stick in both hands.
Bend one arm and take that hand behind your head.
Use the other hand to push the stick and press that elbow down.
Keep your neck relaxed.
換臂。

10741.name: 彈力帶站姿單臂三頭肌伸展
instructions: Stand tall and hold a band behind your back with one hand low.
Raise the other arm overhead and bend the elbow, holding the band.
Gently pull down with the lower hand.
Feel a stretch in the back of the upper arm.
換臂。

10744.name: 彈力帶坐姿單腿腿後側伸展
instructions: Sit tall with one leg extended and a band around that foot.
Hold the band ends in both hands.
Keep your leg straight and gently pull your toes toward you.
Hinge forward until you feel a stretch.
換腿。

10745.name: 坐姿單腿半圓
instructions: Sit tall on the floor with hands behind you for support.
Lift one leg slightly with the knee straight.
Draw a half circle with your foot from one side to the other.
Keep your torso steady.
Repeat for the reps.
換腿。

10746.name: 彈力帶坐姿單腿伸膝
instructions: Sit on a bench and secure a band around one ankle.
Anchor the other end behind you.
Straighten your knee against the band.
Squeeze the front of your thigh at the top.
慢慢放下。
換腿。

10748.name: 站姿單腿前後左右點地
instructions: Stand on one leg.
Tap the other toe forward.
Tap to the side, then back.
Keep your balance.
換腿。

10752.name: 徒手傑佛遜彎舉
instructions: 站直，雙腳分開與髖同寬。
Tuck your chin and roll down one vertebra at a time.
Let your arms hang toward the floor.
Reach only as far as is comfortable.
Reverse slowly to stand.
Move with control and keep the load light.

10753.name: 彈力帶坐姿抬膝
instructions: Sit tall on a bench or chair with a band looped around your foot and anchored low.
Hold the seat edge and brace your core.
Lift one knee toward your chest against the band.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower the foot slowly with control.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

10754.name: 單腿小腿跳
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and arms relaxed.
Push through the ball of your foot and jump up using mainly your ankles.
Keep the knee nearly straight in the air.
用同一只腳的前腳掌輕柔落地。
Rebound right away into the next hop.
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

10755.name: 單腿小腿跳(階梯箱支撐)

10756.name: 小腿向前跳
instructions: Stand tall with feet together and knees slightly soft.
Push off the balls of your feet and hop forward a short distance.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
用前腳掌輕輕落地。
Hop back or turn around and repeat.
Stay light and quick through the whole set.

10757.name: 小腿左右跳
instructions: Stand tall with feet together and knees slightly soft.
Spring off your toes and hop to one side.
用前腳掌輕輕落地。
Immediately hop to the other side.
Keep your chest up and hips level.
Continue alternating for the set.

10758.name: 藥球滑冰跳
instructions: Hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Hop sideways onto one leg.
Land softly with a bent knee.
Pause briefly, then push off to the other side.
抬起胸口。
Alternate for the reps.

10759.name: 高抬膝行走
instructions: Stand tall with your arms relaxed.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Step forward and lower it to the floor.
在另一側重複。
上身保持挺直。
Walk 10-20 steps per leg.

10760.name: 彈力帶踮腳走
instructions: Place a band around your forefeet or ankles.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Walk forward in small controlled steps.
Stay high on your toes.
髖部保持水平。
Walk for 20-30 steps.

10762.name: 踮腳側走
instructions: Stand tall and rise onto your toes.
Bend your knees slightly.
Step sideways with small controlled steps.
Stay high on your toes.
髖部保持水平。
Walk one way, then return.

10763.name: 槓桿式坐姿單腿彎舉(掛片式)
instructions: Sit on the machine and set the pad above your ankle.
Hold the handles and keep your back against the seat.
Curl one leg down and back.
Squeeze at the bottom.
慢慢回到起始位置。
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

10780.name: 仰臥頸部屈曲
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Relax your shoulders.
Tuck your chin and lift your head slightly off the floor.
Hold for a second.
慢慢放下。
Keep the motion small and smooth.

10781.name: 仰臥頸部伸展
instructions: Lie face down with your forehead hanging near the edge of a bench or resting just off the floor.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your head a few centimeters, keeping your chin slightly tucked.
短暫停頓。
慢慢放下。
Use small, controlled reps.

10817.name: 啞鈴腕旋轉
instructions: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh or a bench.
Hold a light dumbbell with your palm facing up.
Rotate your forearm so the palm turns down.
Pause, then rotate back.
Move slowly with control.
換臂。

10818.name: 四向單腿跳 v. 2
instructions: 單腿站立，膝蓋微屈。
向前跳，落地輕柔。
跳回起始位置，再向側面跳出去並跳回。
向第四個方向跳。
每次落地都穩住身體。
換腿。
10818.description: 單腿向四個方向跳躍的平衡動作。訓練爆發力、平衡與踝關節穩定性。

10819.name: 分腿站姿單腿提踵
instructions: Stand in a split stance, front foot flat and back toes lightly touching the floor.
Keep most weight on the front leg.
Rise onto the ball of the front foot.
在頂部暫停。
Lower the heel slowly.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

10820.name: 彈力帶站姿平衡屈腿髖外展
instructions: Place a band around your ankles or knees.
Balance on one leg with a soft knee.
Bend the other knee and lift it out to the side.
上身保持挺直。
慢慢回到起始位置。
完成所有次數，然後換腿。

10847.name: 皮拉提斯器械仰臥蛙腿畫圈

10848.name: 皮拉提斯器械仰臥跑步

10849.name: 皮拉提斯器械仰臥骨盆抬升

10850.name: 皮拉提斯器械側向劈腿
instructions: Stand with one foot on the carriage and one on the platform.
收緊內核。
Slide the carriage out to widen your stance.
Pause.
Draw it back under control with your inner thighs.
Keep your hips square.

10851.name: 皮拉提斯器械俄羅斯深蹲

10852.name: 皮拉提斯器械俄羅斯分腿

10854.name: 皮拉提斯器械手臂畫圈

10855.name: 皮拉提斯器械擴胸
instructions: Kneel facing the straps with your torso upright.
Hold the straps with straight arms.
Pull the straps back behind your body.
Turn your head gently to each side.
慢慢回到起始位置。
Keep your chest lifted and ribs down.

10856.name: 皮拉提斯器械過頭
instructions: Sit or kneel on the carriage holding the straps overhead.
收緊內核。
Press the straps forward and down in a controlled arc.
Return to the overhead position.
Keep your spine tall.
Move smoothly with breath.

10859.name: 站姿地面脛前肌上提(靠牆支撐)
instructions: Stand with your back and hips against a wall, feet a little way out in front.
Keep your legs straight and your heels planted on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shins as high as you can.
在頂部短暫停頓。
Lower your toes slowly and repeat.

10861.name: 負重球反向背部伸展(ghd)
instructions: Lie face down on the GHD with hips at the edge and a ball between your feet.
Hold the pad.
Lift your legs until they line up with your torso.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
慢慢放下。
Do not swing.

10862.name: 徒手單腿硬舉(靠球)
instructions: Stand facing a wall with a ball between your hand and the wall.
Lift one foot slightly.
Hinge at the hip as the free leg extends back.
背部貼緊地面。
Return to standing.
Switch legs after the set.

10863.name: 史密斯機坐姿單臂中立握肩推

10865.name: 啞鈴單腿羅馬尼亞硬舉(長凳)

10866.name: 槓桿式俯身單臂背闊肌划船

10867.name: 槓桿式上斜俯臥中立握划船

10868.name: 波速球深蹲
instructions: Stand on the Bosu with feet shoulder width apart.
Hold your arms forward.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees.
Keep your chest lifted.
Stand tall.
膝蓋方向與腳尖一致。

10869.name: 波速球單腿深蹲
instructions: Stand on one foot on the Bosu.
Extend your arms for balance.
Lower into a controlled squat.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
推回起始位置。
Switch legs after the set.

10870.name: 彈力帶臀橋行走
instructions: Lie on your back with a band above your knees and feet flat.
抬起髖部形成橋式。
Step your feet out and in sideways.
Keep the band tight.
Keep your hips high.
Lower after the set.

10871.name: 負重槓片捲腹(雙手過頭)
instructions: 仰臥，膝蓋彎曲，雙腳平放。
Hold a plate with both hands and extend your arms overhead.
Curl your shoulders and upper back off the floor, reaching the plate upward.
Pause at the top and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly without dropping your head back.

10873.name: 啞鈴負重捲腹(雙手過頭)
instructions: 仰臥，膝蓋彎曲，雙腳平放。
Hold one dumbbell upright with both hands and extend your arms overhead.
Curl your shoulders off the floor, driving the dumbbell toward the ceiling.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
慢慢放下並重復。

10877.name: 負重槓片捲腹(雙手過頭) v. 2

10879.name: 啞鈴負重捲腹(雙手過頭) v. 2
instructions: 仰臥，膝蓋彎曲，雙腳平放。
Hold a dumbbell at one end with both hands, arms extended overhead.
Crunch up and let the dumbbell travel in an arc toward your knees.
在頂部收緊腹部。
Lower with control and repeat.

10882.name: 跪姿增強式伏地挺身
instructions: Kneel in a push-up position with hands under shoulders.
Keep a straight line from knees to head.
將胸口向地面靠近。
Push up explosively so your hands leave the floor.
Land softly with bent elbows.
Go straight into the next rep.

10890.name: 彈跳床腳尖跳
instructions: Stand on the elastic bed with feet together.
Rise onto your toes.
Jump using your ankles.
用前腳掌輕輕落地。
Stay quick and light.
Continue for the set.

10899.name: 彈力帶仰臥外展
instructions: Loop a band around both legs just above the knees and lie on your side.
Stack your hips and bend your knees slightly.
Lift the top knee or leg away from the bottom one against the band.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly. Finish your reps and switch sides.

10903.name: 彈力帶輔助單臂引體向上 v. 2
instructions: Hang a band from the bar and place a foot or knee in the loop.
Grip the bar with one hand and keep the other arm across your chest.
Pull your chin toward the bar, driving your elbow down.
在頂部暫停。
Lower under control. Finish your reps and switch arms.

10904.name: 腿後側橋式 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor, a bit further from your hips.
Press through your heels.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your hamstrings and glutes at the top.
慢慢放下並重復。

10905.name: 腿後側橋式踢腿 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor.
抬起髖部形成橋式。
Straighten one leg out in front, keeping hips level.
Bring the foot back to the floor without dropping your hips.
Alternate legs or finish one side first.

10907.name: 徒手半分腿蹲持握
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other leg extended in front, heel on the floor.
Sit your hips back toward the rear heel.
Keep the front leg straight and your back long.
換腿。

10910.name: 坐姿單腿足部左右擺動

10913.name: 仰臥單腿抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and that foot flat.
Straighten the other leg and tighten the thigh.
Raise it to the height of your bent knee.
短暫停頓。
Lower slowly. Finish your reps and switch legs.

10914.name: 徒手四分之一深蹲
instructions: 雙腳分開與肩同寬站立。
Push your hips back and bend your knees a short way.
Keep your chest up and heels down.
Press through your feet to stand tall.
Repeat at a steady pace.

10915.name: 徒手單腿硬舉持握
instructions: 單腿站立，膝蓋微屈。
Hinge forward from the hips as the other leg extends behind you.
Keep your back flat until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Hold for several seconds, hips level.
Return upright and switch legs.

10916.name: 徒手單腿硬舉摸腳趾
instructions: 單腿站立，膝蓋微屈。
Hinge forward as the free leg lifts behind you.
Reach your hands toward the toes of the standing foot.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Stand back up with control. Finish your reps and switch legs.

10917.name: 坐姿單腿脛前肌推 v. 2

10919.name: 坐姿單腿足部左右擺動 v. 2

10921.name: 彈力帶坐姿單腿伸膝持握

10922.name: 站姿後側阿基里斯腱伸展
instructions: Stand facing a wall and step one foot back.
Keep the back heel down and the knee slightly bent.
Lean forward until you feel the stretch low in the calf.
換腿。

10926.name: 站姿靠牆滑動四分之一深蹲持握

10927.name: 站姿毛巾向前滑動推
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place a towel under your hand against it.
Keep your elbow bent and the hand at chest height.
Slide the towel forward as your arm straightens.
Slide it back slowly.
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

10928.name: 站姿毛巾靠牆前鋸肌滑動

10929.name: 站姿毛巾內旋滑動
instructions: Stand side-on to a wall with a towel under your forearm.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees against your side.
Slide your hand across your body along the wall.
慢慢回到起始位置。
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

10930.name: 站姿毛巾外旋滑動
instructions: Stand side-on to a wall with a towel under your forearm.
Keep your elbow at 90 degrees, tucked at your side.
Slide your hand outward along the wall.
慢慢回到起始位置。
完成所有次數，然後換臂。

10932.name: 毛巾背後肩部伸展
instructions: Hold a towel with one hand over your shoulder and the other behind your lower back.
Gently pull the towel upward with the lower hand.
Keep your chest open and neck relaxed.
換邊。

10933.name: 側臥外旋
instructions: Lie on your side with your top elbow bent to 90 degrees against your ribs.
Hold your forearm across your stomach.
Rotate your forearm upward without moving your elbow.
慢慢放下。
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

10934.name: 徒手側臥肩外旋
instructions: Lie on your side with a small towel under the top elbow.
Bend the elbow to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm up toward the ceiling.
Pause, then lower slowly.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

10935.name: 棍棒背後外展肩部活動度訓練

10950.name: 吊環長臂伏地挺身持握

10977.name: 啞鈴背部伸展 v. 2
instructions: Set the pad at hip height and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Lower your torso with a flat back.
Lift until you are in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes.
慢慢放下。
Do not overextend.

10995.name: 前後螃蟹走
instructions: Sit with hands behind you and feet flat, then lift your hips.
Keep your chest open and hips high.
Walk forward with alternating hands and feet.
Then walk backward the same way.
收緊內核。

10997.name: 靠牆輔助倒立轉團身平板支撐離心

10998.name: 面牆單腿劈腿倒立持握

11006.name: 椅上坐姿雙臂交叉與挺胸

11014.name: 啞鈴反握前平舉
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows slightly soft.
Raise your arms in front of you to shoulder height.
在頂部暫停。
Lower slowly and avoid leaning back.

11016.name: 啞鈴半跪姿單臂肩推
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front, and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height.
Brace your core and squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg.
Press the dumbbell straight overhead until your arm is extended.
Lower it under control back to your shoulder.
完成所有次數，然後換邊。

11048.name: 坐姿屈膝外展
instructions: Sit tall with your knees bent and feet on the floor.
Place your hands on your outer knees.
Press your knees outward against your hands.
Hold briefly.
慢慢放鬆。
Keep your back straight.

11049.name: 坐姿屈膝外展雙腳離地

11050.name: 彈力帶坐姿屈膝外展雙腳離地

11051.name: 滑輪站姿高位交叉中立握三頭伸展

11053.name: 史密斯機錯位站姿臀推

11054.name: 槓桿式錯位站姿臀推(掛片式)

11055.name: 槓桿式腰帶相撲硬舉(V型槓)
instructions: Stand wide on the platform with toes angled out and grip the V bar.
Sit your hips back, chest up, and keep your arms straight.
Push through your heels to stand fully upright.
在頂部夾緊臀部。
Lower under control, letting your knees track over your toes.

11056.name: 槓桿式坐姿肩胛後縮(掛片式)
instructions: Sit with your chest against the pad and grab the handles with straight arms.
Let your shoulder blades spread forward slightly.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together without bending your elbows.
Hold the squeeze for a second.
慢慢回到起始位置。

11057.name: 滑輪坐姿肩胛後縮
instructions: Sit at a low cable station, feet braced, and hold the handle with straight arms.
Sit tall and let your shoulder blades stretch forward.
Pull your shoulder blades together, keeping your arms straight.
Hold the squeeze briefly.
慢慢回到起始位置。

11058.name: 啞鈴髖部支撐羅馬尼亞硬舉
instructions: Stand with your hips lightly against the support, holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees and keep your back flat.
